stages.text: Heather runs Department H's tests on Wolverine for General Chasen. When Chasen orders the skeleton removed, she quits and stands against him.
stages.whoA: A scientist who quits on him
stages.whoB: The general she quits rather than obey

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Chasen says Department H invested a lot in Wolverine and wants a return. He has him chained and probed, then orders his skeleton cut out, until Alpha Flight frees him.
stages.whoA: The deserter whose skeleton he wants
stages.whoB: The general who wants his bones

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Chasen sends Alpha Flight to bring Wolverine home and lets them think he is rejoining. Learning the truth, they storm the lab and beat his android guards.
stages.whoA: His team, which turns on him
stages.whoB: The general who lied to them

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Years ago, Heather and her husband James find the feral Logan and nurse him back to health. Now she lures him back for Department H's tests, then quits to stop Chasen and begs Wolverine to spare her husband.
stages.whoA: The man she once nursed and still cares for
stages.whoB: An old friend who betrays and then saves him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine tracks the new Juggernaut to a dance club, where Eugene is trying to impress women. Wolverine offers him some advice, then grabs the ruby so it can go back to Cain.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who takes the ruby
stages.whoB: The accidental new Juggernaut

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops and Wolverine hunt for the ruby and the new Juggernaut near the Cyttorak ruins. They corner Eugene and take the gem, and he turns back to normal.
stages.whoA: An X-Man sent after the ruby
stages.whoB: The accidental new Juggernaut

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Genosha a big collared slave doubts Jubilee's escape plan, then joins her revolt when she gives the signal. The guards stop them, and Jubilee is taken away.
stages.whoA: The girl who leads the slave revolt
stages.whoB: A fellow slave who joins her revolt

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Blob is part of Mystique's gang sent to kill Senator Kelly. While she poses as Gambit, Blob joins Avalanche and Pyro in the attack on the Capitol.
stages.whoA: The shape-shifter who leads his gang
stages.whoB: A thug in her gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Blob, Avalanche and Pyro pull a paid job that draws the X-Men out. Later they keep the X-Men busy outside Midtown Hospital while Mystique goes after Rogue.
stages.whoA: His boss, who sends him after the X-Men
stages.whoB: Hired muscle for her scheme

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Blob tries to flatten the X-Men at the Capitol. Wolverine knocks him into a pool of water.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who knocks him into a pool
stages.whoB: A Brotherhood thug at the Capitol

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Blob brawls with Wolverine outside Midtown Hospital, until Storm's hurricane blows him away.
stages.whoA: An X-Man he brawls with again
stages.whoB: A thug he keeps beating

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: At the Capitol, Storm calls up an arctic wind and freezes Blob in the pool Wolverine knocked him into.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who freezes him in ice
stages.whoB: A thug she freezes at the Capitol

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Outside Midtown Hospital, Storm blasts Blob with a gale while he fights the X-Men.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who blows him away
stages.whoB: A thug she blasts with a gale

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Garokk's priestess Zaladane steers Sauron into kidnapping Storm, and Garokk reveals that he planted that urge. When Garokk starts to absorb the land's power, Sauron drains it from him until both are spent.
stages.whoA: The man he used, who drains him
stages.whoB: The stone god who used him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Garokk needs Storm's power at full fury, so Sauron hypnotizes her and her storms feed him. When she fights him with cold and heat, she only makes him stronger.
stages.whoA: The weather witch whose power he feeds on
stages.whoB: The god who feeds on her power

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine slashes at Garokk as his stone spreads across the Savage Land, but cannot stop him from heading for the volcanoes.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who attacks him
stages.whoB: The stone god he fights

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George fights the X-Men for Sinister in the Nasty Boys. He delivers Scott and Jean to Sinister in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: His master, Mister Sinister
stages.whoB: One of his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George and the Nasty Boys snatch Jean for Sinister. Sinister then calls George in to cover him when the X-Men stop his grab for Xavier.
stages.whoA: His master, Mister Sinister
stages.whoB: One of his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Nasty Boys attack Scott and Jean for Sinister. Later George brings the captured pair to Sinister in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: An X-Man he captures for Sinister
stages.whoB: A Nasty Boy who captures him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Nasty Boys crash Scott and Jean's wedding day and take Jean through a portal. Cyclops then breaks into Sinister's lair.
stages.whoA: The groom whose bride he snatches
stages.whoB: A Nasty Boy who takes Jean

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George and the Nasty Boys go after Jean and Scott for Sinister. In the Savage Land he hands both of them over.
stages.whoA: An X-Man he captures for Sinister
stages.whoB: A Nasty Boy who captures her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Jean's wedding day the Nasty Boys grab her and toss her through a portal to Sinister.
stages.whoA: The bride he snatches for Sinister
stages.whoB: A Nasty Boy who kidnaps her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On the beach, George reaches for Gambit with 'Come to Gorgeous, pretty boy!' Gambit dodges him and calls him a walking tar pit.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he grabs for
stages.whoB: A gooey Nasty Boy he fights

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mojo calls for Gog to gather his crew and join the hunt for Longshot on Earth. Mojo orders him to cancel the heroes, then begs him for help when Longshot pins him.
stages.whoA: His master, Mojo
stages.whoB: One of his hunters

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gog joins Mojo's hunt for the runaway star Longshot on Earth. Longshot and the X-Men beat the hunters and wreck the broadcast.
stages.whoA: The runaway star he hunts
stages.whoB: A hunter Mojo sends after him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah serves in Corsair's Starjammers as they fight D'Ken. Later they follow Corsair to Earth to protect young Jandra from the Shi'ar police.
stages.whoA: Her captain
stages.whoB: One of his Starjammers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah fights beside the X-Men against D'Ken. On Earth she turns on Storm, thinking the X-Men betrayed Corsair, until the two sides team up again.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who fought beside her
stages.whoB: A Starjammer who fought beside her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah and the Starjammers seize the M'Kraan Crystal, then battle Emperor D'Ken and his Imperial Guard when he tries to take its power.
stages.whoA: The emperor she fights
stages.whoB: One of Corsair's rebel Starjammers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The High Evolutionary lures Magneto to Wundagore with a false Magda and takes his DNA for his new race. He reveals that Magneto is the twins' father, then flees as Magneto fights back.
stages.whoA: The mutant whose DNA he steals
stages.whoB: The geneticist who traps him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine follows Magneto to Wundagore, where he is gassed and held prisoner with him. The High Evolutionary escapes once the X-Men break in.
stages.whoA: An X-Man he captures
stages.whoB: The geneticist who captures him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Beast and Xavier reach Wundagore, the High Evolutionary orders his creatures to bring him the blue one. Beast and the X-Men fight his creatures, and the valley fades after its master flees.
stages.whoA: The blue mutant he wants for himself
stages.whoB: The geneticist who wants to take him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In the duel of honor on the Moon, Storm is fighting Earthquake of the Imperial Guard when Hussar strikes her down. A Guard member hails it as their first round.
stages.whoA: X-Man she brings down in the duel on the Moon
stages.whoB: Imperial Guard warrior who brings her down on the Moon

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: She is one of the Imperial Guard D'Ken sends against Corsair and the X-Men aboard his ship. When D'Ken takes the M'Kraan Crystal's power, the Guard are drawn into the crystal with everyone else.
stages.whoA: The Shi'ar emperor she fights for
stages.whoB: One of his Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hussar serves Empress Lilandra when the Shi'ar condemn Dark Phoenix. She fights for Lilandra in the duel on the Moon over Jean's fate.
stages.whoA: The empress she serves
stages.whoB: One of her Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator leads the Imperial Guard, Hussar among them, against the X-Men and the Starjammers for D'Ken. They fight together again for Lilandra in the duel on the Moon.
stages.whoA: One of the Imperial Guard he leads
stages.whoB: Leader of the Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: D'Ken sends Gladiator to Earth for Lilandra and the M'Kraan Crystal, and Gladiator reports that Phoenix guards it. D'Ken orders him to destroy Corsair once the crystal is his, and Gladiator obeys though D'Ken broke his sacred oath.
stages.whoA: The emperor he serves
stages.whoB: Leader of his Praetorian Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator seizes Lilandra at Cassidy Keep for her brother, telling her he serves whoever holds the Shi'ar throne. Once she is Empress he serves her, assembling the Imperial Guard against Dark Phoenix and fighting the X-Men in the duel on the Moon.
stages.whoA: Princess he captures, then the empress he serves
stages.whoB: Guard leader who seizes her, then serves her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Deathbird storms the palace, Gladiator stands between her and Lilandra as leader of the Praetorian Guard. Apocalypse, Deathbird's ally, takes the psychic Oracle instead.
stages.whoA: The empress he defends from Deathbird
stages.whoB: The guard leader who defends her

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Lilandra announces her engagement to Xavier, and Deathbird challenges it. Gladiator and the Imperial Guard fight Deathbird's supporters for their empress.
stages.whoA: The empress he guards
stages.whoB: Leader of her Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: At Cassidy Keep, Phoenix overwhelms Gladiator to protect Lilandra and hurls him into space. When the Shi'ar condemn Dark Phoenix, he leads the Imperial Guard against the X-Men for her life, and Phoenix rises again to thrash him.
stages.whoA: Phoenix, who hurls him into space
stages.whoB: Imperial Guard leader who fights for her death

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator easily beats the X-Men at Cassidy Keep, Rogue among them. In the duel on the Moon he faces her again, warning that she cannot match his power.
stages.whoA: X-Man he fights at Cassidy Keep and on the Moon
stages.whoB: Imperial Guard leader she fights twice

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Juggernaut, hired by Erik the Red, sneers at Gladiator at Cassidy Keep. Gladiator knocks him into the sea with one blow.
stages.whoA: Erik the Red's hired muscle he knocks into the sea
stages.whoB: Shi'ar warrior who knocks him into the sea

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Deathbird storms Lilandra's palace to seize the throne and has her rebels keep Gladiator busy. Her ally Apocalypse betrays her, and Gladiator stays loyal to the empress.
stages.whoA: Lilandra's sister, who tries to seize the throne
stages.whoB: Lilandra's guard leader, who stands in her way

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Deathbird invokes the Rite of M'Dashaa against Xavier's engagement to Lilandra. Gladiator and the Imperial Guard fight her supporters.
stages.whoA: Lilandra's sister, whose supporters he fights
stages.whoB: Leader of the guard that fights her supporters

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Colossus finds his little sister Illyana hiding in the ruins of their farm after the soldiers take their people. She leads him to the captives, and he rescues her and their parents from Omega Red with the X-Men's help.
stages.whoA: Her big brother Piotr
stages.whoB: His little sister

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: Colossus tells the X-Men his Acolytes are building a peaceful life in honor of the mutants who have died. His sister Illyana is among them.
stages.whoA: Her brother, who honors her memory
stages.whoB: His late sister

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Omega Red seizes Illyana and threatens to finish her unless Colossus surrenders. Wolverine frees her, and Omega Red is frozen again by the end.
stages.whoA: The monster who seizes her
stages.whoB: Colossus's sister, whom he takes hostage

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine arrives in time to tear Illyana from Omega Red's grip. She begs her brother to help the man who saved her.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who saves her from Omega Red
stages.whoB: Colossus's sister, whom he saves

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Jubilee flies to Russia with Colossus and finds his sister Illyana on the ruined farm. Illyana leads them to the compound where their people are held, and Jubilee helps free the farmers.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who comes with her brother
stages.whoB: Colossus's sister, who leads them to the captives

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Essex gives Jack life and sends him through Whitechapel to collect the samples he needs, scolding him for killing one he wanted alive. With them Essex remakes himself and tells Jack to call him Mister Sinister.
stages.whoA: Essex, the master who made him
stages.whoB: Jack, the creature he made to collect samples

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Dr. James Xavier warns the police that the Whitechapel butcher is a creature of Essex's experiments. He leads them to the flat where Jack brings Essex his samples, but the pair are gone.
stages.whoA: The doctor who leads the police after him
stages.whoB: The Whitechapel butcher Essex created

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Dr. James Xavier, physician to Grey Hall, debates Darwin with his friend Dr. Nathaniel Essex and treats Essex's wife Rebecca. He frees the mutants Essex torments and turns the mob on him, then hunts him for decades until Essex escapes as Mister Sinister.
stages.whoA: Essex, the old friend he hunts for decades
stages.whoB: Dr. James Xavier, the friend who hunts him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Years ago Vindicator and Heather took in the feral Logan and brought him into Alpha Flight. Now Vindicator lures him back and holds him for Department H, until Wolverine breaks free and spares him for Heather's sake.
stages.whoA: The old teammate he captures
stages.whoB: Alpha Flight's leader, who captures him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vindicator leads Alpha Flight in capturing Wolverine for Department H. When General Chasen orders Wolverine's skeleton cut out, the team turns on Chasen and helps Wolverine escape.
stages.whoA: The Department H team he leads
stages.whoB: Their leader

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Northstar flies with Vindicator's team to bring Wolverine back to Department H. He breaks with Vindicator when the team turns on General Chasen.
stages.whoA: Alpha Flight's leader
stages.whoB: One of his Alpha Flight team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Northstar and his twin carry the struggling Wolverine into the sky, begging their old teammate to stop fighting them. When Chasen orders him cut apart, Northstar joins Alpha Flight in helping him escape.
stages.whoA: The old teammate he captures, then helps
stages.whoB: Alpha Flight teammate who captures, then helps him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Northstar serves with Alpha Flight, Department H's team. With the others he captures Wolverine, then turns on General Chasen.
stages.whoA: The Canadian team he serves with
stages.whoB: One of the team's speedsters

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Moira left Xavier to marry Joe MacTaggert, and Joe left her because their son Kevin was a mutant. When Kevin escapes, she warns Joe, who cares only about his election, but in the end she watches him make peace with their son.
stages.whoA: His ex-wife, Kevin's mother
stages.whoB: Her ex-husband, Kevin's father

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kevin, the mutant Proteus, tears across Scotland looking for his father Joe, who abandoned him. Joe flees in horror when Kevin storms his rally, but after Xavier calms the boy, Joe asks his forgiveness.
stages.whoA: Kevin, the mutant son he abandoned
stages.whoB: His father, the politician who abandoned him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier and the X-Men set a watch on Joe MacTaggert as Proteus comes for him, and Xavier urges him to tell his son the truth. Joe brushes them off, but Xavier finally talks Kevin down and brings father and son together.
stages.whoA: Xavier, who reunites him with his son
stages.whoB: Moira's ex-husband, whom he protects

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In 1944 Paris, Justine sends Logan to rescue her father, Andre Cocteau, who seems to betray him. Fifty years later she finds Logan at her father's grave, tells him Andre was an Allied double agent, and takes him to dinner.
stages.whoA: Logan, the agent she sent after her father
stages.whoB: His French contact, Andre Cocteau's daughter

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kisara greets Logan at the village feast and later asks him to help stand up to the Silver Samurai's bandits. She reminds him of Master Oku's teaching, and he thanks her once the village is saved.
stages.whoA: Logan, who helps save her village
stages.whoB: Soichi's sister, who urges him to help

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Silver Samurai demands tribute from Kisara's village and burns Oku's temple. She pleads with Logan to help the villagers resist, and Logan humbles the Samurai.
stages.whoA: The bandit lord who preys on her village
stages.whoB: A villager who stands against him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kiyoek is among those who pull Wolverine from the Arctic sea, then grows jealous as the camp cheers the stranger. He leads Wolverine into Sabretooth's trap, but after the camp burns he follows him into the fight to make it right.
stages.whoA: The stranger he envies, then fights beside
stages.whoB: The jealous young man who leads him into a trap

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kiyoek takes Sabretooth for a snow demon and agrees to lure Wolverine away from the camp. Sabretooth burns the camp and takes its people instead, and Kiyoek joins the fight against him.
stages.whoA: The snow demon who uses him
stages.whoB: The young man he uses against Wolverine

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Darkstar serves the generals who wake Omega Red, but she protests as he dissolves the Parliament and ruins the towns. She turns against him and helps the X-Men and Colossus put him back on ice.
stages.whoA: The generals' living weapon she turns against
stages.whoB: The generals' agent who turns on him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Darkstar leaves the generals once she sees what Omega Red has done to her people. She fights beside Colossus to take back their country.
stages.whoA: The countryman she fights beside
stages.whoB: The generals' agent who joins his side

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Rogue meets Darkstar during the battle and asks who she is. Darkstar says she is a pawn of the old generals no longer and joins the X-Men against Omega Red.
stages.whoA: The X-Man she joins against Omega Red
stages.whoB: The Russian mutant who joins them

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Darkstar asks Storm whether she can command the cold that once held Omega Red. Storm whips up a blizzard and freezes him solid.
stages.whoA: The X-Man whose blizzard freezes Omega Red
stages.whoB: The Russian mutant who gives her the idea

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Corsair and the Starjammers protect Jandra, a witness against the Lord Chamberlain, from the corrupt Commander Raknar. Corsair says he saved her because he cares about her, and he exposes Raknar's plot to kill her.
stages.whoA: The Starjammer captain who protects her
stages.whoB: The witness he protects

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops sends Storm to find Jandra and keep her safe while he works out who is lying. Once he learns Raknar means to kill her, he sides with Corsair and the Starjammers.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who ends up protecting her
stages.whoB: The witness at the heart of the hunt

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cable once fought in the Leader's army, until he learned the Leader was no champion of democracy and took to the hills. Cable raids the Sentinel factory and stops the fleeing Leader just before the flood sweeps them both away.
stages.whoA: His former soldier, now the rebel hunting him
stages.whoB: The Genoshan ruler he served, then rose against

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gyrich, an old associate who still calls him Colonel, comes to Genosha to see Master Mold. He offers to have Cable eliminated in exchange for large numbers of the Leader's mutant control collars.
stages.whoA: An old associate bargaining for his collars
stages.whoB: Genosha's Leader, an old colonel he deals with

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Trask unveils Master Mold to the Leader and Gyrich in a factory on Genosha. The dam the Leader's mutant slaves are building is meant to power it.
stages.whoA: The scientist building Sentinels on his island
stages.whoB: Genosha's ruler, host to his Sentinel factory

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gambit is one of the mutants the Leader enslaves to build his dam. Brought before the Leader and Gyrich, Gambit promises to lead them to the X-Men, then escapes and frees the slaves.
stages.whoA: A mutant slave who fakes cooperation, then escapes
stages.whoB: The ruler who enslaves him on Genosha

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Callisto sends Leech to lure Cyclops into the Morlock tunnels, and later has him steal a device from Lady Deathstrike's lab. When Leech falls gravely ill at Christmas, Callisto demands that Storm help save him.
stages.whoA: The Morlock leader he serves
stages.whoB: A Morlock boy who runs her errands

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops tries to help Leech escape an angry mob, not knowing Callisto sent the boy to lure him underground. As thanks, Leech cancels Cyclops' powers so he can see without his visor.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he lured underground for Callisto
stages.whoB: The Morlock boy who cancelled his powers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Lady Deathstrike forces Leech to lure Wolverine into the Morlock tunnels with a message from Yuriko. At Christmas, Wolverine gives his blood in a transfusion that saves Leech's life.
stages.whoA: The X-Man whose blood saved his life
stages.whoB: The Morlock boy he saved with his blood

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Leech steals a device from Lady Deathstrike's lab for Callisto, and she catches him. She makes him carry a message that lures Wolverine into her trap.
stages.whoA: The cyborg who caught him and used him as bait
stages.whoB: The Morlock thief she uses as bait

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Marianna stays close while her best friend Leech lies gravely ill at Christmas. Wolverine's blood brings him back, and Jubilee tells her he is okay.
stages.whoA: His best friend among the Morlock children
stages.whoB: Her best friend, who falls gravely ill

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Magneto rescues Leech from a hostile crew in the sewers and promises he will never be afraid again. On Genosha, Leech holds on to that promise as the Sentinels attack.
stages.whoA: The mutant who saved him in the sewers
stages.whoB: A Morlock boy he saved and promised to protect

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Domo serves Mojo with endless flowery titles, putting up with his rants and suggesting the X-Men as his new stars. Later he backs the plan for Mojo to lead an expedition to Earth after Longshot.
stages.whoA: The ranting showman he serves
stages.whoB: His deadpan right-hand man

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Marianna asks Jubilee whether Leech will be okay, and Jubilee asks her if she believes in miracles. She invites Jubilee to share the Morlocks' Christmas, and Jubilee tells her when Leech pulls through.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who stays with her through Christmas
stages.whoB: A Morlock girl she comforts at Christmas

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sunder serves Callisto, carrying the captured Cyclops and Jean into the tunnels on her orders and fighting the X-Men until Storm beats her. He stays with her Morlocks afterward.
stages.whoA: The Morlock leader he serves
stages.whoB: Her Morlock strongman

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When the X-Men storm the Morlock tunnels, Sunder dares Rogue to come down and fight him fair. Rogue takes him on and gets the better of him.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who beats him in a fair fight
stages.whoB: A Morlock strongman she takes down

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Callisto's orders, Sunder takes the unconscious Cyclops and Jean below into the Morlock tunnels. Cyclops is freed when Storm wins her duel with Callisto.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he dragged into the tunnels
stages.whoB: The Morlock who carried him below

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Martha is Jubilee's foster mother, uneasy when her husband registers the girl with the Mutant Control Agency. After the X-Men rescue her, Jubilee says goodbye to her foster parents and moves into Xavier's school.
stages.whoA: Her foster daughter, a young mutant
stages.whoB: Her foster mother

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops visits Martha's home looking for Jubilee and tells her the girl was likely taken by Sentinels. She passes this on, and her husband warns Cyclops that Gyrich is on his way.
stages.whoA: The X-Man searching for her foster daughter
stages.whoB: Jubilee's foster mother

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mentor pulls Wolverine away from Arkon's robot guards and asks for his help freeing the Belganian slaves. Wolverine joins the rescue and the resistance hides the X-Men in its caverns.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who helps him free his people
stages.whoB: Leader of the Belganian resistance

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast fights beside Mentor's resistance to free Arkon's slaves and is wounded in the escape. In the caverns, Mentor shows him and the X-Men the tower behind Arkon's police state.
stages.whoA: The X-Man wounded helping free his people
stages.whoB: Leader of the Belganian resistance

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag serves in Mister Sinister's Nasty Boys, helping capture Cyclops and Jean and fighting the X-Men in the Savage Land. He later helps snatch Jean from her wedding for Sinister.
stages.whoA: The master of his Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: One of his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag helps the Nasty Boys collar Cyclops and Jean on their honeymoon island for Sinister. The gang strikes again at their wedding and carries Jean off.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he helps capture
stages.whoB: A brawler in Sinister's Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag helps the Nasty Boys capture Jean and Cyclops on their honeymoon for Sinister. When they marry, the Nasty Boys crash the wedding and take Jean.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he helps snatch for Sinister
stages.whoB: A brawler in Sinister's Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Shaman calls Wolverine his friend even as Alpha Flight hunts him down for Department H. Once the team learns what Department H wants, Shaman helps set Wolverine free.
stages.whoA: His old friend who left Alpha Flight
stages.whoB: The Alpha Flight mystic who calls him friend

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Storm breathed life into MjNari as a newborn and became his godmother. When the Shadow King possesses him, Storm offers her own body to free him, and together they drive the villain back into the astral plane.
stages.whoA: His godmother, who breathed life into him
stages.whoB: Her godson in Africa

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Shadow King possesses MjNari and lays waste to the villages. Freed, MjNari lures him back into the tear in the astral plane before it seals.
stages.whoA: The psychic who possessed him
stages.whoB: A boy he possesses in Africa

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: MjNari catches Rogue when the possessed Storm knocks her out of the sky. Rogue and Storm then save him as the tear in the astral plane seals.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he catches as she falls
stages.whoB: Storm's godson, who catches her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Toad helps Solarr hold Skull Mesa and taunts the powerless Cyclops, whose friend Dr. Prescott he keeps frozen in resin. Cyclops rallies the townsfolk, who turn on Solarr's gang.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who breaks Solarr's hold on the town
stages.whoB: A resin-wielding thug in Solarr's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bender finds Bishop lost in the Axis of Time and leads him around with riddles and jokes, showing him glimpses of the X-Men and Cable. His hints help Bishop free the captive psychics and stop Apocalypse.
stages.whoA: The babbling janitor who guides him through time
stages.whoB: The lost time traveler he guides

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar leaves the captive Cyclops in Navigator's care, and she shows him a faked ship's log proving Raknar means to kill the witness Jandra. The truth turns Cyclops against Raknar.
stages.whoA: The X-Man she shows the truth about Raknar
stages.whoB: Raknar's navigator, who exposes his plot

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Navigator turned to Corsair for help, trusting him to save the witness Jandra from Raknar. Her proof helps Corsair's son Cyclops see that his father told the truth.
stages.whoA: The Starjammer she asked to save Jandra
stages.whoB: A Shi'ar officer who asked him to save Jandra

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Logan returns to rural Japan and helps his old teacher Master Oku build a temple. Oku tells him peace comes with purpose and urges him to see himself through new eyes, and Logan ends up defending the village from the Silver Samurai.
stages.whoA: The former student who helps him build a temple
stages.whoB: His old spiritual teacher in Japan

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Silver Samurai's men demand tribute from the village, and Master Oku is trapped when smoke pours from his temple. When they come back, Oku steps out and dares the warriors to attack him instead.
stages.whoA: Bandit leader whose men threaten his village
stages.whoB: Monk who stands up to his men

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Erik the Red, posing as the Eagle One crew's host, gasses the Starcore's crew and has Dr. Corbeau brought to his control room. Corbeau begs the stowaway X-Men to stop him from destroying the alien ship.
stages.whoA: Shi'ar agent who takes him prisoner on Eagle One
stages.whoB: Shuttle scientist he takes prisoner

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast knows of Dr. Corbeau's solar vortex study, and Corbeau is stunned to find Hank McCoy aboard his shuttle. Beast and Jean then set out to rescue him from Erik the Red.
stages.whoA: X-Man who stows away to save him
stages.whoB: Starcore scientist he helps rescue

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Jean senses the trap on Eagle One and warns Dr. Corbeau back to the shuttle. When the autopilot fails, she absorbs his flight training to fly it home and rises from the crash as Phoenix.
stages.whoA: X-Man who warns him of the trap on Eagle One
stages.whoB: Scientist whose shuttle she flies home

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pierre calls Remy at Xavier's school because Bobby is missing on the night of the tithe. He meets Gambit in the swamp and goes with him to the Assassins to make the trade.
stages.whoA: Old guild friend he calls home for help
stages.whoB: Thieves Guild friend who calls him home

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Pierre stands with Bobby among the mourners at Gambit's funeral. Nightcrawler gives the eulogy as the X-Men lay Gambit to rest.
stages.whoA: Old guild friend whose funeral he attends
stages.whoB: Thieves Guild friend at his funeral

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pierre raises the alarm when Bobby is taken by the Assassins on the night of the tithe. Gambit and Pierre win Bobby back, and the Thieves return to their base together.
stages.whoA: Guild leader he helps rescue
stages.whoB: Fellow Thief who helps get him back

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Believing Magneto killed their mother, Quicksilver and Wanda lure him into a trap, and the High Evolutionary reveals that Magneto is their father. Later the Phalanx takes Pietro, and Magneto joins the fight to save him, greeting him with relief once he is free.
stages.whoA: His father, whom he first blames for his mother's death
stages.whoB: His son, one of the Maximoff twins

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Forge introduces Quicksilver as part of his government team X-Factor when they meet the X-Men. Quicksilver is with Forge's group when the Phalanx strikes and takes him.
stages.whoA: Leader of his X-Factor team
stages.whoB: Speedster on his X-Factor team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast meets Quicksilver and Forge to warn them of the Phalanx, and Pietro doubts the story until the aliens ambush them. Beast then works to free him and the others from the Phalanx.
stages.whoA: X-Man who warns him of the Phalanx
stages.whoB: X-Factor speedster he helps save

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Apocalypse turns the mutants who come to Muir Island for a cure into his Horsemen and names Pestilence among his agents of destruction. When the X-Men beat the Horsemen, he calls them unworthy.
stages.whoA: Master who remakes her as his Horseman
stages.whoB: One of his Horsemen

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Under Callisto's orders, the fever-touch Morlock helps kidnap Cyclops and Jean and fights the X-Men. Back among the Morlocks at Christmas, she is there when Callisto takes back the leadership.
stages.whoA: Leader of the Morlocks
stages.whoB: One of her Morlocks

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In the Morlock tunnels the fever-touch Morlock fights the X-Men until Storm beats Callisto in a duel. As Pestilence she comes at the X-Men in Paris, and Storm's fog throws her from her horse.
stages.whoA: X-Man whose fog throws her from her horse
stages.whoB: Morlock and Horseman she fights twice

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In the Morlock fight she lays hands on Gambit and gives him a fever, mocking him that he has a touch of the plague. Storm sends Rogue to get him back to the mansion.
stages.whoA: X-Man she strikes down with a fever
stages.whoB: Morlock who gives him a fever

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pestilence and War are among the mutants Apocalypse remakes as his Horsemen. They attack the peace conference in Paris together and fall to the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Fellow Horseman of Apocalypse
stages.whoB: Fellow Horseman of Apocalypse

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pooyetah takes the half-frozen Wolverine into his tent and later sees him become the camp's hero. When Sabretooth takes the villagers hostage, Wolverine saves them, and Pooyetah calls him friend.
stages.whoA: Stranger he nurses back to health
stages.whoB: Inuit elder who saves him from the ice

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sabretooth tracks Wolverine to the fishing camp, destroys it and ties Pooyetah and the others to an ice bridge rigged to blow. Wolverine beats him and frees them.
stages.whoA: Mutant who wrecks his camp and takes him hostage
stages.whoB: Elder he takes hostage on the glacier

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Quark corners Wolverine until he is asked whether he would rather be the man who defeated Longshot. He goes after Longshot instead and is quickly knocked out.
stages.whoA: Star he wants to be known for beating
stages.whoB: Rival in Mojo's crew he knocks out

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Quark is one of the crew Mojo brings to Earth for his televised hunt of the X-Men. When the broadcast is wrecked, the crew heads home with Mojo.
stages.whoA: Master he serves on the hunt
stages.whoB: One of his crew

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Quark gets the drop on Wolverine during Mojo's hunt, but turns away to chase Longshot. Wolverine shrugs it off, saying he heals fast.
stages.whoA: X-Man he attacks during Mojo's hunt
stages.whoB: One of Mojo's warriors

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar hunts Corsair across the galaxy and brands him a kidnapper, while Corsair says Raknar is a bad cop. Raknar captures Corsair and admits he was hired to kill the witness, before the Starjammers turn the tables.
stages.whoA: Pirate he hunts to Earth
stages.whoB: Shi'ar officer hunting him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar convinces Cyclops that Corsair is after a fortune, and Cyclops turns his father in. Once the truth comes out, Cyclops helps take Raknar down.
stages.whoA: X-Man he tricks into turning on Corsair
stages.whoB: Shi'ar commander who tricks him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raza and the Starjammers hide the witness Jandra from Raknar's patrol. They rejoin Corsair to defeat Raknar's ship.
stages.whoA: Starjammer protecting the witness he hunts
stages.whoB: Shi'ar commander hunting their crew

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raza takes Corsair's orders aboard the Starjammer and fires the stun ray on the X-Men when told. Later he helps keep the witness Jandra safe while Raknar holds Corsair.
stages.whoA: His captain
stages.whoB: One of his Starjammers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Nathaniel Essex tries to cure his wife Rebecca and secretly treats her with his experiments. When the mob drives him home, she sees the monster he has made of himself and runs from him.
stages.whoA: Her husband, whose cure turns him into a monster
stages.whoB: His sick wife, whom he tries to cure

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Brother Reinhard thinks his fellow monk Nightcrawler is a demon and leads the townspeople up to burn him out. Nightcrawler spares him in the flames, and Reinhard repents.
stages.whoA: Fellow monk he takes for a demon
stages.whoB: Brother monk who turns the town on him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Spiral works Mojo's studio, showing his captive X-Men to the set and pushing the applause button. She later opens the way for his trip to Earth and he calls on her to get him out when the hunt goes wrong.
stages.whoA: Master she produces shows for
stages.whoB: His assistant and producer

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Spiral helps run Mojo's deadly video game for Jubilee and Roberto. Mojo snaps at her to patch the bug that keeps helping them.
stages.whoA: Master whose game she runs
stages.whoB: Assistant he scolds over a bug

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Longshot quits Mojo, he makes Spiral send the captive X-Men home. On Earth she leads the hunt for him, and he admits they used to date.
stages.whoA: Rebel star she hunts, and an old flame
stages.whoB: Mojo's aide and his old flame

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Spiral's warriors chase Longshot when Jubilee runs into him on a driving lesson. Jubilee later ends up in Mojo's hands before the X-Men rescue her.
stages.whoA: Young X-Man caught up in Mojo's hunt
stages.whoB: Mojo's aide hunting Longshot

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Spiral helps keep Jubilee trapped in Mojo's deadly video game. A bug keeps giving Jubilee and Roberto extra lives, and Spiral cannot stop it.
stages.whoA: Player trapped in Mojo's game
stages.whoB: Mojo's aide running the game

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier's X-Men save Senator Kelly from Magneto and Master Mold, and Kelly comes to defend good mutants. As president he weighs a strike on Asteroid M while Xavier warns him against it.
stages.whoA: Mutant leader whose X-Men save his life
stages.whoB: Senator, then president, his X-Men protect

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Xavier asks President Kelly to let him reason with Magneto, and Kelly blames him for leaving his legacy to a lunatic. Xavier reminds him they have been here before and asks him to trust the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Mutant leader he trusts against Magneto
stages.whoB: President who lets his X-Men act

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Senator Kelly arranges Beast's bail, and his first act as president is a full pardon for him. Later the Phalanx uses Kelly's emergency line to lure Beast into a trap.
stages.whoA: X-Man he pardons as president
stages.whoB: Senator, then president, who frees him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Magneto kidnaps Senator Kelly to a sunken ship to kill him and start a war, until Sentinels snatch Kelly away. As president, Kelly faces Magneto's armed Asteroid M.
stages.whoA: Mutant who kidnaps him to start a war
stages.whoB: Senator he kidnaps to kill

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops leads the mission to rescue Senator Kelly from Master Mold, and Jean and Cyclops get him out alive.
stages.whoA: X-Man who leads his rescue
stages.whoB: Senator he rescues from Master Mold

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: After Genosha, Cyclops asks President Kelly for more help finding survivors. Kelly refuses, citing scared voters, and tells him to be patient.
stages.whoA: X-Man whose plea for help he refuses
stages.whoB: President who refuses him help

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mystique, posing as Gambit, tries to assassinate Senator Kelly at his Senate hearing to frame the X-Men. The real Gambit stops her.
stages.whoA: Shapeshifter who tries to kill him
stages.whoB: Senator she tries to assassinate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Assassins seize Bobby to force his brother Remy home, and Remy blames Bobby for making him a Thief. Gambit trades himself to get Bobby and the tithe back.
stages.whoA: His brother Remy, the X-Man Gambit
stages.whoB: His brother, who made him a Thief

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: Bobby mourns his brother at the funeral. Later Gambit returns from the dead, invites the guilds home and bends Bobby's mind, until Rogue frees them.
stages.whoA: His brother, back from the dead
stages.whoB: Brother whose mind he bends

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops catches Rusty after a fire at the orphanage and tells him his power takes time to learn. Rusty warns him that Killgrave is bad news, and Cyclops later breaks Killgrave's hold on him.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who believed him at the orphanage
stages.whoB: An orphan he helped free from Killgrave

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sarah runs the orphanage where Rusty lived and sends him back to Killgrave, not believing his warnings. She then helps Cyclops free Rusty and the other children.
stages.whoA: The woman who runs his orphanage
stages.whoB: An orphan from her home, taken by Killgrave

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Scott returns to his old orphanage and finds his childhood friend Sarah running it. Together they expose Killgrave and save the children, and she offers him a home, but he goes back to the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Her childhood friend from the orphanage, Scott
stages.whoB: His childhood friend who runs the orphanage

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Rogue visits Sam in Kentucky as Ms. LeBeau and learns of Kirkland's offer. She fights Kirkland's troops in his hometown, and Sam thanks her for looking out for him.
stages.whoA: Rogue, who came to look out for him
stages.whoB: A young Kentucky mutant she looked out for

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier and Beast come to Cumberland to find Sam before Kirkland does. Xavier offers him a home at the school, but Sam stays with his family.
stages.whoA: Xavier, who offered him a place at the school
stages.whoB: A young mutant he offered a home

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In 1944 Paris, Captain Sawyer briefs Logan on rescuing Cocteau from the Chateau du Mort. He tells Logan to call him Captain, not Happy, and pairs him with Captain America.
stages.whoA: Logan, the agent he sent to the chateau
stages.whoB: The captain who sent him to the Chateau du Mort

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Senator Goode chairs the plague hearing and calls Beast to testify. When the attack breaks out in the chamber, he orders security to clear the room.
stages.whoA: The scientist he called to testify
stages.whoB: The senator who called him to testify

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Graydon Creed blames mutants for the plague before Senator Goode's committee. Goode cuts him off and calls Beast to the stand instead.
stages.whoA: An anti-mutant witness he cut off
stages.whoB: The senator who cut him off

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Shani tells Storm her son Mjnari has changed, and recalls how Storm, then living in the village, breathed life into him at birth. Storm drives the Shadow King out of him and brings him back to her.
stages.whoA: Storm, her son's godmother
stages.whoB: The mother of her godson Mjnari

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Shadow King takes over Shani's son Mjnari to lure Storm back to the village. Storm and Rogue force him back into the astral plane.
stages.whoA: The being who took over her son
stages.whoB: The mother of the boy he possessed

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ka-Zar fights to free his wife Shanna, a prisoner in Sinister's citadel. She signals and distracts a guard, and he frees her and the other captives.
stages.whoA: Her husband, Ka-Zar
stages.whoB: His wife, Shanna

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sauron hunts Shanna down in the Savage Land and carries her off. Ka-Zar later learns she is a prisoner in the citadel.
stages.whoA: The winged creature who carried her off
stages.whoB: A Savage Land woman he carried off

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Genosha, Jubilee rallies Sunfire and the other slaves to rush the guards, and the plan fails. Once the collars are off, they fight their way free together.
stages.whoA: The girl who rallied the slaves
stages.whoB: A fellow slave on Genosha

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sunfire slaves on the Genoshan dam alongside Gambit. Gambit then shuts off the collars, and Sunfire cries out that they can use their powers.
stages.whoA: The Cajun who freed the slaves' powers
stages.whoB: A mutant slave he freed on Genosha

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: After Xavier is attacked, Sunfire calls for war and joins the mutants on Genosha who beg Magneto to lead them. Magneto calls off the attack when he learns Xavier is dying.
stages.whoA: The leader he rallied behind on Genosha
stages.whoB: One of the mutants in his Genosha army

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Silver Fox sends Logan the photo that brings him to the old lab, where they find their memories were faked. He insists their cabin was real, but she says goodbye.
stages.whoA: Logan, the man she loved
stages.whoB: His lost love, Fox

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Silver Fox and Sabretooth, old comrades from the lab, search it for answers with Logan and Maverick. They open the sealed chamber together and fight Talos.
stages.whoA: An old comrade from the lab
stages.whoB: An old comrade, Fox

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast finds the lab's video records that explain the faked memories to Silver Fox and the others. He readies the mini jet for their escape.
stages.whoA: Logan's friend, Mr. McCoy
stages.whoB: Logan's old love, Ms. Fox

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Opening the sealed chamber sets off Talos, which tries to capture Silver Fox and the others for reprogramming. They destroy it.
stages.whoA: The robot sent to reprogram her
stages.whoB: One of the subjects it hunted

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Soichi calls Logan a coward for staying out of the fight. Logan then backs him, the village fights the bandits, and Logan beats the Silver Samurai.
stages.whoA: Logan, the gaijin who fought for the village
stages.whoB: The young villager who stood up to the bandits

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Soichi refuses to pay the Silver Samurai's tribute and leads the village against his bandits. The Samurai turns on him until Logan steps in.
stages.whoA: The bandit lord who extorts his village
stages.whoB: The villager who defied him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mystique calls Pyro to Muir Island, where his kidnapping of the fake Dr. Adler exposes her. Later he and the Brotherhood act as her diversion in the Kelly plot and at a hospital.
stages.whoA: The shape-shifter he works for
stages.whoB: One of her Brotherhood

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pyro flirts with Rogue in a Muir Island pub and a fight breaks out, and later she beats him and Avalanche. They clash again at the Capitol, and later she spots his gang looting a market.
stages.whoA: Rogue, who keeps beating him
stages.whoB: A Brotherhood firebug she fights

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Searching Muir Island for Avalanche, Pyro runs into Cable, who is also hunting Dr. Adler. Both go after the scientist for their own ends.
stages.whoA: Cable, his rival for Dr. Adler
stages.whoB: A Brotherhood mutant also after Dr. Adler

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bishop fights the Brotherhood at the Capitol during the plot against Senator Kelly. He turns Avalanche's power back on them, and Pyro flees.
stages.whoA: The time traveler who drove him off
stages.whoB: A Brotherhood mutant he drove off

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Starbolt is part of the Imperial Guard that D'Ken sends against the Starjammers. The Guard fights for him until he takes the M'Kraan Crystal.
stages.whoA: His emperor, D'Ken
stages.whoB: One of his Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Empress Lilandra sends the Imperial Guard to fight the X-Men on the Moon for the Phoenix. Starbolt fights in her name.
stages.whoA: His empress, Lilandra
stages.whoB: One of her Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On the Moon, Starbolt boasts that his rage is feared across the empire and chases Rogue. She taunts him and slips away.
stages.whoA: Rogue, who taunts him on the Moon
stages.whoB: A hot-headed guardsman she taunted

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Starbolt and Oracle serve together in the Imperial Guard. They fight the Starjammers for D'Ken and the X-Men on the Moon.
stages.whoA: A fellow Imperial Guard
stages.whoB: A fellow Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Oracle serves in the Imperial Guard that D'Ken sends against the Starjammers and the X-Men. The Guard fights for him until he takes the M'Kraan Crystal.
stages.whoA: Her emperor, D'Ken
stages.whoB: One of his Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Oracle fights for Lilandra on the Moon and later warns her of Deathbird's attack on the palace. Lilandra then asks Xavier for help when Apocalypse takes Oracle.
stages.whoA: Her empress, Lilandra
stages.whoB: One of her psychics

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Apocalypse helps Deathbird attack Lilandra's palace only to carry off Oracle. He holds her with other psychics to remake time, until the X-Men free them.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, who abducted her
stages.whoB: A Shi'ar psychic he kidnapped

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Takaki rides with the Silver Samurai's bikers, who collect his tribute from the village. When the village refuses, the Samurai orders it destroyed.
stages.whoA: The bandit lord he rides for
stages.whoB: One of his bikers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Soichi refuses to pay the tribute, Takaki threatens him and is held back. Soichi then leads the village against the bikers' raid.
stages.whoA: The villager who defied him
stages.whoB: A biker who threatened him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Logan joins the villagers against the Silver Samurai's bikers when they raid. The bandits are beaten and the Samurai is humbled.
stages.whoA: The gaijin who beat his gang
stages.whoB: One of the Samurai's bikers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Talos wakes when Logan's group opens the sealed chamber and tries to capture them. Logan tears open its back so Maverick can blow it up.
stages.whoA: A Weapon X subject it hunted
stages.whoB: The failsafe robot at the lab

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Talos tries to capture Sabretooth with the others for reprogramming. Sabretooth fights it with a blaster.
stages.whoA: A Weapon X subject it hunted
stages.whoB: The failsafe robot at the lab

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Talos attacks while Beast works to open the lab's doors. Beast helps fight it off.
stages.whoA: Logan's friend, Mr. McCoy
stages.whoB: The failsafe robot at the lab

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Deathbird leads Starbolt and the Imperial Guard onto Ronan's warship in the war with the Kree. The Guard routs the Kree soldiers while she beats Ronan herself.
stages.whoA: Deathbird, who leads the Guard against the Kree
stages.whoB: One of the Imperial Guard she leads against the Kree

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Years ago Dr. Prescott defends the young Scott from bullies and takes him for ice cream. Scott comes to Skull Mesa to find him, learns Solarr has paralyzed him, and the town's uprising sets him free.
stages.whoA: Scott Summers, the boy he once looked after
stages.whoB: His old friend, the founder of Skull Mesa

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Tusk tells Cyclops that Doc Prescott once got him out of a real jam. With Prescott paralyzed by Solarr, Tusk joins the townsfolk who throw Solarr out, and Prescott is revived.
stages.whoA: A Skull Mesa mechanic he once helped
stages.whoB: Doc Prescott, who once helped him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Dr. Essex keeps Flannery locked up as a test subject and shows off his fire to the Royal Society. When James Xavier frees the prisoners, Flannery flees and the mob turns on Essex.
stages.whoA: Dr. Essex, who held him captive
stages.whoB: One of his mutant test subjects

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bishop and Shard chase Fitzroy to 1959 but fail to stop him killing Xavier. In the changed future Fitzroy hands Bishop a tape, and his warning lets the travelers save Xavier.
stages.whoA: The time traveler who chases him
stages.whoB: The mutant traitor who kills Xavier

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Fitzroy plants a bomb that kills the young Xavier in 1959. On the second try, warned that Master Mold will betray him, Fitzroy spares him.
stages.whoA: The man he is sent to kill
stages.whoB: The assassin sent to kill him in 1959

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine and Storm join Bishop's hunt for Fitzroy and fight him and Nimrod in 1959. They fail, then return and keep Xavier alive until Fitzroy backs down.
stages.whoA: One of the time travelers who hunt him
stages.whoB: The assassin he tries to stop

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Master Mold sends Fitzroy and Bantam to 1959 with the Sentinel Nimrod to make sure he kills Xavier. Once the job is done, Master Mold orders Nimrod to kill them both.
stages.whoA: Master Mold and Nimrod, who hire and betray him
stages.whoB: Their mutant assassin

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Professor has adamantium bonded to Logan's skeleton, and Logan breaks loose. Years later Logan finds his tapes and learns his memories were faked.
stages.whoA: Logan, his first adamantium subject
stages.whoB: The Professor who turned him into a weapon

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Professor's tapes tell Sabretooth that his memories were planted and that he was next for the adamantium process. His recorded message sets the robot Talos on him and Logan.
stages.whoA: One of his conditioned test subjects
stages.whoB: The Professor who faked his memories

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops asks Tusk for help against Solarr, but Tusk is afraid for his wife and children. When Solarr tries to make an example of Cyclops, Tusk joins the townsfolk who turn on him.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who asks him for help
stages.whoB: A Skull Mesa mechanic who finally stands up

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Tyler cries out for his father as their future starts to vanish, and Cable finds him safe once the plague is stopped. Grown up, Tyler fights Apocalypse beside Cable and helps him steal a time machine, then stays behind.
stages.whoA: His father, Cable
stages.whoB: His son, Tyler

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Tyler joins his father's attack on Apocalypse's pyramid in 3999. After Apocalypse steals Cable's time device, Tyler helps him go after him in the past.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, the tyrant of his time
stages.whoB: One of Cable's fighters

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo brings the captive Xavier and Magneto to her master Sinister in the Savage Land. Later, in Sinister's crew, she helps kidnap Jean and fights for him at the Axis of Time.
stages.whoA: Sinister, her master
stages.whoB: One of his followers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In the Savage Land Vertigo overwhelms Xavier and Magneto and takes them to Sinister. She fights again when the X-Men break into Sinister's base.
stages.whoA: A captive she takes to Sinister
stages.whoB: A Savage Land mutant who captures him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo tries to force Wolverine to his knees in the Savage Land, but he gets away. She fights the X-Men again when Sinister's crew kidnaps Jean.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who escapes her power
stages.whoB: A mutant who makes his head spin

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo is one of Sinister's crew who snatch Jean after her wedding. She turns her power on the X-Men when they come for Jean.
stages.whoA: The bride she helps kidnap
stages.whoB: One of her kidnappers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sasquatch helps Alpha Flight bring their old teammate Wolverine back to Department H. When General Chasen orders Wolverine's skeleton removed, Sasquatch and the team turn on the general.
stages.whoA: His old Alpha Flight teammate
stages.whoB: An old Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wanda and Pietro lure Magneto into a trap to avenge their mother, until the High Evolutionary reveals that Magneto is their father. They fight together to escape, and Wanda leaves unsure if she can forgive him.
stages.whoA: Magneto, the father she never knew
stages.whoB: His daughter, the Scarlet Witch

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Warlock saves Beast from the Phalanx and asks for his help to find his Lifemate. Together they make a virus, and Warlock calls him Self-friend Hank before carrying it into the Phalanx core.
stages.whoA: Self-friend Hank, who helps him
stages.whoB: A Phalanx rebel he befriends

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Forge works with Warlock and Beast against the Phalanx. At the end Warlock asks Self-friends Hank and Forge to help him build a ship home.
stages.whoA: A Self-friend who helps him
stages.whoB: An alien ally against the Phalanx

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Warlock flees the Phalanx rather than merge with it, and it follows him to Earth and takes his Lifemate. He lets the Phalanx take him so the virus reaches its core.
stages.whoA: The hive mind he fled
stages.whoB: Its runaway heir

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Solarr's order Watchdog brings down Cyclops' plane, cuts off his powers and jams his signal. When the town turns on Solarr, Watchdog salvages a transmitter and calls the X-Men in.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he shoots down
stages.whoB: Solarr's guard who later calls for help

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In Jubilee's fairy tale, the wizard Xavier appears to the warrior Jubilee after she wins a piece of the MacTaggert Crystal. He tells her she is the key to its power once the two halves are joined.
stages.whoA: The warrior he tells of the crystal
stages.whoB: The wizard who guides her quest

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Yoshida welcomes Logan to the village since Master Oku has. He wants the village to keep paying tribute, but Logan backs the villagers who fight and beats the Silver Samurai.
stages.whoA: Logan, the outsider Oku welcomes
stages.whoB: The village elder

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Silver Samurai's men demand tribute from Yoshida's village and mock him for not controlling his people. When the villagers rise up, Logan beats the Samurai.
stages.whoA: The bandit lord his village pays
stages.whoB: The elder of a village he squeezes

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Zaladane saves Sauron from Ka-Zar and tells him to fetch Storm for her power. Once Garokk wakes, she refuses Sauron's orders and Garokk turns on him.
stages.whoA: The tool she uses to free Garokk
stages.whoB: The priestess who sends him for Storm

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Zaladane has Sauron bring Storm to the Savage Land and helps strip away her self-control. Storm's unleashed power wakes Garokk.
stages.whoA: The weather witch she uses
stages.whoB: The priestess who unleashes her

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Dr. Rao welcomes Secretary McCoy to Worthington Labs on Alcatraz and introduces him to Jimmy, the boy behind the cure. Later she warns that Hank's politics sit at odds with his own nature.
stages.whoA: The Secretary of Mutant Affairs who tours her lab
stages.whoB: The scientist who shows him the cure's source

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Dr. Rao keeps Jimmy at Worthington Labs on Alcatraz until his DNA is mapped, since his genes are the source of the cure. She brings Hank McCoy in to meet him.
stages.whoA: The boy whose genes make the cure
stages.whoB: The scientist who keeps him at the lab

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Trask and Hank sit with the President as Trask reports Mystique's capture at the FDA. Hank later resigns over the cure weapons while Trask leads the hunt for Magneto.
stages.whoA: The Secretary of Mutant Affairs
stages.whoB: A fellow secretary hunting Magneto

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Mystique is caught breaking into the FDA while posing as Secretary Trask. After Magneto abandons her, she tells the government where his camp is, and Trask sends troops in.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who posed as him
stages.whoB: The secretary she impersonated

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Lyman leads Stryker's soldiers at Alkali Lake and reports that the Cerebro machine is finished. When he asks why the children are being held, Stryker brushes him off, then posts him and his men at the Cerebro door.
stages.whoA: The colonel he serves
stages.whoB: His sergeant at Alkali Lake

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Lyman and Yuriko both serve Stryker at Alkali Lake. They stand at his side as his operation runs.
stages.whoA: Stryker's silent enforcer
stages.whoB: Stryker's sergeant

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Lyman and his men guard the door to Cerebro with orders to shoot anyone who comes near. Magneto pulls the pins from their grenades and kills them all.
stages.whoA: The mutant who kills him at Cerebro's door
stages.whoB: The sergeant guarding Cerebro

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Laurio guards Magneto in his plastic prison and taunts him. After Mystique fills Laurio's blood with iron, Magneto pulls it out of his body to break free.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he guards and taunts
stages.whoB: His taunting prison guard

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Mystique, calling herself Grace, picks Laurio up at a bar and drugs him. She injects him with iron so Magneto can use it to escape.
stages.whoA: The woman who drugs him at a bar
stages.whoB: The guard she drugs to free Magneto

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Bobby brings Logan, Rogue and John home and tells his family he is a mutant. Jealous and upset, Ronny calls the police, and Bobby realizes it was him before he leaves with the others.
stages.whoA: His older brother, a mutant
stages.whoB: His younger brother, who calls the police

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Ronny comes home to find Logan in the house, introduced as Professor Logan. His call brings the police, and an officer shoots Logan during the standoff.
stages.whoA: The stranger his call brings the police on
stages.whoB: Bobby's brother, who calls the police

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Asad and Nyssa duel Blade to test him, then Asad gives his name and offers the Vampire Nation's truce. Asad then fights the Reapers in the Bloodpack under Blade's command.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker he tests and then follows
stages.whoB: Vampire envoy, then Bloodpack ally

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Asad and Nyssa bring Blade the truce together and duel him side by side. They hunt Reapers in the Bloodpack until Asad falls beside her in the sewers.
stages.whoA: Fellow envoy and Bloodpack warrior
stages.whoB: Fellow envoy, killed in the sewers

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Asad speaks for the Vampire Nation that Damaskinos rules and brings Blade before him. Damaskinos sends the Bloodpack after the Reapers, ready to sacrifice every one of them.
stages.whoA: The overlord he serves
stages.whoB: His envoy to Blade

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa and Priest serve in the Bloodpack together. When a Reaper bites Priest, he begs Chupa to kill him, and Chupa holds him as he turns. Chupa vows to make Whistler pay for losing him.
stages.whoA: His friend, lost to a Reaper bite
stages.whoB: The friend he begs to end it

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa trades insults with Whistler and blames him for leaving his post when Priest dies. In the sewers Chupa beats Whistler, who sets off Reaper pheromones and leaves Chupa to the Reapers.
stages.whoA: The old man he blames for Priest
stages.whoB: Bloodpack thug who attacks him

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa trained to kill Blade and cheers Reinhardt on when Blade dares the Bloodpack to try. Under the truce he takes Blade's orders against the Reapers, but never hides his contempt.
stages.whoA: The quarry he must follow
stages.whoB: Hostile Bloodpack vampire

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa and Reinhardt are the Bloodpack's loudest brawlers. They fight the Reapers at the House of Pain and both try to put Priest down when he turns.
stages.whoA: Fellow Bloodpack brawler
stages.whoB: Fellow Bloodpack brawler

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Lighthammer and Verlaine are lovers in the Bloodpack. He hides a Reaper bite from the House of Pain and turns in the sewers, and Verlaine ends them both in the sunlight.
stages.whoA: His lover, who dies with him
stages.whoB: Her lover, who turns Reaper

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Lighthammer joins Blade's hunt with the Bloodpack and fights the Reapers at the House of Pain. He keeps his bite secret from Blade until it turns him in the sewers.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker leading his hunt
stages.whoB: Bloodpack vampire who hides a bite

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Priest hunts the Reapers in the Bloodpack under Blade. When the bite turns him and nothing else works, Blade lets the sunlight in to end him.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker who ends his suffering
stages.whoB: Bloodpack vampire he puts down

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Priest and Reinhardt serve in the Bloodpack together. When Priest turns, Reinhardt cuts into his skull, but only sunlight can finish him.
stages.whoA: Bloodpack comrade
stages.whoB: Bloodpack comrade lost to a bite

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Verlaine joins Blade's hunt with the Bloodpack. In the sewers she stops her turned lover, Lighthammer, by taking him into the sunlight.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker leading her hunt
stages.whoB: Bloodpack vampire, Lighthammer's lover

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Blade catches Rush and makes him get him into the place where Whistler is held, then lets him go. Later in London, Blade waits behind a peep show window and kills him.
stages.whoA: The hunter who spares him, then returns
stages.whoB: Vampire informant he comes back for

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: After Drake wipes out the Nightstalkers' hideout, Caulder introduces himself and drives Blade to a hidden refuge. There he hands over the last Daystar, built into one arrow.
stages.whoA: The hunter he arms with Daystar
stages.whoB: Nightstalker with the last Daystar

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Caulder picks up Abigail and Blade after the raid and shows them Sommerfield's message. He gives them the Daystar arrow that Abigail later fires at Drake.
stages.whoA: Fellow Nightstalker he arms
stages.whoB: Nightstalker who brings the Daystar

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Agent Ray Cumberland has tracked Blade for a long time and takes him in after Whistler dies. He mocks Blade's war on vampires in questioning, then loses him in a transfer.
stages.whoA: The fugitive he has long tracked
stages.whoB: FBI agent who takes him in

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Cumberland expects Chief Vreede to work with him on Blade. Instead Vreede claims jurisdiction and has Blade transferred out of FBI hands.
stages.whoA: The police chief who takes his prisoner
stages.whoB: FBI agent he pushes aside

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Dr. Vance sends Cumberland out to examine Blade alone. Vance then declares Blade psychotic and recommends a transfer, which costs Cumberland his prisoner.
stages.whoA: Psychiatrist who takes Blade from him
stages.whoB: FBI agent he sends out of the room

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Duane and Billy grow up as friends and install car stereos together. The night Billy goes to take one back, Duane sees Connors shoot him. In a dream life Andre builds for Tandy, both are alive at the Johnsons' party.
stages.whoA: His friend, shot by Connors
stages.whoB: His friend who saw him shot

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone, Billy's little brother, finds Duane running a business and asks him for work to get at Connors. After Tyrone steals and returns a bag of drugs, Duane takes him on, and Tyrone later sees him killed.
stages.whoA: Billy's brother, who works for him
stages.whoB: Billy's friend, who hires him

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Duane deals drugs under Connors's protection, though he knows Connors shot Billy. When Duane pushes back and a bag goes missing, Connors sets him up to be shot by O'Reilly.
stages.whoA: The corrupt cop who protects him
stages.whoB: The dealer he protects, then sets up

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Greg is Melissa's lawyer boyfriend and works her case against Roxxon over Nathan. Tandy warns her he is married, and Melissa breaks up with him before he is killed.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend and client
stages.whoB: Her lawyer boyfriend

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy mocks Greg as another married man after her mother. She comes to see he cares for Melissa and asks to help his Roxxon research, then takes his files after he is killed.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend's daughter, who helps him
stages.whoB: Her mother's boyfriend

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Mina works at Roxxon to carry on her father Ivan's work while he lies catatonic. Tandy and Tyrone reach him by reminding him of Mina, and father and daughter are reunited.
stages.whoA: His daughter
stages.whoB: Her father

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy enters Ivan's mind and finds him reliving the rig explosion, and she helps him reach the core. Awake, he tells her Nathan hid evidence in a safe deposit box.
stages.whoA: Nathan's daughter, who frees his mind
stages.whoB: The scientist whose mind she frees

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone helps Tandy enter Ivan's mind. Inside the looping rig explosion, he convinces Tandy the voice on the phone is not really her father and helps Ivan reach the core.
stages.whoA: The young man who helps free him
stages.whoB: The scientist he helps free

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Ivan and Nathan work the Roxxon rig together, and Nathan calls him just before the explosion. Tandy hears Nathan's voice again inside Ivan's memory of that night.
stages.whoA: His Roxxon partner
stages.whoB: His Roxxon partner

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Fuchs talks over Connors's record with O'Reilly at the precinct, and they start dating over pancakes. She finds him murdered, and later spirits wear his face to taunt her.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend, a detective
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, murdered

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Fuchs defends Connors's record at first, then joins O'Reilly's plan to take him down. Connors beats Fuchs to death and frames Tyrone, then later confesses to clear Tyrone.
stages.whoA: The detective who kills him
stages.whoB: The officer he kills

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy meets Mikayla at Lia's support group and loses her temper when Mikayla defends her abusive boyfriend. Feeling guilty, Tandy searches for her and later tries to pull her out of Andre's trance.
stages.whoA: The girl who tries to help her
stages.whoB: A woman from her support group

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Mikayla turns to Lia's support group to get away from her abusive boyfriend. Lia secretly works in Andre's trafficking ring, which preys on women just like her.
stages.whoA: The group leader who preys on her
stages.whoB: A woman from her group

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Andre draws Mikayla, Melissa and many others into his trance club. Tandy and Tyrone defeat him and set them free.
stages.whoA: The man who traps her in a trance
stages.whoB: One of the people he entrances

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone finds a drugged Mikayla in a private ambulance and tries to get her out, but the men inside open fire. Later he and Tandy free her and the others from Andre's club.
stages.whoA: The young man who tries to rescue her
stages.whoB: A drugged woman he tries to rescue

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Nathan picks Tandy up from ballet the night the rig explodes and drowns in the crash. She tracks down his evidence against Roxxon, learns he abused her mother, and finally faces a vision of him.
stages.whoA: His daughter
stages.whoB: Her father

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Nathan is Melissa's husband until he dies in the rig explosion. Tandy sees in Melissa's memories that he was abusive toward her, and Tandy relives those memories again later.
stages.whoA: His wife
stages.whoB: Her late husband

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy robs Rick, and at a party he corners and attacks her. She stabs him with her first dagger of light and flees.
stages.whoA: The girl who stabs him
stages.whoB: The man who attacks her

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: O'Reilly questions Rick in the hospital, and he says he saw nothing. Spotting his scratches and unbuckled pants, she works out he was the attacker.
stages.whoA: The detective who sees through him
stages.whoB: The man she sees through

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Big Chief Roland welcomes Otis back to the Wild Red Hawks as his old Spy Boy. The Red Hawks gather at Otis's home on the anniversary of Billy's death, and Roland stands by the family when the police come.
stages.whoA: His old Spy Boy
stages.whoB: His Big Chief

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Roland meets Tyrone when Otis brings him to the Red Hawks, where Tyrone takes on Billy's unfinished suit. When the police come for Tyrone, Roland stalls them at the door.
stages.whoA: Otis's son, whom he shields
stages.whoB: The Big Chief who shields him

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Billy is Tyrone's big brother, killed by Connors in front of him. Tyrone finishes Billy's suit and poses as his ghost to get Connors to confess.
stages.whoA: His little brother
stages.whoB: His older brother

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Adina is Billy's mother and still grieves his death. Years later she holds Connors captive and makes him tell her where Billy's body lies.
