stages.whoA: His mother
stages.whoB: Her older son

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Otis is Billy's father. He takes Tyrone to the Red Hawks, where Billy's unfinished suit waits, and hosts them on the anniversary of Billy's death.
stages.whoA: His father
stages.whoB: His older son

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Connors shoots Billy and hides his body. Tyrone haunts him as Billy's ghost until he confesses, and later he tells Adina where the body is.
stages.whoA: The cop who killed him
stages.whoB: The boy he shot

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Matt takes Dante's murder case after hearing his heartbeat and believing he is innocent. He makes the opening statement and tracks the lie back to Officer McKenzie, and Dante is cleared and thanks him.
stages.whoA: His defense attorney, who believes him
stages.whoB: A client he proves innocent

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Foggy doubts Dante at first, calling him a three-time loser. With Matt missing, Foggy questions Dante on the stand alone and struggles through Matt's Braille notes before the case is won.
stages.whoA: His other lawyer, who doubts him at first
stages.whoB: A client he defends alone in court

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Karen works for Foggy and Matt at their small firm. Staying late with Foggy on the Tazzio case, she asks the date of the murder and helps him see that Matt's note points to Wesley Owen Welch.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Nelson & Murdock
stages.whoB: The firm's secretary

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Karen works for Matt at Nelson & Murdock and keeps the office going. When Matt goes missing during the Dante Jackson trial, she tells Foggy not to worry.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Nelson & Murdock
stages.whoB: The firm's secretary

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Jack works as muscle for Fallon, then tries to box clean. Fallon tells him his wins were bought and orders him to take a fall, and when Jack wins anyway Fallon has him killed.
stages.whoA: His fighter and hired muscle
stages.whoB: The mob boss who has him killed

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Before he becomes the Kingpin, Fisk works for Fallon. He kills Jack Murdock when Jack refuses to throw his fight, and later tells Matt it was just business.
stages.whoA: His killer for hire
stages.whoB: The mob boss he once worked for

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Hirsch defends Quesada at his rape trial, objecting to Matt's questions and attacking Angela Sutton's past. Quesada walks free, and Foggy guesses the Kingpin paid the bill.
stages.whoA: His client, whom he gets acquitted
stages.whoB: His defense attorney

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Hirsch faces Matt in court in the Quesada trial. He objects to Matt's line on perjury and wins the acquittal that Matt calls another rapist back on the streets.
stages.whoA: Angela Sutton's lawyer, whom he beats in court
stages.whoB: Quesada's attorney, who beats him in court

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Kirby sells Urich tips about anything weird. For cash he shows Urich that Daredevil's baton unfolds into a blind man's cane, a clue that points Urich toward Matt.
stages.whoA: The reporter who pays him for tips
stages.whoB: A paid source with access to evidence

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Elektra is hired to kill DeMarco. She cuts down his guards and the Hand's men, lets him run, then reaches him past his last guards and kills him with a thrown sai.
stages.whoA: The assassin who hunts him down
stages.whoB: A target she kills

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Meizumi serves Master Roshi on the Hand's council and asks for the task of taking the Treasure. When his men fail, Roshi gives the task to Kirigi instead.
stages.whoA: His master, head of the Hand
stages.whoB: His officer who fails to take the Treasure

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Kirigi tells the council that Meizumi's careful methods have failed and that his men are dead. Meizumi calls Kirigi's forces an abomination, but Kirigi wins the task.
stages.whoA: A rival who takes his task
stages.whoB: A council rival whose men failed

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Kirigi is Roshi's son and calls him Father. Roshi gives him the hunt for the Treasure and promises to step aside as head of the council if he succeeds.
stages.whoA: His son and best assassin
stages.whoB: His father, master of the Hand

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Leonard works as Victor's right hand at Von Doom Industries, briefing him on the falling stock and planning his press. On Victor's orders he fetches Ben Grimm to the Baxter Building, and in the end he sees the frozen Doom shipped to Latveria.
stages.whoA: His boss at Von Doom Industries
stages.whoB: His aide at Von Doom Industries

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Ned's bank backs Von Doom Industries, and after the failed space mission he gives Victor one week to turn the stock around. When the bank pulls out, Victor, changed by the storm, kills him.
stages.whoA: The client he drops, who kills him
stages.whoB: The banker who pulls out, whom he kills

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: General Hager brings Mr. Sherman in to question the captured Silver Surfer and keeps the Fantastic Four out of the room. Hager later calls a break in the questioning.
stages.whoA: The general who brings him in
stages.whoB: The interrogator he calls in

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Mr. Sherman questions the Silver Surfer in a military cell, saying the rules against torture don't apply because the Surfer isn't human. He tells the Surfer he should be more cooperative.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he interrogates
stages.whoB: His interrogator

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: After Bronaja's Terrigenesis, Maximus courts him as a seer, and Bronaja warns him the Genetic Council is plotting his death. Maximus later catches him lying about Tibor, makes him pledge loyalty, and pushes him into a vision of Maximus as undisputed king.
stages.whoA: The king who uses his visions
stages.whoB: His seer, who sees the future

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Auran leads Flora, Mordis and the rest of their Royal Guard team hunting the Royal Family on Oahu. Flora clears a path through the jungle and later helps guard Declan's facility, and the team is returned to Maximus under parley.
stages.whoA: The leader of her team on Oahu
stages.whoB: A plant-controlling guard on her team

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Flora and Mordis march through Oahu's jungle in Auran's team, and Mordis asks her to make a path. At Declan's facility she spots Karnak coming, and Mordis goes after him.
stages.whoA: A fellow guard on Auran's team
stages.whoB: A fellow guard who controls plants

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Flora spots Karnak approaching Declan's facility and warns her team, unsure whether shooting him is a trick. Karnak and Gorgon then beat Auran's party.
stages.whoA: A royal she hunts on Oahu
stages.whoB: A guard in the team hunting him

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Captain Pena holds the silent man his officers arrested and tells reporters there was no giant dog. He has him put in general population so the other inmates will rattle him into talking.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he will not explain
stages.whoB: The police captain holding him

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Louise asks Captain Pena whether his prisoner showed powers and asks to see him, and he refuses. When she waits outside the station, he threatens to tow her car with her in it.
stages.whoA: A scientist pressing him about his prisoner
stages.whoB: The captain who stonewalls her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Aura and Frances serve the church side by side and are rarely seen apart, and Chase and Molly fool them both in disguise. Later they escort Frank to Jonah, join his move against Leslie, and confront her together.
stages.whoA: Her constant partner in the church
stages.whoB: Her constant partner in the church

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Aura serves the church Leslie leads, alongside the other elder. When Leslie announces she is shutting the church down, Aura sides with Frank and tells her they won't let her.
stages.whoA: The church leader she turns against
stages.whoB: A church elder who turns on her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frank calls on Aura and the other elder after he kills Destiny's brother and tells them Leslie is the problem. Aura backs him when Leslie tries to close the church.
stages.whoA: Leslie's husband, whom she backs
stages.whoB: A church elder who backs him

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Aura and the other elder escort Frank to Jonah, who thanks them and sends them off. They head for Jonah's Ascension, which Aura calls a holy moment, until the Runaways hack their van.
stages.whoA: The church's hidden power she reveres
stages.whoB: A devoted church elder

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frances serves the church Leslie leads, alongside the other elder. When Leslie announces she is shutting the church down, Frances sides with Frank and tells her they won't let her.
stages.whoA: The church leader she turns against
stages.whoB: A church elder who turns on her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frank calls on Frances and the other elder after he kills Destiny's brother and tells them Leslie is the problem. Frances backs him when Leslie tries to close the church.
stages.whoA: Leslie's husband, whom she backs
stages.whoB: A church elder who backs him

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frances and the other elder escort Frank to Jonah, who thanks them and sends them off. They head for Jonah's Ascension, which Aura calls a holy moment, until the Runaways hack their van.
stages.whoA: The church's hidden power she reveres
stages.whoB: A devoted church elder

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Leslie talks Destiny into staying with the church to go Ultra, praising her plan to reclaim her child. At the ritual Destiny begs her, afraid, and Leslie tells her not to be afraid as PRIDE sacrifices her.
stages.whoA: The church leader who sacrifices her
stages.whoB: A runaway she sacrifices

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Victor runs the container used in PRIDE's ritual on Destiny and says she is gone. He later finds his machine failed and she is still alive inside it.
stages.whoA: The scientist whose machine holds her
stages.whoB: The girl left alive in his container

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Destiny meets Karolina at the church and asks for her number. When the kids see the ritual, Karolina refuses to believe Destiny is dead.
stages.whoA: A church girl she wants to befriend
stages.whoB: A runaway who wanted to be her friend

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: In the thin place, Destiny begs Karolina for help, then blames her as the face on the billboards that drew the seventeen to the church. She and the others use Karolina as bait before she escapes.
stages.whoA: The church's face, whom she blames
stages.whoB: A sacrificed girl who blames her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Eiffel blames Karolina for Chase's fight with the lacrosse team and later offers him a free dance ticket and a dance. When he comes back to Atlas asking a favor, she gets him her master key, wanting something in return.
stages.whoA: A classmate she has a crush on
stages.whoB: A classmate with a crush on him

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Eiffel blames Karolina for the lacrosse fight and calls her a slut in front of the school. Karolina says she doesn't remember what Eiffel claims happened.
stages.whoA: A classmate she bullies
stages.whoB: A classmate who spreads rumors about her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Molly asks Eiffel for a spot on the dance team after a failed audition, and Eiffel takes her on. Molly tells Gert that Eiffel appreciates her.
stages.whoA: A girl she takes onto her dance team
stages.whoB: The captain of her dance team

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Flores is at the Minoru house the night Amy dies, asking Tina where Robert is while she handles things, and he later works the Destiny case for PRIDE.
stages.whoA: A PRIDE leader he covers for
stages.whoB: The detective on PRIDE's payroll

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tina takes command of PRIDE's hunt for the kids, and Flores runs it. After Molly escapes him, Tina agrees to replace him with AWOL.
stages.whoA: A PRIDE leader he answers to
stages.whoB: The cop PRIDE drops

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Geoffrey is among the PRIDE parents Flores brings to the wrong kids. After Molly escapes him, Geoffrey says Flores is out and hands the strike team to AWOL.
stages.whoA: A PRIDE member who drops him
stages.whoB: The cop PRIDE pays

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Leslie calls Flores to cover up Frank's killing of Destiny's brother. He arrives joking that PRIDE keeps him busy and is impressed Frank did it.
stages.whoA: A PRIDE member he cleans up for
stages.whoB: The cop who hides Frank's killing

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: AWOL is Flores's partner on PRIDE's strike team, and Flores tells him to stay in line about the kids' powers. AWOL goes to PRIDE, takes Flores's job and kills him.
stages.whoA: His partner, who kills him
stages.whoB: His corrupt partner, whom he kills

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Flores captures Molly, claims he was a friend of her parents, and threatens to hurt her for answers. Her friends rescue her, and Molly throws him aside.
stages.whoA: A runaway he captures
stages.whoB: The corrupt cop who captures her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tina pays Kincaid to investigate for her, and he brings her proof of the Yorkeses' hidden ranch, thanked as always for his service. Before that, she put him on the Wizard breach that led to Amy.
stages.whoA: The client who pays him
stages.whoB: Her hired investigator

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Mike on a Bike steals Chase's Fistigons and blasts them around a homeless camp, and Chase chases him down to get them back. Mike later tells PRIDE the pretty boy grabbed the gloves.
stages.whoA: The kid whose gloves he steals
stages.whoB: The biker who steals his Fistigons

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Old Lace corners Mike on a Bike when the Runaways chase him, and he begs to be left alone. He later tells PRIDE he wants to say the kids had a dinosaur.
stages.whoA: The dinosaur that scares him
stages.whoB: A biker she scares off

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tamar, pregnant with Darius's son, warns him he will get himself killed. He tells her he saw a girl who glows and a little one who lifts an SUV.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tamar and Darius ready the nursery with Alex's help and plan their new life. Darius is killed before their son Xerxes is born.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tamar's sister Livvie stays close after Darius dies, and AWOL holds Tamar and the baby to force Livvie to help him. Afterward Tamar tells Alex that he and Livvie are done.
stages.whoA: Her sister
stages.whoB: Her sister

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Geoffrey signs the property over to Tamar, but she blames him for Darius's death and secretly reports on PRIDE to AWOL. She turns down the security he offers.
stages.whoA: Darius's old friend, whom she distrusts
stages.whoB: Darius's widow, who distrusts him

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Tamar lets Geoffrey reach Alex through her phone. Later he moves in with her and Nana B, and they work together on Wizard's new headquarters in her neighborhood.
stages.whoA: Darius's old friend, now her partner
stages.whoB: Darius's widow, now his partner

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Catherine has AWOL fire on Tamar's house as a warning, with a newborn inside.
stages.whoA: The woman who shot at her family
stages.whoB: A widow whose house she has shot up

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: In prison, Catherine is told Tamar says hello before inmates hired by Tamar kill her.
stages.whoA: The woman she has killed
stages.whoB: The widow who has her killed

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: AWOL fires on Tamar's house, then she cuts a deal to keep him in the loop on PRIDE if he leaves her family alone. He later holds her and the baby to force Livvie's help.
stages.whoA: The hitman she makes a deal with
stages.whoB: A widow he threatens and deals with

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Alex paints the nursery for Darius and eats at Tamar's table, and she warns him about AWOL. She later hands him the gun Darius kept with his prints on it, but tells him to stay away from Livvie.
stages.whoA: Darius's young friend
stages.whoB: Darius's wife

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Alex brings Leslie in labor to Tamar's house, but he is not himself and turns on Tamar when she fights back.
stages.whoA: Darius's young friend, acting strange
stages.whoB: Darius's widow, who shelters him

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Vaughn works for the Deans at the church and calls them his family, and Leslie thanks him for his loyalty after Karolina escapes. When Frank has her reconditioned she cries out for Vaughn, and he later helps free her from the Crater.
stages.whoA: The church leader he serves
stages.whoB: Her loyal assistant at the church

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Vaughn quietly brings Leslie's mother to meet her. At Leslie's reformed church he gets more duties and runs the youth group.
stages.whoA: The church leader he serves
stages.whoB: Her loyal helper at the church

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Karolina's friends beg Vaughn for help finding her at the church, and he leads Chase and Molly to her. Later he tells Karolina her mother is held in the Crater, steals the map and joins the rescue.
stages.whoA: Leslie's daughter, whom he helps
stages.whoB: A church worker who helps her

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Vaughn greets Karolina at Leslie's new church and tells her Leslie will be happy to see her.
stages.whoA: Leslie's daughter
stages.whoB: A worker at her mother's church

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frank tries to make Vaughn his new assistant while poking around the church archives. Later Frank demands to know where Leslie is, and Vaughn tells him before Frank has her reconditioned.
stages.whoA: Leslie's husband at the church
stages.whoB: A church worker

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Molly sneaks into the church in disguise with Chase, and Vaughn leads them to Karolina. Later Molly joins Vaughn on the Crater rescue and teases him as Brawnster.
stages.whoA: A runaway he helps
stages.whoB: The church worker on her rescue team

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Molly volunteers at Leslie's church, where Vaughn runs the youth group and keeps an eye out for her.
stages.whoA: A volunteer at his church
stages.whoB: The youth group leader at the church

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Joe and Mike are the Toro brothers, Cubans who run gambling on the Gulf Coast and launder their cash through Howard Saint. They come to Saint's house together when Castle destroys a shipment of their money.
stages.whoA: His brother and partner
stages.whoB: His brother and partner

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Howard Saint washes the Toro brothers' dirty money. Joe and Mike come to his house after Castle destroys their cash, and when a second shipment is burned, Howard refuses to cover the losses.
stages.whoA: The mobster who launders his family's cash
stages.whoB: One of the Toro brothers, his Cuban partners

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Howard Saint washes the Toro brothers' dirty money through his banks. When Castle torches a shipment, Mike warns Howard he could lose everything, and Howard answers that he has more guns.
stages.whoA: The mobster who launders his cash
stages.whoB: His Cuban partner, who warns him over the lost cash

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Frank points out Candelaria at the reunion as the man locals call a witch doctor. After the massacre Candelaria finds Frank dying, takes care of him, and sends him off with 'Vaya con Dios'. Frank answers that God is going to sit this one out.
stages.whoA: The man he nursed back to health
stages.whoB: The local who saved his life

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Maria is Frank's wife, who has followed him through years of moves for his FBI work. At the reunion she tells him they are not lucky but blessed. Saint's men kill her and their son Will, and her memory drives Frank's war on the Saints.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife, murdered by Saint's men

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Maria and her son Will join Frank's parents and relatives at the first family reunion in five years. Saint's men kill them all and leave Frank for dead.
stages.whoA: Her family, killed with her in Puerto Rico
stages.whoB: Frank's wife

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: John Saint leads the attack on the Castle reunion. Maria flees with Will, but John runs them both down on the pier.
stages.whoA: The man who kills her and her son
stages.whoB: Frank's wife, whom he kills

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Sergei sees a scarred man with a Turkish accent among the men who take Dmitri. Calypso gets him the name Omer Ozdemir, and Kraven tracks him to his family's monastery in Turkey, where Ömer names Rhino and the ambush closes in.
stages.whoA: The hunter who tracks him to Turkey
stages.whoB: The mercenary who abducted Dmitri

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Ömer is among the four men who break into Dmitri's London apartment and carry him off for Rhino.
stages.whoA: Dmitri, the man he kidnaps
stages.whoB: One of his kidnappers

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Rhino is the man behind Dmitri's kidnapping, carried out by Ömer and his men. When Kraven corners him at the monastery, Ömer names Rhino and says Rhino has killed them both.
stages.whoA: The man behind the kidnapping
stages.whoB: The mercenary who took Dmitri for him

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Stroud and Rodriguez are FBI partners on the drained bodies case. They question Martine and Michael together, arrest Michael, and find on CCTV that the killer is someone else.
stages.whoA: His FBI partner
stages.whoB: His FBI partner

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Stroud thanks Michael for the artificial blood that saved his arm in Afghanistan, then presses him about experiments on a boat. After a nurse is found drained, he arrests Michael, who later escapes.
stages.whoA: The doctor he suspects and arrests
stages.whoB: The FBI agent hunting him

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Stroud questions Martine in the hospital as the only survivor of the ship. After Michael escapes, he orders her watched, but she slips away.
stages.whoA: The ship's survivor he questions
stages.whoB: The FBI agent investigating the ship

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Rodriguez helps question Michael and takes him into custody after a nurse is found drained. In the interrogation he presses Michael over Nurse Sutton, a single mother.
stages.whoA: The doctor he helps arrest
stages.whoB: Stroud's partner, who arrests him

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Rodriguez and Stroud question Martine in the hospital about the fang marks on the bodies from the ship.
stages.whoA: The ship's survivor he questions
stages.whoB: An FBI agent investigating the ship

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Kristen works with Michael every day for seven years at Horizon Labs and helps him care for Anna. When she is found drained, Michael fears he killed her and is arrested, then learns Milo did it.
stages.whoA: The doctor she works with
stages.whoB: His nurse of seven years

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Kristen and Martine work together at Horizon Labs and treat Anna when her fever spikes.
stages.whoA: A doctor she works with
stages.whoB: A nurse at Horizon Labs

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Milo secretly takes the cure and kills Kristen in the hospital at night. Michael is blamed until he realizes Milo is the killer.
stages.whoA: Her killer
stages.whoB: The nurse he kills

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Baron Von Rantenraven attacks New York with biplanes from Sky Harbor, and the Mayor calls in Spider-Man. Spider-Man tricks the pilots with a mirror and crashes the Baron's plane into a zeppelin holding up the fortress.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who brings down Sky Harbor
stages.whoB: The baron whose flying fortress he brings down

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Ben is Peter's uncle. Peter, newly given spider powers, lets a thief escape a TV station, and that thief later murders Ben. Peter catches him and vows to use his powers responsibly.
stages.whoA: His nephew, who let his killer escape
stages.whoB: His uncle, murdered by a thief Peter let go

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Ben is May's husband and Peter's uncle. He is murdered by a thief that Peter failed to stop.
stages.whoA: His wife, Peter's Aunt May
stages.whoB: Her husband, murdered by a thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man finds that Blackwell is behind the strange events at his old theatre, then helps him make Jameson spare it. Later the Green Goblin raids Blackwell's house, and the two beat him together.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who helps save his theatre
stages.whoB: The magician who helps him beat the Goblin

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Green Goblin plots to steal Blackwell's magic secrets and uses tricks to rob the city. He chains Spider-Man at Blackwell's house, but Blackwell helps Spider-Man defeat him.
stages.whoA: The Goblin, who steals his magic secrets
stages.whoB: The magician whose secrets he steals

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson backs tearing down Blackwell's old theatre. Blackwell and the theatre's performers, helped by Spider-Man, trick Jameson into changing his mind.
stages.whoA: The publisher who wants his theatre torn down
stages.whoB: The magician who tricks him into sparing the theatre

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man interrupts Boomer's bank blast and chases him, but loses him when a Martian warrior lands. Boomer frees the Martian to rob gold, and Spider-Man captures him once the Martian is gone.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who catches him after a gold heist
stages.whoB: The safecracker he catches after a gold heist

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Brutus is Charles Cameo's bodyguard and helps him steal art. He knocks out the officer delivering a tapestry and takes his place while Cameo poses as Spider-Man. Both are caught.
stages.whoA: His boss, a master of disguise
stages.whoB: His bodyguard and partner in theft

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Brutus knocks Spider-Man down while guarding Charles Cameo. When the police set a trap with a tapestry, Spider-Man catches Brutus along with Cameo.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who catches him with Cameo
stages.whoB: Cameo's bodyguard, who knocks him down

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Peter meets Carol at a club and they set a date. As Spider-Man he stumbles on her robbery, sees her spider powers, learns she is an alien, and stops a proton test that would destroy her people before they go home.
stages.whoA: Peter, the boy she makes a date with on Earth
stages.whoB: The alien girl he helps get home

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Clive sets the monster Blotto on the city with his Spirit-Scope. Spider-Man finds him, takes the Scope after a fight and uses it to turn Blotto back into film.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who takes his Spirit-Scope
stages.whoB: The man who unleashes Blotto

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Fiddler attacks Flintridge's band with sonic waves and demands a ransom of $1,000,000, then $5,000,000. After Spider-Man beats him, Flintridge recognizes him as Otto.
stages.whoA: The violinist who tries to extort him, Otto
stages.whoB: The rich man he tries to extort

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man protects Flintridge's band from the Fiddler's sonic attacks. He defeats the Fiddler before the second ransom is paid.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who stops the Fiddler
stages.whoB: The man the Fiddler tries to extort

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man leads the crash survivors to the Cloud City of Gold, where DeVargas sends a golden eagle after him and captures the others. DeVargas fires a cannon at him in the volcano, but Spider-Man frees everyone.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who frees his captives
stages.whoB: The conquistador who rules the Cloud City

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Desperado robs banks from his flying robot horse with hypnotic guns. Spider-Man sets a trap using Jameson, gets him off his horse and webs him up.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who webs him up
stages.whoB: The cowboy thief on a flying horse

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man uses Jameson to set a trap for Desperado. The trap works and Desperado ends up webbed.
stages.whoA: The publisher used as bait in his capture
stages.whoB: The cowboy thief he is used to trap

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man tracks Doctor Cool to his hideout, but Cool knocks him out and locks him in a deep freeze with the diamonds. Spider-Man wakes and later buries Cool and his henchman under ice.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who buries him in ice
stages.whoB: The smuggler who freezes him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: A slave on Dr. Manta's island sends a distress call that Spider-Man picks up. He fights the robot beetles and the Mountain Monster, then beats Manta and frees the people.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who frees his slaves
stages.whoB: The slaver of the island castle

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man tries to rescue Doctor Smartyr from ice creatures, until Smartyr stops him: the Plutonians only want help home. Later Doctor Octopus steals his Nullifier, and Spider-Man tracks him down.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who comes to his rescue
stages.whoB: The scientist he tries to rescue

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Doctor Octopus steals Doctor Smartyr's new weapon, the Nullifier. Spider-Man tracks him with a spider-tracer and holds him for the police.
stages.whoA: The villain who steals his Nullifier
stages.whoB: The scientist whose Nullifier he steals

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Doctor Vespasian turns invisible to destroy Spider-Man and impress the city's criminals. Spider-Man beats his invisible dog, then exposes Vespasian at a bank with ice cream.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who exposes him with ice cream
stages.whoB: The invisible scientist out to destroy him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man loses Doctor Von Schlick in a fire, then finds him stealing oil from a tanker. He tracks him to his sewer base and beats him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who tracks him to the sewers
stages.whoB: The slippery oil thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Zapp kidnaps Dr. Caldwell, and Spider-Man helps Skyboy find his lab on Lightning Mountain. Zapp captures Spider-Man, who blinds him with his camera flash and escapes as the lab explodes.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who stops his kidnapping
stages.whoB: Dr. Zapp, a mad scientist he beats

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Zapp kidnaps Jan's father and knocks Jan down with his lightning antenna. Jan, as Skyboy, and Spider-Man rescue Dr. Caldwell from him.
stages.whoA: Skyboy, the son out to rescue his father
stages.whoB: Dr. Zapp, who kidnaps his father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Zapp kidnaps Dr. Caldwell in front of a crowd at his awards ceremony. Caldwell is held in Zapp's lab until Spider-Man and Skyboy free him.
stages.whoA: Dr. Caldwell, the scientist he kidnaps
stages.whoB: Dr. Zapp, his kidnapper

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jan watches his father, Dr. Caldwell, get kidnapped at an awards ceremony. Using his father's Astro-Helmet, Jan becomes Skyboy and helps Spider-Man rescue him.
stages.whoA: Jan, his son, who becomes Skyboy
stages.whoB: Dr. Caldwell, his father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man joins Skyboy to rescue Dr. Caldwell from Dr. Zapp's lab. He beats Zapp and gets Caldwell and Jan out before the lab explodes.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who rescues him
stages.whoB: Dr. Caldwell, the scientist he rescues

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino brings his wax Blackbeard to life to steal a treasure chest. Spider-Man later smashes Parafino's controls at the wax museum.
stages.whoA: Parafino, who made and controls him
stages.whoB: Blackbeard, one of his living wax figures

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The wax Blackbeard knocks Spider-Man overboard and gets away with a treasure chest. Spider-Man tracks the wax figures to Parafino's museum and destroys them.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who fails to stop the theft
stages.whoB: Blackbeard, a living wax pirate

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino sends his wax Executioner after Spider-Man. When it is webbed up and found to be wax, the trail leads Spider-Man back to Parafino.
stages.whoA: Parafino, who made and controls him
stages.whoB: The Executioner, one of his living wax figures

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Executioner of Paris attacks Spider-Man, who webs it up. Seeing that it is made of wax, Spider-Man heads for the wax museum.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who webs him up
stages.whoB: The Executioner, a wax attacker

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino sends his wax Jesse James to rob a bank. Spider-Man stops it and later beats Parafino at the museum.
stages.whoA: Parafino, who made and controls him
stages.whoB: Jesse James, one of his living wax figures

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man stops the wax Jesse James from robbing a bank. A guard sees Spider-Man there and takes him for the robber.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who foils his bank robbery
stages.whoB: Jesse James, a wax bank robber

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson pays Dr. Stillwell to create the Scorpion to catch Spider-Man. The Scorpion turns on Jameson instead.
stages.whoA: Jameson, who hires him to make the Scorpion
stages.whoB: Dr. Stillwell, the scientist he hires

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Stillwell turns a man into the Scorpion for Jameson. After escaping prison, the Scorpion drinks a chemical in Stillwell's lab and trashes it.
stages.whoA: The Scorpion, the man he creates
stages.whoB: Dr. Stillwell, who creates him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Clivendon sends Jameson a one-eyed idol that hypnotizes him into stealing his own money. Spider-Man catches Clivendon and his thief.
stages.whoA: Jameson, whom he robs through a hypnotic idol
stages.whoB: Harley Clivendon, who hypnotizes and robs him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Clivendon knocks Spider-Man out with a boomerang and tries to kill him with an elevator, but is captured. In Florida he knocks him out again, but Spider-Man beats him once more.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who beats him twice
stages.whoB: Harley Clivendon, a hunter he fights

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Clivendon goes after the missing Dr. Connors in Florida, where Connors has found the Fountain of Youth. Spider-Man finds Connors held in a Spanish fort and beats Clivendon.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, the scientist he hunts
stages.whoB: Harley Clivendon, who hunts him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jackie and Peter set loose a seed from a missing scientist's house, and it grows into a giant plant. Peter travels back in time as Spider-Man to find a way to stop it.
stages.whoA: Peter, a friend
stages.whoB: Jackie, a friend

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Plotter guides Cowboy and Ox as they grab a series of missile blueprints. Spider-Man lures them with a photo of a missing blueprint and catches the whole gang.
stages.whoA: The Plotter, who hires him
stages.whoB: Cowboy, one of his thugs

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Cowboy and Ox knock Spider-Man out and take back the blueprints. Spider-Man uses a photo of himself with the last blueprint to lure them in and capture them.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who captures him
stages.whoB: Cowboy, a blueprint thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Peter changes into Spider-Man when the revived Kotep attacks a professor. Kotep traps him in his castle with a demon army, but Spider-Man destroys his scepter.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who breaks his scepter
stages.whoB: Kotep, an ancient sorcerer he defeats

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Marie, the Phantom's robot henchwoman, poses as a shop window dummy to set Spider-Man up. Spider-Man beats the Phantom and his robot henchwomen at his base.
stages.whoA: The Phantom, her master
stages.whoB: Marie, his robot henchwoman

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Disguised as a shop window dummy, Marie helps the Phantom set Spider-Man up. Spider-Man finally defeats her and the other robots at the Phantom's base.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who beats her
stages.whoB: Marie, the Phantom's robot

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man follows a sunken bank to the Molemen's city and seizes their leader. He unmasks him as Mugs Reilly, and the Molemen turn on him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who unmasks him
stages.whoB: Mugs Reilly, the fake Moleman leader

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Peter resists Pardo's hypnosis at the premiere and stops his goons as Spider-Man. He chases Pardo's giant cat form to the Brooklyn Bridge, where it is electrocuted.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who fights him to the end
stages.whoB: Pardo, a hypnotist who becomes a giant cat

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson sends Peter and Penny to the South Pole, and their plane crash lands in a blizzard. Natives seize Penny for a volcano sacrifice, and Spider-Man saves her before the two fly home.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who saves her from the natives
stages.whoB: Penny, the Bugle's pilot

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson sends Penny to fly Peter to the South Pole for pictures of a crashed nose cone. She brings Peter home safely after the trip.
stages.whoA: Jameson, who sends her south
stages.whoB: Penny, the Bugle's pilot

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Plotter guides Ox and Cowboy as they grab a series of blueprints. Spider-Man lures them with a photo of the blueprint they left behind and catches the whole gang.
stages.whoA: The Plotter, who hires him
stages.whoB: Ox, one of his thugs

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Ox and Cowboy knock Spider-Man out and take back the blueprints. Spider-Man uses a photo of himself with the last blueprint to lure them in and capture them.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who captures him
stages.whoB: Ox, a blueprint thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino catches the escaped con Red Dog Melvin and disguises him as a waxwork to lure Spider-Man. Melvin revives and attacks Parafino, and Spider-Man webs them both up.
stages.whoA: Parafino, who uses him as bait
stages.whoB: Red Dog Melvin, his bait

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino uses Red Dog Melvin, disguised as a waxwork, as bait for Spider-Man. When Melvin revives and attacks Parafino, Spider-Man webs them both up.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who webs him up
stages.whoB: Red Dog Melvin, an escaped con

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Scarf's gang robs the rich with illusions and hits a museum with laughing gas. Spider-Man alerts the police, who catch the gang as he defeats the Scarf.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who defeats him
stages.whoB: The Scarf, an illusionist thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Peter and Señor Fuentiz crash in the Andes, and Spider-Man leads the survivors past natives and bats. DeVargas captures Fuentiz, and Spider-Man frees him before the volcano erupts.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who leads him to safety
stages.whoB: Señor Fuentiz, his professor

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Shakespeare frees a gorilla at the zoo, and Spider-Man recaptures it. At the college museum Shakespeare hits Spider-Man with liquid latex, but Spider-Man beats him and his men.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who defeats him
stages.whoB: Shakespeare, a museum robber

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Sir Galahad stops a robbery and then keeps the money, while Jameson blames Spider-Man. Spider-Man beats him in a joust over King Arthur's sword and knocks him into the waterfront.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who beats him in a joust
stages.whoB: Sir Galahad, a crooked knight

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Skymaster's men kidnap Roy Robinson and take him to an airship hidden in a cloud. Spider-Man finds it, beats Skymaster and his goons, and the ship crashes into the harbor.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who wrecks his airship
stages.whoB: Skymaster, a kidnapper in the clouds

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Swami fools the city with illusions and traps Spider-Man in his crystal ball. Spider-Man escapes, finds the dry ice behind the snowstorm and has the Swami arrested.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who exposes him
stages.whoB: The Swami, a fake mystic

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man knocks Vulcan out and webs him up, but Boomer frees him. Vulcan robs the Bank of Nations, and Spider-Man turns his homing thunderbolt back on him and sends him into space.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who sends him into space
stages.whoB: Vulcan, a Martian warrior

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Eddie Brock tells Dr. Kafka at Ravencroft how Spider-Man ruined his life, and she believes the symbiote was only a stress illusion. She later helps him reject it, and when Carnage tries to drag her into Dormammu's realm, Eddie as Venom goes through the portal to save her.
stages.whoA: Her patient, who gives himself up to save her
stages.whoB: His Ravencroft therapist, whom he loves

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Cletus Kasady is locked up at Ravencroft next to Eddie Brock and is also Dr. Kafka's patient. As Carnage, he drains her life force, carries her off to Mordo's lair and tries to drag her through Dormammu's portal.
stages.whoA: Carnage, a patient who abducts her
stages.whoB: His Ravencroft therapist, whom he abducts

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dr. Kafka and Dr. Connors work together to detach Eddie Brock from the symbiote, using what Connors learned of its weakness to sound.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, who helps her free Eddie
stages.whoB: A therapist he helps free Eddie of the symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dr. Kafka is trying to help Venom reject the symbiote when he spots Spider-Man and attacks him. Later Spider-Man, Venom and Iron Man go to Mordo's lair to rescue her from Carnage.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who helps rescue her
stages.whoB: Eddie's therapist, whom he helps rescue

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Harry Osborn is Dr. Kafka's patient at Ravencroft. He tells her his father was the Green Goblin and Peter is Spider-Man, but she says those images are only his imagination, and soon after he escapes.
stages.whoA: Harry Osborn, her patient at Ravencroft
stages.whoB: His therapist at Ravencroft

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Beyonder chooses Spider-Man for a test of whether good is stronger than evil, and lets Doctor Doom capture him so Spider-Man's team must free him. He then makes Spider-Man leader of the Spider-Men against Spider-Carnage, and his last act saves Spider-Man before he goes home.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, the hero he chooses and tests
stages.whoB: The cosmic being who tests him and makes him leader

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Madame Web brings Spider-Man before the Beyonder, a being from her own universe, and they watch his test together. Before leaving, the Beyonder asks her to tell Spider-Man thank you if he prevails.
stages.whoA: Madame Web, who shares his faith in Spider-Man
stages.whoB: The Beyonder, a being from her universe

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Beyonder picks Doctor Doom as one of the villains of his test and lets Doom capture him. Doom absorbs his power to force eternal peace, until Spider-Man and the heroes defeat Doom and free the Beyonder.
stages.whoA: Doctor Doom, who absorbs his power
stages.whoB: The Beyonder, whose power he absorbs

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie Robertson visits his old friend Boris Pushkin at a Moscow police station with Peter. Boris says he knew Peter's parents and gives Robbie the address they need next.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, his old friend
stages.whoB: An old friend in the Moscow police

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter visits Boris Pushkin with Robbie in Moscow, looking for the truth about his parents. Boris claims to have known them and gives Robbie an address that helps the search.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, son of people he knew
stages.whoB: A Moscow officer who says he knew his parents

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Police chief Rhienholdt Kragov interrupts Boris's meeting with Robbie and Peter and threatens to arrest them if they do not leave.
stages.whoA: Police chief Kragov, his superior
stages.whoB: A Moscow officer under his command

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Microchip is the Punisher's partner, feeding him crime details and suggesting he capture Spider-Man. He helps the Punisher prepare at their base before the Punisher heads out in his Battle Van.
stages.whoA: The Punisher, the vigilante he works with
stages.whoB: Microchip, his tech partner

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Ned Leeds is a reporter at Jameson's Daily Bugle. He covers Robbie Robertson's conviction and Morbius's return to New York for the paper.
stages.whoA: J. Jonah Jameson, his publisher
stages.whoB: Ned Leeds, one of his reporters

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Ned Leeds works at the Daily Bugle with Robbie Robertson and is assigned stories about Robbie's conviction for crimes he was framed for.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, a Bugle colleague he covers
stages.whoB: A Bugle reporter who covers his case

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Liz Allan is Mary Jane's friend and confidante. Together they visit Harry Osborn at Ravencroft to tell him Mary Jane is marrying Peter, and Liz is at the wedding when Harry crashes it.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane Watson, her close friend
stages.whoB: Liz Allan, her friend and confidante

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Liz is drawn to Harry Osborn. When Harry, as the Green Goblin, threatens to blow up the church unless Mary Jane marries him, Liz begs him to go back to Ravencroft and admits her feelings for him.
stages.whoA: Harry Osborn, the friend she loves
stages.whoB: Liz Allan, who admits she loves him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Felicia Hardy takes Mrs. Farrell to collect her son Robert from the police station. Later Felicia is the one who tells Robert that his mother has collapsed.
stages.whoA: Felicia Hardy, who helps her and her son
stages.whoB: Robert Farrell's ailing mother

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter tutors Mrs. Farrell's son Robert and comes by the store to see him. As Spider-Man, he and Robert fight off the gang that returns to rob her store.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who defends her store
stages.whoB: The mother of Robert, whom he tutors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Flash ridicules Peter at school and is jealous when Felicia picks Peter, so he puts on a fake Spider-Man costume to taunt him and gets carried off by a Spider-Slayer. Spider-Man saves him more than once, and Flash later attends Peter's wedding.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, the classmate he mocks
stages.whoB: Flash Thompson, a classmate who mocks him

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Flash watches the news of Asteroid M falling with Peter and Mary Jane.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, an old classmate
stages.whoB: Flash Thompson, an old classmate

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Felicia dances with Flash at her charity ball, then ditches him for Peter and scolds him for his costume stunt. Later Flash helps Debra, the Black Cat and Dr. Connors identify a mysterious attacker's DNA.
stages.whoA: Felicia Hardy, the girl he dances with
stages.whoB: Flash Thompson, a classmate who courts her

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Flash tries to impress Debra at her new lab and is angry when Peter gets them both thrown out. Later they are attacked together at a jungle exhibit, and both end up in hospital after Miriam drains their plasma.
stages.whoA: Debra Whitman, the girl he tries to impress
stages.whoB: Flash Thompson, who tries to impress her

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spencer Smythe's Spider Seekers spot Flash in his fake Spider-Man costume, and the Black Widow Spider-Slayer carries him off to Oscorp. Smythe's men are about to destroy him when the real Spider-Man arrives.
stages.whoA: Spencer Smythe, whose robot captures him
stages.whoB: A boy his robot mistakes for Spider-Man

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Alistair Smythe blames Flash, among others, for his father's apparent death and sends his Spider-Slayers after him. Spider-Man saves Flash from the Black Widow.
stages.whoA: Alistair Smythe, who hunts him for revenge
stages.whoB: One of the people he blames for his father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Flash finds Debra after the Vulture drains her youth, and the Vulture then tries to take Flash's youth too, until Spider-Man counters him.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, who tries to steal his youth
stages.whoB: A young man whose youth he tries to take

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Stillwell turns Mac Gargan into the Scorpion, and the Scorpion attacks him demanding a cure he says is impossible. Later the Scorpion takes Stillwell from a mental hospital to cure him, and Stillwell destroys his research instead.
stages.whoA: The Scorpion, the man he mutated
stages.whoB: The scientist who mutated him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jameson has Mac Gargan taken to Stillwell's lab, where Stillwell turns him into the Scorpion to eliminate Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: J. Jonah Jameson, who hires him
stages.whoB: The scientist he hires to make the Scorpion

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Gila is one of the lizards who kidnap Dr. Connors, but she respects humans and refuses to let the others destroy Spider-Man. Branded a traitor, she is locked up beside him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom she refuses to harm
stages.whoB: Gila, a lizard who stands up for him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Gila gains intelligence from Curt Connors's DNA, and she and the other lizards claim him as their father and kidnap him. Connors and the lizards are all turned back to normal in the end.
stages.whoA: Curt Connors, the man she calls father
stages.whoB: A lizard who calls him father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Genevieve works as Herbert Landon's assistant, believing he is curing mutancy, and tells a captive Beast that destroying mutants is the only way to end their suffering. After Landon mutates, he kidnaps her, and she reveals her powers.
stages.whoA: Herbert Landon, her employer
stages.whoB: His assistant, a hidden mutant

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: At the Brand Corporation's press conference, Genevieve uses telekinesis to save Spider-Man from the collapsing roof without revealing herself. Later she saves him and the X-Men again when the mutated Landon drags their jet down.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom she saves twice
stages.whoB: A hidden mutant who saves him twice

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Glory Grant is the secretary at Jameson's Daily Bugle. When the Chameleon slips into the Bugle to steal the security plans for Jameson's conference, he takes her form to escape.
stages.whoA: J. Jonah Jameson, her boss
stages.whoB: Glory Grant, the Bugle's secretary

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Glory works alongside Robbie Robertson at the Daily Bugle. The Chameleon takes the forms of both Robbie and Glory to escape the building with the stolen plans.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, a Bugle colleague
stages.whoB: Glory Grant, the Bugle's secretary

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Gwen tries to kill Spider-Carnage with a sonic gun, but Fisk takes it and Spider-Carnage carries her off as a hostage. He tells her how he means to destroy all reality, and after Uncle Ben reaches him, she sees him leap into an unstable portal.
stages.whoA: Spider-Carnage, who takes her hostage
stages.whoB: Gwen Stacy, the hostage he takes

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man arrives in the world where Gwen is engaged to a rich Peter Parker. She helps him against Spider-Carnage even after learning he is not her fiance, and he frees her once Uncle Ben has reached Spider-Carnage.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, a stranger in her fiance's place
stages.whoB: Gwen Stacy, his double's fiancee

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man stops Hobie Brown from stealing Mary Jane's purse and sends him back to jail. As the Prowler, Hobie later beats Spider-Man, then tells Peter everything and teams with Spider-Man to break into the Kingpin's base and free himself from the suit.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who jails him and then frees him
stages.whoB: The Prowler, a crook who beats him and then needs him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Hobie runs petty robberies for the crime boss Iceberg and skims some of the loot. Iceberg has his men try to kill him, and Hobie later returns as the Prowler and defeats him.
stages.whoA: Iceberg, the crime boss who wants him dead
stages.whoB: Hobie Brown, the crook who skims his loot

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In prison Hobie saves Richard Fisk, so the Kingpin gets him released and gives him a stealth battle suit. The suit then shocks him and the Kingpin says he controls him, until Hobie and Spider-Man find a way to disarm it.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, who traps him in a rigged suit
stages.whoB: The Prowler, a crook he tries to control

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Hobie saves Richard Fisk from another prisoner's attack in prison. Richard tells his father, who repays Hobie by clearing his name.
stages.whoA: Richard Fisk, whose life he saves in prison
stages.whoB: Hobie Brown, who saves his life in prison

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter and Robbie track Illyena down in Moscow. She tells Peter his parents were not traitors and shows them the details her father hid, before the Chameleon steals them.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, Richard and Mary's son
stages.whoB: Illyena Groitzig, who clears his parents

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie gets Illyena's address from his friend Boris Pushkin and brings Peter to her. She shows them the evidence her father kept on the Doomsday device.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, a Daily Bugle editor
stages.whoB: Illyena Groitzig, Groitzig's daughter

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Chameleon poses as Illyena's husband Karl. He takes the evidence she shows Peter and Robbie and leads Spider-Man into a trap.
stages.whoA: The Chameleon, posing as her husband
stages.whoB: Illyena Groitzig, whose husband he poses as

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man fights Jackson Weele's jet-pack gang and saves Robert Farrell from the Big Wheel. He and Robert wreck its timing, and Spider-Man webs Weele out before it plunges into the water.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who wrecks his Big Wheel
stages.whoB: Jackson Weele, a gang boss on the Big Wheel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thunderer fights beside Captain America in the Six American Warriors during World War II. When Cap returns from the vortex fifty years later, they fight the Red Skull together again, and Cap is trapped once more.
stages.whoA: Captain America, his old team leader
stages.whoB: The Thunderer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thunderer and Keene Marlow, the Destroyer, serve together in the Six American Warriors. Fifty years later they reunite to fight the Kingpin's Insidious Six and the Red Skull.
stages.whoA: The Destroyer, his old teammate
stages.whoB: The Thunderer, his old teammate

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man fights beside the Thunderer and the other warriors against the Insidious Six. Together they take on the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who fights beside the Six
stages.whoB: The Thunderer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thunderer and the Six try to stop the Red Skull's doomsday plot in World War II. When the Skull is freed fifty years later, the Thunderer fights him again.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, the Six's old enemy
stages.whoB: The Thunderer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Red Skull's doomsday device turns his son Kragov into Electro. The Thunderer and the Six fight him with Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Electro, the Red Skull's son
stages.whoB: The Thunderer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: John is J. Jonah Jameson's son, and his crash leads Jonah to put a bounty on Spider-Man. When Jonah visits him in hospital, John tells him the Rhino was at the scene, and Jonah calls the bounty off.
stages.whoA: His father, J. Jonah Jameson
stages.whoB: His son John, an astronaut

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man saves John and his copilot from the crashed shuttle on the bridge. When the Shocker kidnaps John for ransom, Spider-Man brings him back.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who saves him twice
stages.whoB: John Jameson, the astronaut he saves

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Alistair Smythe sends the Shocker to kidnap John from his hospital bed. The Shocker holds him for ransom for the Promethium X until Spider-Man frees him.
stages.whoA: The Shocker, who kidnaps him
stages.whoB: John Jameson, his ransom hostage

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: After John's shuttle crashes on the George Washington Bridge, the Kingpin sends the Rhino to steal the Promethium X. John later tells his father the Rhino was there.
stages.whoA: The Rhino, who robs his shuttle
stages.whoB: John Jameson, the astronaut whose shuttle he robs

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Wilson Fisk gives Dr. Ohnn a lab to continue his portal research, and Ohnn hides his new powers from him. The Kingpin takes Silvia hostage to force the Spot to capture Spider-Man, but Ohnn double-crosses him, and Fisk then lends him a plane to close the rift.
stages.whoA: Wilson Fisk, who funds and then threatens him
stages.whoB: Dr. Ohnn, the scientist he funds

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man chases the Spot through two robberies and loses him through his portals. Forced by the Kingpin to bring in Spider-Man, Ohnn instead tells him the truth, and they fake his capture to save Silvia.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who fights and then helps him
stages.whoB: The Spot, a portal thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Tony Stark shuts down Dr. Ohnn's portal project after the trouble with Carnage and Dormammu and fires him. Ohnn is bitter and takes Fisk's offer.
stages.whoA: Tony Stark, who fires him
stages.whoB: Dr. Ohnn, the scientist he fires

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jameson goes back to his old contact Joey Nails for information to clear Robbie. Joey has him restrained in a chair, but Jameson gets free, locks Joey in it instead and takes what he needs.
stages.whoA: Jigsaw Jameson, an old contact who outwits him
stages.whoB: Joey Nails, a shady old contact

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene Marlow, an old friend of Ben's, visits May at the Parker home. Peter overhears them talking about what May must tell him about his parents.
stages.whoA: May Parker, his late friend Ben's wife
stages.whoB: Keene Marlow, Ben's old friend

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene and Ben grow up as friends who dream of being heroes. After Keene's wife Lenora dies, he gives Ben his costume and ring to keep.
stages.whoA: Ben Parker, his childhood friend
stages.whoB: Keene Marlow, his childhood friend

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene visits May and meets her nephew Peter. As the Destroyer, he fights beside Spider-Man against the Insidious Six and the Red Skull.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, Ben's nephew
stages.whoB: Keene Marlow, Uncle Ben's old friend

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene Marlow serves S.H.I.E.L.D. as a commander under Nick Fury. Both are drawn into the hunt for the doomsday weapon.
stages.whoA: Nick Fury, his S.H.I.E.L.D. chief
stages.whoB: Commander Keene Marlow, a S.H.I.E.L.D. officer

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene fights beside Captain America as the Destroyer in the Six American Warriors during World War II. When Cap returns from the vortex, they fight the Red Skull together again.
stages.whoA: Captain America, his old team leader
stages.whoB: The Destroyer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Destroyer and the Six try to stop the Red Skull's doomsday plot in World War II. When the Skull is freed fifty years later, the Destroyer fights him again.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, the Six's old enemy
stages.whoB: The Destroyer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Lenny sets off the time dilation accelerator in a pawn shop and it starts pulling everything in, him included. Spider-Man arrives to save the people there before the Hobgoblin ambushes him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who saves him
stages.whoB: Lenny, a man caught in his own portal

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo shows Peter an illusion of his parents, and Mary speaks to him until Doctor Strange frees him. Later Illyena reveals that Mary and Richard were not traitors but American spies who tried to stop the Doomsday device.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, her son
stages.whoB: Mary Parker, his late mother

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mary and Richard come to warn Illyena's father that they have been found out. Mary comforts the young Illyena, who has been listening, and is reminded of her own son.
stages.whoA: Illyena, Groitzig's young daughter
stages.whoB: Mary Parker, the spy who comforts her

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Quentin Beck finds the scarred Miranda under Wonder Studios and keeps her alive as a cyborg. He admits the body swap could never work and that he loves her as she is, and he stays with her as the complex explodes.
stages.whoA: Quentin Beck, who loves her
stages.whoB: Miranda Wilson, the star he loves

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mary Jane gets Miranda's old leading role, and Miranda captures her to swap their bodies. When the swap fails, Miranda lets her go.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, the look-alike she captures
stages.whoB: Miranda Wilson, who tries to steal her body

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man comes into the tunnels under Wonder Studios to rescue Mary Jane from Miranda's machine. He gets Mary Jane out as the complex explodes.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who saves Mary Jane from her
stages.whoB: Miranda Wilson, a cyborg who captures Mary Jane

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Monitor and the other lizards kidnap Curt Connors, calling him their father. Connors becomes the Lizard and leads them, until Margaret, Debra and Mary Jane change him and the lizards back.
stages.whoA: Curt Connors, the 'father' he kidnaps
stages.whoB: Monitor, a lizard made from his DNA

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man follows Monitor and the lizards into the sewers to rescue Connors and Mary Jane. The lizards lock him up with Gila when she is called a traitor.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who chases him into the sewers
stages.whoB: Monitor, one of the lizard trio

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Monitor and the lizards kidnap Mary Jane along with Connors. She escapes and helps change Connors and the lizards back.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, who he kidnaps
stages.whoB: Monitor, a lizard who kidnaps her

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Taina meets Mousie at a police station after Doctor Octopus brainwashes Spider-Man, and Mousie agrees to help. Together they rally the city's cab drivers and crash into Ock's hideout to free him.
stages.whoA: Taina, the girl she helps save Spider-Man
stages.whoB: Mousie, the cab driver who helps her

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man once saved Mousie, and when Doctor Octopus wipes his memory she follows him across the city. Caught by Ock, she urges Spider-Man to remember who he is until he recovers.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom she frees from Doctor Octopus
stages.whoB: Mousie, a cabbie who helps restore his memory

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mousie trails Doctor Octopus and his brainwashed partner Spider-Man around New York. Ock catches her and is about to get rid of her when her fellow drivers crash in, and he is arrested.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, who brainwashes Spider-Man
stages.whoB: Mousie, a cab driver who foils him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter and Robbie visit Omar Mosely, who tells them the story of the Six American Warriors. Omar later reveals he is the Black Marvel and fights beside Spider-Man against the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who fights beside the Warriors
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, who tells him of the Six Warriors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie and Peter visit Omar to learn the Warriors' history. Omar later shows Robbie where the last keys are hidden, but that Robbie is the Chameleon in disguise, who grabs the keys.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, a Bugle editor he confides in
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, a professor who knew the Warriors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Omar fought beside Captain America as the Black Marvel in the war and later tried for years to free him from the vortex. When Cap returns, they fight the Red Skull together until Cap is pulled back in.
stages.whoA: Captain America, his wartime teammate
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, the Black Marvel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Omar and the Whizzer served together in the Six American Warriors. Reunited fifty years later, they battle the Kingpin's Insidious Six, the Red Skull and Electro beside Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Whizzer, his teammate in the Six
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, the Black Marvel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin steals the Warriors' keys to claim the Red Skull's Doomsday device. Omar and the Warriors fight him and his Insidious Six for the last key, but Fisk escapes with it.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, who hunts the Warriors' keys
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, the Black Marvel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Black Marvel fought the Red Skull in the war. When the Skull returns from the vortex and turns his son into Electro, Omar and the Warriors help Spider-Man defeat them.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, the Warriors' old foe
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, the Black Marvel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie learns his son Randy has been skipping school and running with a gang, and catches him taking his old service revolver. When Tombstone takes Randy, Robbie goes to face him, and the family sorts out its problems.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, his father
stages.whoB: Randy, his son

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Randy's gang turns out to be led by Tombstone, who plans to frame the boy to pressure Robbie. Spider-Man shows Randy he has been set up, and Tombstone is arrested.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, the gang boss who sets him up
stages.whoB: Randy, Robbie's son he uses as bait

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man catches Randy in a carjacking with the gang. At the chemical plant he talks to Randy before fighting and convinces him that Tombstone has set him up.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who sets him straight
stages.whoB: Randy, Robbie's son

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo shows Peter an illusion of his parents, and Richard welcomes his son. The vision binds Peter to Mordo's cult until Doctor Strange frees him.
stages.whoA: Peter, his son
stages.whoB: Richard Parker, his late father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Told that his parents were traitors, Peter goes to Russia to clear their names. He learns Richard and Mary were American spies working against the Red Skull's Doomsday device.
stages.whoA: Peter, his son
stages.whoB: Richard Parker, his late father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spying on the Red Skull's Doomsday device, Richard and Mary go to Dr. Groitzig, who was forced to build it. Fearing they will not escape alive, they leave their evidence with him.
stages.whoA: Dr. Groitzig, who keeps his evidence
stages.whoB: Richard Parker, an American spy

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter tutors Robert in science, but Robert drops out after a night in a cell. Spider-Man finds out Robert is the rocket thief, and together they wreck the Big Wheel and stop his gang.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, his science tutor
stages.whoB: Robert Farrell, a student he tutors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Felicia takes Robert's mother to collect him from the police station and tells Peter what happened. Later she drives Robert to his mother after she collapses, with the Big Wheel in pursuit.
stages.whoA: Felicia Hardy, who looks out for his family
stages.whoB: Robert Farrell, a student she looks out for

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Whizzer got his speed from a flawed copy of the formula that made Captain America, and fought beside him in the war. When Cap returns from the vortex, the Whizzer fights with him against the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: Captain America, leader of the Six
stages.whoB: The Whizzer, a speedster of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man seeks out the Six American Warriors before the Kingpin can. The Whizzer joins him against the Insidious Six and later against the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who teams with the Six
stages.whoB: The Whizzer, a speedster of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In the war, the Whizzer and the Warriors tried to stop the Red Skull's doomsday plot. Fifty years later he fights the freed Skull again and helps defeat him.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, the Warriors' old foe
stages.whoB: The Whizzer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Sarah stands by the Scorpion as he tries to pay for a cure from Curt Connors. When Alistair Smythe captures him, she frees the Vulture so he can go and save him.
stages.whoA: Scorpion, the man she loves
stages.whoB: Sarah, his partner

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Scorpion has been holding the Vulture hostage. Sarah releases him so he can rescue the Scorpion from Smythe, and in the chaos the Vulture regains his youth.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, whom she frees to save Scorpion
stages.whoB: Sarah, the Scorpion's partner who frees him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Smythe captures the Scorpion to use his DNA in an experiment for Silvermane. Sarah frees the Vulture, who breaks up the experiment, and Smythe's lab explodes.
stages.whoA: Alistair Smythe, who captures the Scorpion
stages.whoB: Sarah, the Scorpion's partner

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin assigns Silvia to Johnathon Ohnn's portal project, and she reports Ohnn's new powers to him. Fisk then takes her hostage to force Ohnn to capture Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, her employer
stages.whoB: Dr. Silvia Lopez, a scientist he controls

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Agent Choi works in Richard Fisk's plot to frame Peter Parker for treason. She hands Richard the disc that could clear Peter, and both are arrested and convicted.
stages.whoA: Richard Fisk, whose frame-up she serves
stages.whoB: Agent Choi, a corrupt federal agent

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Agent Choi ambushes Peter for his diagnostic disc, but he escapes as Spider-Man. She later takes the evidence that could clear him, until her arrest helps prove his innocence.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, whom she helps frame
stages.whoB: Agent Choi, a corrupt agent who frames him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Detective Terri Lee watches Agent Choi hand the disc to Richard Fisk and suspects Peter was framed. She arrests Choi when the police raid the hideout.
stages.whoA: Terri Lee, the detective who arrests her
stages.whoB: Agent Choi, a corrupt agent she arrests

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Matt Murdock gives the data disc to Agent Choi, unaware she is part of the plot against his client Peter. Daredevil and Terri Lee then save Peter and Mary Jane, and Choi is arrested.
stages.whoA: Matt Murdock, whom she deceives
stages.whoB: Agent Choi, who takes his evidence

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Vanessa is dining with her husband Wilson when Tombstone kidnaps her for Silvermane. Once she is back, she tells Wilson she is leaving him because of his criminal life.
stages.whoA: Wilson Fisk, her husband
stages.whoB: Vanessa Fisk, his wife

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Tombstone kidnaps Vanessa so that Silvermane can force the Kingpin to hand over the Tablet of Time. He brings her to a hostage exchange that Alistair Smythe's robot breaks up.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, who kidnaps her
stages.whoB: Vanessa Fisk, the Kingpin's wife he kidnaps

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman and Dr. Stromm race to perfect the gas the Kingpin demands. Norman's carelessness sets off a blast that nearly kills Stromm and seems to kill Norman.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, his boss at Oscorp
stages.whoB: Wardell Stromm, his Oscorp scientist

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin forces Oscorp to make a gas for use as a chemical weapon. After the explosion, he orders Stromm to keep working on it anyway.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, who forces him to make gas
stages.whoB: Wardell Stromm, an Oscorp scientist he coerces

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man pulls Stromm out of the burning Oscorp building, and Stromm tells him Norman is still inside.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who saves him from the fire
stages.whoB: Wardell Stromm, a scientist he saves

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Red Skull forced Dr. Groitzig to build his Doomsday device in the war and then tried to have him killed. Freed from the vortex, the Skull has him taken again, and the Six American Warriors save him.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, who forced him to build the device
stages.whoB: Dr. Groitzig, the scientist he forced

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Stephen Strange, a surgeon whose hands were ruined in an accident, seeks a cure from the Ancient One, who offers to teach him. After the Ancient One defeats Baron Mordo, Strange becomes his student.
stages.whoA: Stephen Strange, his new student
stages.whoB: The Ancient One, his teacher

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo, the Ancient One's student, plots to destroy his master and take his place. The Ancient One sees through the scheme and defeats him.
stages.whoA: Baron Mordo, the student who betrays him
stages.whoB: The Ancient One, the master he betrays

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Peter signs up for Bonesaw McGraw's cage match to win $3000 and is announced as the Amazing Spider-Man. Bonesaw mocks and pounds him, but Peter pins him in two minutes.
stages.whoA: The masked newcomer who pins him in a cage match
stages.whoB: Bonesaw McGraw, the wrestler he beats for prize money

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Flash laughs at Peter from the school bus and, after a tray of food hits him, starts a hallway fight. Peter, newly powered, dodges his punches and sends him flying across the hall.
stages.whoA: Peter, the classmate who knocks him down
stages.whoB: Flash, the school bully he beats in a fight

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Flash is Mary Jane's boyfriend and takes her for a ride in his new car. After graduation she hands back his ring and leaves him.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, his girlfriend until graduation
stages.whoB: Flash, the boyfriend she leaves at graduation

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Mr. Balkan sits on the Oscorp board that reviews Norman's work. When the board sells the company, he tells Norman he is out, and the Green Goblin kills him at the Unity Day festival.
stages.whoA: Norman, the founder he forces out, and his killer
stages.whoB: Mr. Balkan, a board member who ousts him

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Mr. Balkan and Max Fargas visit Oscorp together as board members and vote to sell the company. Both die when the Green Goblin attacks the board at the Unity Day festival.
stages.whoA: Max Fargas, a fellow board member
stages.whoB: Mr. Balkan, a fellow board member

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Max Fargas tells Norman the board is unanimous on selling Oscorp and forcing him out. Days later the Green Goblin kills him at the Unity Day festival.
stages.whoA: Norman, the founder he ousts, and his killer
stages.whoB: Max Fargas, the board member who ousts him

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: At the Unity Day festival Harry asks Max Fargas if he has seen his father. Moments later the Green Goblin attacks the board.
stages.whoA: Harry, Norman's son, who greets him at the festival
stages.whoB: Mr. Fargas, an Oscorp board member

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Dr. Stromm runs Norman's performance enhancer work at Oscorp and warns it must go back to formula. Under pressure he helps Norman test it on himself, and the crazed Norman kills him.
stages.whoA: Norman, his boss, who kills him
stages.whoB: Dr. Stromm, his lead scientist, whom he kills

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: General Slocum visits Oscorp and threatens to give Norman's military contract to Quest Aerospace. When Quest tests its exoskeleton, a glider rider bombs the test and kills him.
stages.whoA: Norman, the contractor he threatens, and his killer
stages.whoB: General Slocum, who threatens his contract

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Henry Jackson, the boy across the street, helps May pack for her move for $5. May tells Peter that Henry wants to be Spider-Man and that kids like him need a hero.
stages.whoA: Mrs. Parker, the neighbor he helps move
stages.whoB: Henry Jackson, the boy who helps her pack

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
