stages.text: Henry greets Peter at May's house and asks where Spider-Man has gone. Peter says he quit, and May's speech about Henry needing a hero moves him.
stages.whoA: Peter, May's nephew who takes Spider-Man's pictures
stages.whoB: Henry Jackson, May's young neighbor

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Mr. Aziz scolds Peter for always being late and gives him one last chance to deliver eight pizzas in minutes. When Peter arrives late, Aziz fires him.
stages.whoA: Peter, his unreliable delivery boy
stages.whoB: Mr. Aziz, his boss at Joe's Pizza

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The High Evolutionary has Dr. Borowski separate Venom and Carnage from their hosts. Borowski takes the Venom symbiote to his lab to study it, but Spider-Man steals it back, and the High Evolutionary is furious at his failure.
stages.whoA: His master, who wants the symbiote studied
stages.whoB: A lizard scientist who loses the Venom symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Dr. Borowski's crew lures Venom into an alley and splits Eddie Brock from the symbiote with sonic waves. Eddie is left dying while Borowski studies the symbiote in his lab.
stages.whoA: Venom's host, whom he splits from the symbiote
stages.whoB: The scientist who takes his symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man sneaks into Dr. Borowski's lab and takes the Venom symbiote out of his DNA machine. He brings it back to the dying Eddie Brock, ruining Borowski's work.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who steals the symbiote from his lab
stages.whoB: A lizard scientist studying the Venom symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Daniel learns his brother Durwood is alive after decades apart and goes to find him with Spider-Man. Durwood betrays them to the High Evolutionary, and in their fight Durwood falls into a purifying tank and drowns.
stages.whoA: His brother, whom he betrays
stages.whoB: His long-lost brother, who betrays him

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man comes with Daniel to free his brother Durwood. Durwood springs a trap on them for the High Evolutionary, hoping for a promotion.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom he lures into a trap
stages.whoB: Daniel's brother, who sells them out

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Durwood works at the High Evolutionary's water plant. The High Evolutionary promises to put him in charge of it if he hands over Spider-Man and Daniel, and Durwood goes along.
stages.whoA: His ruler, who promises him a promotion
stages.whoB: A plant worker who betrays Spider-Man

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Sir Ram secretly creates Firedrake, a dragon Bestial, and puts him in charge of the front that kidnaps humans for his experiments. Firedrake guards the operation until Spider-Man and the Vulture shut it down.
stages.whoA: His creator, who runs the kidnapping plot
stages.whoB: His dragon Bestial and guard

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man breaks into Sir Ram's lab to free kidnapped humans and fights Firedrake. He throws a canister of liquid nitrogen into the dragon's mouth and knocks him down.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who knocks him out
stages.whoB: A fire-breathing dragon guarding Sir Ram's lab

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The Vulture joins Spider-Man to stop Sir Ram's kidnappings. Together they fight Firedrake and shut down his facility.
stages.whoA: A Bestial hero who helps shut him down
stages.whoB: Sir Ram's dragon guard

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Mary Jane is Peter's wife and knows he is Spider-Man. She worries about the danger he faces, and stays on Earth when he heads to Counter-Earth.
stages.whoA: Her husband, Spider-Man
stages.whoB: His wife, waiting on Earth

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Nick Fury confronts Spider-Man over the shuttle he is taking to Counter-Earth. Spider-Man talks him into letting him go to rescue John Jameson, and Fury backs off.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who talks him round
stages.whoB: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s chief, who tries to stop him

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Prima's band of cast-off Bestials seizes Spider-Man and the Goblin in Atlantic City. Spider-Man goes along with them on a raid into a High Evolutionary hideout, where he hopes to find a ship home.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, taken by her band
stages.whoB: Leader of the cast-off Bestials

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Prima's band takes the Goblin along with Spider-Man in Atlantic City. The Goblin ends up working with her cast-off Bestials against the High Evolutionary.
stages.whoA: The Goblin, an ally of her band
stages.whoB: Leader of the cast-off Bestials

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: C. Weber, Miles's counselor, tries to shape his college application, telling his parents he has a great story to tell. In the meeting she reveals his B in Spanish, Miles admits to missed classes, and he rushes off to be Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: A student she is helping with college
stages.whoB: His guidance counselor

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jeff and Rio meet C. Weber about Miles's college plans. After Miles runs off, she tells Jeff his son is lying to him and that he knows it.
stages.whoA: Miles's father, whom she warns
stages.whoB: Miles's counselor, who says he is lying

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Rio sits in on C. Weber's college meeting about Miles. She is upset to hear about his B in Spanish and the classes he has missed.
stages.whoA: Miles's mother at the college meeting
stages.whoB: Miles's counselor

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Vanessa sees her husband Wilson fighting Spider-Man and flees with their son Richard, and both die in a car crash. Wilson builds his collider to bring them back, but the Vanessa it pulls in from another universe backs away from him in fear.
stages.whoA: Wilson, her husband, the Kingpin
stages.whoB: Vanessa, his late wife

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man finds Jack trapped in a burning car hanging from the Williamsburg Bridge. He takes off his mask, lends it to Jack for courage and webs him to safety as the car falls.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who pulls him from a falling car
stages.whoB: Jack, the boy he saves on the bridge

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Smythe sneers at Max Dillon when he says he designed Oscorp's power grid. On Max's birthday he orders him to stay late and fix a fault in the lab, where Max falls into the eel tanks.
stages.whoA: Max Dillon, the electrician he belittles
stages.whoB: Smythe, his dismissive boss at Oscorp

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Spider-Man chases off bullies, fixes Jorge's wind turbine and walks him home. Later Jorge faces the Rhino in a Spider-Man costume, and the real Spider-Man returns, thanks him and sends him to his mom.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, his hero, who saves him twice
stages.whoB: Jorge, the brave boy he walks home

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Jorge, in his Spider-Man costume, steps in front of the Rhino as he rampages down the street. The Rhino taunts the little boy until Spider-Man swings in.
stages.whoA: The Rhino, the armored man he stands up to
stages.whoB: A little boy in a Spider-Man costume

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Principal Davis tells Midtown's students who their guest instructors are. After Harry's doping comes to light, Davis reports it to the league, and the Mustangs' state title goes under review.
stages.whoA: Harry, the student whose doping he reports
stages.whoB: Principal Davis, who reports him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash owns up that he told on Harry's doping, and Principal Davis reports it to the league. The Mustangs' title that Flash helped win goes under review.
stages.whoA: Flash, the quarterback who tells him the truth
stages.whoB: Principal Davis, his principal

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Anna is May's confidante as May admits the Parkers are almost out of money. When the Rhino attacks outside their theater, Anna is beside May as she has a heart attack.
stages.whoA: May Parker, her closest friend
stages.whoB: Anna, her best friend

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Anna is the friend May visits and the aunt of the girl May wants Peter to meet. After May collapses, Anna keeps calling the Parker house to reach Peter.
stages.whoA: Peter, May's nephew
stages.whoB: Anna, Aunt May's friend

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Kafka praises Max Dillon's progress and lets him leave Ravencroft. Later Max is back in her group therapy when Kraven breaks in to free him, and he ignores her pleas to stay.
stages.whoA: Max Dillon, her patient, who calls himself Electro
stages.whoB: Dr. Kafka, his therapist at Ravencroft

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto Octavius sits in Dr. Kafka's group therapy, where she praises his progress and he rejects the name Doctor Octopus. Kraven bursts in to free him too, but Otto cowers and is left behind.
stages.whoA: Otto Octavius, a patient in her group
stages.whoB: Dr. Kafka, his therapist at Ravencroft

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kraven bursts into Dr. Kafka's group therapy session to free her patients for the Master Planner. He carries off Electro while she begs Max not to go.
stages.whoA: Kraven, who breaks into her session
stages.whoB: The therapist whose session he breaks up

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man leans on Blackie for the stolen tech Mysterio was moving, and Blackie admits Mysterio fronts for a big boss. Later Spider-Man fights the Molten Man that Blackie helped create in the burning Big Sky bar.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who squeezes him for tips
stages.whoB: Blackie Gaxton, a bookie he leans on

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Green Goblin storms the Big Sky bar and declares himself the new Big Man of crime. Blackie backs the winner and becomes his first lieutenant, bringing him Mark Allan for an experiment.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, his new boss
stages.whoB: Blackie, his first lieutenant

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Mark Allan owes his bookie Blackie money he cannot pay. Blackie offers him a way out through a secret procedure, and Mark becomes the Molten Man and sets the Big Sky bar on fire.
stages.whoA: Mark Allan, a gambler deep in his debt
stages.whoB: Blackie, the bookie he owes

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Fancy Dan and the Enforcers try to squash Spider-Man for the Big Man, and Spider-Man leaves him webbed for police. He returns as Ricochet for a gold heist and later fights Spider-Man in the Vault breakout.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who keeps beating the Enforcers
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, an Enforcer later called Ricochet

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Fancy Dan, Ox and Montana are the Enforcers. Montana becomes the Shocker and leads them as the new Enforcers on a gold heist, and the three end up in the Vault together.
stages.whoA: Montana, his fellow Enforcer, the Shocker
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, his fellow Enforcer

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Hammerhead brings the Enforcers to the Big Man and gives them their orders. He takes Fancy Dan and Ox with him in the breakout while Montana stays behind.
stages.whoA: Hammerhead, who gives the Enforcers orders
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, one of his Enforcers

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Big Man hires the Enforcers to squash Spider-Man after seeing him on video. Fancy Dan's crew later robs gold for him as the new Enforcers.
stages.whoA: The Big Man, the crime boss they work for
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, one of his Enforcers

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Tinkerer builds Fancy Dan a kinetic energy suit and tunes it so he can bounce faster as Ricochet.
stages.whoA: The Tinkerer, who builds his Ricochet suit
stages.whoB: Ricochet, who tests his suit

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Menken is Norman's assistant and runs the Rhino armor auction for him, selling Kingsley a fake drive. When Norman needs a scapegoat, he makes Menken look like the Green Goblin.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, his boss
stages.whoB: Menken, his personal assistant

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man is told Menken is the Green Goblin and confronts him in his new apartment. Menken says he has no response, and the real Goblin springs his trap.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who accuses him of being the Goblin
stages.whoB: Menken, the man he thinks is the Goblin

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Patch plants a bug on Menken as he runs the secret Rhino armor auction. Foswell and Peter listen in as the bidding climbs to half a billion dollars.
stages.whoA: Menken, the auctioneer he bugs
stages.whoB: Patch, who bugs him at the auction

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Foswell tells Peter what he knows about the Big Man rumors. Later Peter joins his gang war story, and they listen in on the Rhino armor auction through Patch's bug.
stages.whoA: Peter, a young Bugle photographer
stages.whoB: Mr. Foswell, a Bugle reporter

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Jameson barks orders at Foswell and sends him to cover John's shuttle landing. He calls Foswell lazy and refuses to fund his gang war story until Peter's photos change his mind.
stages.whoA: Jameson, his editor
stages.whoB: Foswell, one of his reporters

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Fed up with Kenny's prank, Glory has Harry take her home and goes to the fall formal as his date. At the dance she takes Kenny back, leaving Harry on his own.
stages.whoA: Harry, her date to the fall formal
stages.whoB: Glory, his date who goes back to Kenny

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Glory and Sally are part of Midtown's popular crowd. At the fall formal Sally scolds Glory for dumping the guy with the limo before the dance was over.
stages.whoA: Sally, a friend in the popular crowd
stages.whoB: Glory, a friend in the popular crowd

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash bullies Peter but later talks him out of his dark mood. They fight over Liz, who leaves Flash for Peter, yet Flash invites Peter to his party and asks him for help winning Sha Shan.
stages.whoA: Peter, the geek he bullies and comes to like
stages.whoB: Flash, the quarterback who bullies him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Liz is Flash's girlfriend until she dumps him for being jealous of Peter. After his injury he tries to win her back, but she chooses Peter.
stages.whoA: Liz, his girlfriend who leaves him
stages.whoB: Flash, her jealous ex-boyfriend

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash and Harry play together on the Mustangs and win state. When Harry's doping comes out, Flash is the one who reports it, saying a title only counts if it is won fair.
stages.whoA: Harry, his teammate who dopes
stages.whoB: Flash, the teammate who reports him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash is smitten with Mary Jane at the fall formal, where they are crowned king and queen. At the parade they rush over together to help save Gwen.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, the girl he keeps hitting on
stages.whoB: Flash, who keeps hitting on her

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash rides along with DeWolff and Carter and insists Spider-Man handles the real threats. DeWolff answers that Spider-Man goes too far when he takes the law into his own hands, and the patrol leads them to a real bank robbery.
stages.whoA: Flash, a student on her ride-along
stages.whoB: Officer DeWolff, his ride-along officer

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Harry is paired with Flash for a ride-along with DeWolff and Carter. The patrol takes them to a real bank robbery by the new Enforcers.
stages.whoA: Harry, a student on her ride-along
stages.whoB: Officer DeWolff, his ride-along officer

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Jonah proudly shows off his son John before his shuttle mission and frets through the landing. When spores give John powers, Jonah talks him into fighting Spider-Man as Colonel Jupiter and blames Spider-Man for what follows.
stages.whoA: Pop, his proud father
stages.whoB: John, his astronaut son

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: John helps Spider-Man find the Goblin's bomb in a chandelier. Later, maddened by spores as Colonel Jupiter, he fights Spider-Man, who cures him with a power surge.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who helps him and later cures him
stages.whoB: John Jameson, who helps him and then fights him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Green Goblin crashes the gala John attends with his father. John charges one of his men and is shot down.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, who crashes his gala
stages.whoB: An astronaut at the gala he crashes

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Connors studies the spores in John's body and builds the suit he wears as Colonel Jupiter. After the fight Connors finds the spores gone.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, who treats him
stages.whoB: Colonel Jameson, his patient

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Captain Stacy calls Carter and DeWolff to his side when the Sinister Six attack Manhattan. Later he puts Flash and Harry in their car for the ride-along, and the patrol brings them to the bank robbery he is working.
stages.whoA: Captain Stacy, her commanding officer
stages.whoB: Officer DeWolff, one of his officers

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kenny tries to trip Harry at football tryouts and then pranks him, so Glory dumps Kenny and leaves with Harry. At the formal Kenny apologizes and Glory takes him back.
stages.whoA: The teammate Glory leaves him for
stages.whoB: The teammate who keeps picking on him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kenny helps Flash torment Peter, eating his lunch and pelting him with water balloons. At football tryouts Peter and Harry give Kenny a rough time.
stages.whoA: The geek he and Flash pick on
stages.whoB: Flash's teammate and fellow bully

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kenny and Rand play on the Midtown football team and run with the same popular crowd. In the State final Kenny recovers a fumble and Rand catches a key pass as the Mustangs win.
stages.whoA: His teammate on the Mustangs
stages.whoB: His teammate on the Mustangs

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Curt welcomes Miles to the ESU lab, but Miles wants to build on Curt's lizard research. When Curt finds his plans for human armor tests and threatens to go to the board, Miles threatens to expose Curt's past as the Lizard, and the Connors leave New York.
stages.whoA: The ESU colleague he blackmails out
stages.whoB: The colleague who blackmails him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kraven tracks Spider-Man's scent to Miles's lab and pays him to make him a better hunter. After days of treatments with an electrolyzed lizard mutagen, Kraven is transformed.
stages.whoA: The hunter he mutates for money
stages.whoB: The scientist who mutates him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Miles puts Mark Allan in a new armor and coaches him to switch it on and off with his mind. Mark becomes Molten Man.
stages.whoA: The young man he puts in molten armor
stages.whoB: The scientist who builds his armor

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Curt introduces Miles to his intern Gwen, and Miles says his brother speaks highly of her. When the Connors leave ESU, Miles takes charge of the lab where Gwen works.
stages.whoA: An intern in his lab
stages.whoB: The new head of her lab

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Curt introduces Miles to his intern Peter, whose biology professor is Miles's brother. When the Connors leave ESU, Miles takes charge of the lab where Peter works.
stages.whoA: An intern in his lab
stages.whoB: The new head of his lab

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Bromwell treats May after her heart attack, sends her home for Thanksgiving and drives her there himself. On Valentine's Day he makes a house call and tells her she is fit as a fiddle.
stages.whoA: His patient, who has a heart attack
stages.whoB: Her doctor, who drives her home

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: When Peter asks if everything is okay, Dr. Bromwell tells him and May that she can go home from the hospital for Thanksgiving.
stages.whoA: His patient's nephew
stages.whoB: Aunt May's doctor

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Peter asks Robbie whether he knows a Rand Robertson. Robbie jokes that a kid by that name lives in his house and eats all his food.
stages.whoA: His father, the Bugle's editor
stages.whoB: His son, a Midtown football player

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Sally is Rand's girlfriend, and Rand just shrugs when Peter asks her out. When Rand runs to help catch Gwen at the parade, Sally begs him not to.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend, a cheerleader
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend on the football team

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Rand takes it in stride when Peter asks out Sally, and he shields Peter from Flash's water balloons. He is the one football player who never bullies him.
stages.whoA: The classmate he stands up for
stages.whoB: The friendliest of the football players

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Montana leads Ox and Fancy Dan against Spider-Man for the Big Man. Later Montana, now the Shocker, leads the New Enforcers with Ox in a Tinkerer suit, and both end up in the Vault.
stages.whoA: His leader in the Enforcers
stages.whoB: His big Enforcer muscle

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Big Man hires the Enforcers, and Ox fights Spider-Man on his orders. Later the Big Man looks over Ox and the New Enforcers in their Tinkerer gear and likes what he sees.
stages.whoA: The crime lord he works for
stages.whoB: One of his Enforcers

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: When the villains break out of Ryker's Island, Hammerhead takes Ox and Fancy Dan with him while Montana stays with the others.
stages.whoA: The mobster he follows off Ryker's
stages.whoB: An Enforcer who leaves Ryker's with him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Tinkerer builds Ox a strength suit for the New Enforcers. Montana becomes the Shocker and Fancy Dan becomes Ricochet, but Ox keeps his old name.
stages.whoA: The inventor who builds his suit
stages.whoB: The Enforcer he builds a suit for

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Ox fights Spider-Man for the Big Man and can snap his webbing. Spider-Man beats him again when he returns in a Tinkerer suit, and again when the Vault's prisoners are freed.
stages.whoA: The hero who keeps beating him
stages.whoB: A huge Enforcer who can snap webs

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kingsley outbids Hammerhead for the Rhino specs. When Hammerhead tries to steal the prize, he finds that Kingsley handed him an empty box.
stages.whoA: A bidder he outbids and fools
stages.whoB: The buyer who fools him with an empty box

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kingsley outbids Silver Sable's side for the Rhino specs. When Sable tries to steal the prize, she finds that Kingsley handed her an empty box.
stages.whoA: A rival he fools with a decoy
stages.whoB: The buyer who fools her with an empty box

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Rhino catches up with Kingsley, angry that anyone else might wear his suit, and Kingsley runs. The case of specs is destroyed in the brawl that follows.
stages.whoA: The villain who hunts him for the specs
stages.whoB: The man who buys the specs to his suit

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Devereaux casts Harry as Puck, the lead in his school play. On opening night Harry never shows, so Devereaux sends Hobie on in his place.
stages.whoA: The student he casts as Puck
stages.whoB: The director who gives him the lead

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Devereaux posts his cast list, and Kenny and Glory both get into the play.
stages.whoA: A football player in his cast
stages.whoB: The director of the school play

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Carter serves under Captain Stacy and joins the police as they take on the Sinister Six. Later Stacy runs a student ride-along and assigns students to Carter's car.
stages.whoA: His captain
stages.whoB: A sergeant under his command

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Unlike his partner, Carter backs Spider-Man. On the ride-along he says Spider-Man hasn't gone far enough.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, the hero he backs
stages.whoB: A police sergeant on his side

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Peter wins a wrestling match as Spider-Man, but Edwards refuses to pay without a management contract. When a thief robs him, Peter lets the man go.
stages.whoA: The masked wrestler he won't pay
stages.whoB: The promoter who cheats him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto returns to his old workplace and threatens Dr. Twaki, who kept the Megalo-pack Otto built. Twaki tells him it is in vault 8.
stages.whoA: His old employee, now a villain
stages.whoB: The doctor who kept his invention

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man grabs the Megalo-pack from Doctor Octopus, and Dr. Twaki explains that it holds a charge for years. Spider-Man tells him to hide.
stages.whoA: The hero who tells him to hide
stages.whoB: The doctor who explains the Megalo-pack

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Billy reads about lizards like his father and sees Curt turn into the Lizard. At the zoo Billy begs his dad to stop, giving Spider-Man the moment he needs to cure him. Later the family moves to Florida.
stages.whoA: His father, who becomes the Lizard
stages.whoB: His young son

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Martha tries to keep Billy from seeing his father change, but he sees it anyway. Later the family leaves New York for Florida.
stages.whoA: His mother
stages.whoB: Her young son

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Billy asks Peter whether his father will still care about him if he turns into a monster. Peter promises that his dad always will.
stages.whoA: The intern who comforts him
stages.whoB: Dr. Connors's son

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Gwen stays with Billy while Martha goes after the Lizard, but Billy follows his father to the zoo.
stages.whoA: The intern who looks after him
stages.whoB: Dr. Connors's son

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Jack tells Eddie the network gave him a home and orders him to ask Carlton Drake only about his rocket. When Eddie accuses Drake on camera with no source, Jack fires him.
stages.whoA: The star reporter he fires
stages.whoB: Jack, the network boss who fires him

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Eddie greets Richard by name and cheers when he hears his daughter got into MIT on a scholarship. Later Richard refuses to let the fired Eddie upstairs, and Eddie stops Venom from eating him, saying Richard is his friend.
stages.whoA: The friend he has to turn away
stages.whoB: Richard, the guard Venom wants to eat

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Detective Mulligan pushes Eddie to visit Kasady, and Eddie later calls him with a lead from St. Estes. After Kasady escapes, Mulligan suspects Eddie, arrests him and grills him about the monsters.
stages.whoA: The reporter he uses, then suspects
stages.whoB: Detective Mulligan, who arrests him

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Eddie is blamed for Mulligan's apparent death. At Area 51 Eddie finds him alive with a new symbiote, which urges him to protect the Codex and free the captive symbiotes.
stages.whoA: The man wrongly blamed for his death
stages.whoB: Mulligan, alive at Area 51 with a symbiote

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: As a young officer, Mulligan shoots Frances in the eye and thinks she is dead. Years later she calls him the cop who took her eye, holds him hostage at the cathedral and blasts him with her scream.
stages.whoA: Frances, the screamer he once shot
stages.whoB: The cop who took her eye

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Mulligan hunts the escaped Kasady and the monster seen with him. Kasady takes him hostage as a wedding gift for Frances, and after the battle a piece of Carnage lives on in Mulligan.
stages.whoA: The killer who takes him hostage
stages.whoB: The detective he takes hostage

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: When Venom bonds with Eddie again at Area 51, a Xenophage tracks the Codex to the base. In the battle it devours Mulligan.
stages.whoA: The hunters who kill him
stages.whoB: A symbiote host they kill

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Martin introduces Nova as his wife, and they welcome hitchhiker Eddie into their camper. They drive him to Las Vegas, then take the family on to Area 51.
stages.whoA: Martin, her husband
stages.whoB: Nova, his wife

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Nova and Martin take in the stranded Eddie and give him a ride to Las Vegas. At Area 51 her family is caught up in the battle he is fighting.
stages.whoA: The hitchhiker her family drives to Vegas
stages.whoB: Nova, who gives him a ride to Vegas

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Nova travels with her daughter Echo in the family camper. They drive Eddie to Las Vegas and go on to Area 51 together.
stages.whoA: Echo, her daughter
stages.whoB: Nova, her mother

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Nova rides with her son Leaf in the camper as they drive Eddie to Las Vegas. The family then goes on to Area 51 together.
stages.whoA: Leaf, her son
stages.whoB: Nova, his mother

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Martin introduces his daughter Echo to Eddie. She rides with her father to Las Vegas and on to the Area 51 he has always dreamed of seeing.
stages.whoA: Martin, her father
stages.whoB: Echo, his daughter

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Echo and her little brother Leaf ride in the back of the camper. They reach Area 51 together with their parents.
stages.whoA: Leaf, her little brother
stages.whoB: Echo, his big sister

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Echo greets hitchhiker Eddie by saying he must be a serial killer from her favorite murder podcast. She rides with him to Las Vegas in the family camper.
stages.whoA: The hitchhiker she teases
stages.whoB: Echo, the sardonic daughter

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Martin introduces his son Leaf to Eddie. Leaf rides with his father to Area 51 to look for aliens.
stages.whoA: Martin, his father
stages.whoB: Leaf, his son

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: In the camper, Leaf slips Eddie chocolate and admits he is scared of aliens, and Eddie promises they are not real. At Area 51 Eddie admits he lied: his best friend is an alien who will get Leaf out.
stages.whoA: Eddie, the hitchhiker who looks after him
stages.whoB: Leaf, the boy who gives him chocolate

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Eddie takes Leaf's chocolate for a friend who loves it. At Area 51, Venom shows himself to Leaf and thanks him for the chocolate.
stages.whoA: The alien who thanks him
stages.whoB: The boy who gave him chocolate

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: When Andre is caught running with the 110th Street Gang, his brother Lonnie tracks his phone to their hideout and trades himself to Big Donovan to free him. Later Andre tells Lonnie the trade was the wrong call and he can't hide it forever.
stages.whoA: Lonnie, the brother who joins the gang for him
stages.whoB: Andre, the brother he saves

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Big Donovan claims Andre as the 110th's little brother and refuses to let him go. He releases Andre only when Lonnie offers himself instead.
stages.whoA: Big Donovan, the gang boss who claims him
stages.whoB: Dre, the kid he trades for Lonnie

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Wittman oversees Peter's internship at Oscorp and scolds him for being late and for leaving the lab. He later shreds Peter's battery pitch as a lesson to the other interns.
stages.whoA: Dr. Wittman, his harsh Oscorp supervisor
stages.whoB: The intern he keeps scolding

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Wittman hands Peter to Carla Connors for her energy project, and she warns Peter he treats science like a race. When Wittman rages that Peter is missing, Carla covers for him and tells Bentley to calm down.
stages.whoA: Carla Connors, the colleague who covers for Peter
stages.whoB: Bentley, the supervisor she keeps calm

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Wittman tests the four interns and mocks Amadeus for asking about robotics. He still places Amadeus in Oscorp's robotics division.
stages.whoA: Amadeus, the intern he puts in robotics
stages.whoB: Dr. Wittman, the supervisor who places him

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Norman saddles Wittman with four interns he never asked for. After Gargan's defeat, Wittman is among the scientists who meet Norman about Oscorp's secret projects.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, his employer
stages.whoB: Wittman, one of his scientists

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Carmilla serves as Mac Gargan's lieutenant in the Scorpions and fights beside him in the turf war with the 110th. She tracks Lonnie to the 110th's hideout and tells Gargan the plan worked.
stages.whoA: Mac Gargan, her boss
stages.whoB: Carmilla, his lieutenant

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Carmilla corners Lonnie when he picks up food on Scorpion turf, and Big Donovan warns him she has seen his face. Later she tails him to the 110th's hideout.
stages.whoA: Lonnie, the 110th recruit she hunts
stages.whoB: Carmilla, the Scorpion who tails him

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Carmilla sends Big Donovan a threat through Lonnie, and Donovan calls her the Scorpions' lieutenant. She fights his gang when the Scorpions move on the 110th's turf.
stages.whoA: Big Donovan, the rival gang boss
stages.whoB: Carmilla, the rival lieutenant

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Bulldozer reports to Big Donovan that the Scorpions are moving in. Donovan sends him to fetch Lonnie for the turf war, and he fights beside the gang when the Scorpions attack.
stages.whoA: Big Donovan, his gang boss
stages.whoB: Bulldozer, his enforcer

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Bulldozer waits outside Lonnie's school to bring him to the turf war. At the hideout he calls Lonnie Tombstone and tells him Pearl has come to see him.
stages.whoA: Lonnie, the fellow gang member he calls Tombstone
stages.whoB: Bulldozer, the 110th enforcer

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Bulldozer warns Donovan that Gargan's Scorpions are moving in on their turf. When Gargan attacks the hideout in his scorpion armor, Bulldozer fights and then runs.
stages.whoA: Gargan, the rival boss who attacks them
stages.whoB: A 110th enforcer he attacks

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Mr. Taylor lets Lonnie pick Peter as his lab partner, and the pair ace his first lab. When Lonnie stops coming to class, he puts Peter with Pearl and Emma.
stages.whoA: Mr. Taylor, his science teacher
stages.whoB: Parker, a student in his class

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Lonnie asks Mr. Taylor if he can work with Peter, and Mr. Taylor agrees. Lonnie later brags that they aced his first lab.
stages.whoA: Mr. Taylor, his science teacher
stages.whoB: Lincoln, the student who picks Peter

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: At a charity gala, Norman offers Oscorp's help with the Sokovia Accords and reveals Spider-Man as his asset, and Ross agrees to keep the registration quiet. Later Norman sends Ross Otto Octavius's location.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, the backer who tips him off
stages.whoB: Secretary Ross, his government contact

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Ross's agents corner Otto at his lab and charge him with violating the Sokovia Accords. When Otto tries to fight his way out, Iron Man arrives and Ross takes him in.
stages.whoA: Otto Octavius, the arms maker he arrests
stages.whoB: Ross, who arrests him

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Iron Man flies in to stop Otto Octavius from escaping Ross's raid. Ross and Stark greet each other by name.
stages.whoA: Stark, who helps with the arrest
stages.whoB: Ross, whose raid he backs up

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Vincent cleans Otto's lab after a sale and soothes him that the world will soon revere him. Later he calls to check that Otto has eaten and offers soup, just before agents arrest Otto.
stages.whoA: Otto, the boss he looks after
stages.whoB: Vincent, his loyal assistant

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: When General Ross turns his tanks and guns on Bruce Banner at Culver University, his daughter Betty begs him to stop. He ignores her, and she watches Bruce die.
stages.whoA: Her father, the general who opens fire on Bruce
stages.whoB: His daughter, who begs him to call off the attack

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: After Tony's death, a U.S. general seizes Stark Industries and orders the Liberator drones into production. His military puts J.A.R.V.I.S. at the controls of the drone army sent into Wakanda, until the Wakandans cut the link.
stages.whoA: The general who takes command of his drone army
stages.whoB: Tony Stark's AI, running the drone army sent against Wakanda

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: Maverick joins Wolverine's crew to bury Dr. Cornelius, the Weapon X scientist who made them killing machines. In the ruined Arctic lab, Cornelius greets them as stray dogs come home, then turns into a Brood creature.
stages.whoA: A Team X soldier who comes to his lab to end him
stages.whoB: The Weapon X scientist his team comes to bury

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Leech falls gravely ill on Christmas Eve, Ape helps steal an ambulance for its medicine. In the tunnels, Ape readies a place beside the boy for Wolverine's blood transfusion, and Leech pulls through.
stages.whoA: The sick Morlock boy he helps save at Christmas
stages.whoB: A Morlock who steals an ambulance to save him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator and Starbolt fight side by side in the Imperial Guard, first for D'Ken against the X-Men and the Starjammers. When Lilandra claims Jean Grey, they battle the X-Men again on the Moon over the Phoenix.
stages.whoA: A hot-tempered fellow guardsman in the Imperial Guard
stages.whoB: The Imperial Guard's leader, who fights beside him

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Gladiator and Starbolt fight together in the Imperial Guard as it overruns Ronan's Kree soldiers for Deathbird. Gladiator brings Ronan down at her feet.
stages.whoA: A hot-tempered fellow guardsman in the war with the Kree
stages.whoB: The Imperial Guard's leader, who fights beside him against the Kree

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bella Donna's Assassins kidnap Bobby and the Thieves' tithe, and she lets him go only when Gambit agrees to marry her. At the tithe, her fake box nearly dooms the Thieves, and Bobby cries out for her destruction.
stages.whoA: Gambit's brother, a Thief she holds for ransom
stages.whoB: The Assassins' leader who kidnaps him

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: Bobby and Bella Donna bicker over who called them home, until the risen Gambit reveals the invitations were his. He bends both their minds, and they fight the X-Men together for him.
stages.whoA: Gambit's brother, called home beside her by the risen Gambit
stages.whoB: Gambit's old flame, called home beside him by the risen Gambit

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Boomer frees the webbed-up Martian warrior Vulcan, and the two team up to rob a bank of its gold. Spider-Man turns Vulcan's own homing bolt back on him, sending him into space, then catches Boomer.
stages.whoA: The Martian warrior he frees to help rob gold
stages.whoB: The safecracker who frees him and robs a bank with him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Señor Fuentiz and the crash survivors reach the Cloud City of Gold, where its conquistador ruler DeVargas has them captured. Spider-Man frees them, and they flee as DeVargas's cannon fire sets off the volcano.
stages.whoA: A stranded professor he takes captive
stages.whoB: The conquistador who holds him captive

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Cowboy and Ox work as a team for the Plotter, grabbing a series of blueprints while Spider-Man is knocked out. When they come back for the one they left behind, Spider-Man's photo lure lets him catch the gang.
stages.whoA: His partner in the Plotter's blueprint thefts
stages.whoB: His partner in the Plotter's blueprint thefts

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo conjures illusions of Peter's late parents, who greet him side by side and draw him into the cult. Doctor Strange breaks the spell, and the couple fades away.
stages.whoA: Her husband, Peter's late father
stages.whoB: His wife, Peter's late mother

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Years before, Richard and Mary pose as traitors in Russia to learn about the Red Skull's Doomsday device. When the KGB catches on, they leave their evidence with Dr. Groitzig, fearing they will not get home alive.
stages.whoA: Her husband and fellow American spy
stages.whoB: His wife and fellow American spy

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robert follows the gang that robbed his mother's store and takes their jet tech for a rocket skateboard. Jackson Weele chases him in the Big Wheel to get it back, until Robert and Spider-Man send it into the water.
stages.whoA: A teen who steals his gang's jet tech
stages.whoB: The gang boss who chases him in the Big Wheel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robert tries to turn his life around for his ailing mother, but after her store is robbed he uses stolen tech to rob a jeweler. Mrs. Farrell collapses when she sees her son on TV, and Robert turns back to doing right.
stages.whoA: Her troubled teenage son
stages.whoB: His ailing mother, who runs a grocery store

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Gila and Monitor, lizards made smart by Connors' DNA, kidnap him with Gecko and call him their father. When Gila refuses to let Spider-Man be destroyed, she is chained up too, and both are turned back into lizards.
stages.whoA: A fellow lizard who helps kidnap Connors
stages.whoB: A fellow lizard who turns against the plan

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thunderer and the Whizzer, old teammates in the Six American Warriors, fight side by side once more. With Spider-Man, they take on the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: A speedster teammate in the Six American Warriors
stages.whoB: A loud-voiced teammate in the Six American Warriors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Omar, revealed as the Black Marvel, fights beside the Thunderer, who spent fifty years watching the doomsday site as a homeless man. The old teammates battle the Red Skull and Electro with Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: An old teammate who kept watch over the doomsday site
stages.whoB: The Black Marvel, an old teammate in the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene Marlow puts on his Destroyer costume again and rejoins the Whizzer and the other Warriors. Together they take on the Red Skull and Electro at Spider-Man's side.
stages.whoA: A speedster comrade from the Six American Warriors
stages.whoB: The Destroyer, a comrade from the Six American Warriors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Destroyer and the Black Marvel fight together again as the Six American Warriors reunite. With Spider-Man, Keene and Omar take on the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: The Black Marvel, his old comrade in arms
stages.whoB: The Destroyer, his old comrade in arms

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin makes Dr. Lopez the lab partner on Johnathon Ohnn's portal work, and he falls for her. As the Spot, he turns on the Kingpin to save her, and she follows him into the rift he seals.
stages.whoA: His lab partner, the woman he loves
stages.whoB: The portal scientist who falls in love with her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pyro, Blob and Avalanche wait for the Senate hearing as Mystique's gang, and Pyro teases old Blob about his manners. At the Capitol they stage a diversion, with Blob trying to flatten the X-Men while Pyro sets fires.
stages.whoA: Pyro: his fire throwing partner in Mystique's gang
stages.whoB: Blob: his huge, belching partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pyro, Avalanche and Blob loot a market together, with Blob stuffing himself on fruit. Then they hit the X-Men outside Midtown Hospital, a brawl that is only a distraction for Mystique.
stages.whoA: Pyro: his fire throwing partner in Mystique's gang
stages.whoB: Blob: his huge, belching partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pyro asks Avalanche, his old darling, to begin the diversion at the Senate hearing. Avalanche shakes the building while Pyro adds fire, and both battle the X-Men at the Capitol.
stages.whoA: Pyro: his fire wielding partner in Mystique's gang
stages.whoB: Avalanche: his earthquake making partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pyro praises Avalanche's work as they raid a market with Blob. Later the two ambush the X-Men at Midtown Hospital to keep them busy while Mystique goes after Rogue.
stages.whoA: Pyro: his fire wielding partner in Mystique's gang
stages.whoB: Avalanche: his earthquake making partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Avalanche and Blob join Pyro in Mystique's plot at the Senate hearing on mutants. Avalanche brings the house down while Blob tries to sit on the X-Men, until Storm freezes him.
stages.whoA: Blob: the huge, near unbreakable muscle of their gang
stages.whoB: Avalanche: his ground shaking partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Avalanche and Blob rob a market with Pyro, then fight the X-Men outside Midtown Hospital. Blob shrugs off every hit as their brawl buys Mystique time to reach Rogue.
stages.whoA: Blob: the huge, near unbreakable muscle of their gang
stages.whoB: Avalanche: his ground shaking partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Shani tells Storm that her son MjNari has changed, and that Storm became his second mother at his birth. When the Shadow King takes Shani, MjNari refuses to run, and once she is free she begs him to flee before the villain seizes him again.
stages.whoA: Shani: his mother in the village
stages.whoB: MjNari: her son, and Storm's godson

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sasquatch and Shaman help Alpha Flight trap Wolverine in the Canadian woods and bring him to Department H. When they learn General Chasen wants his skeleton, both join the team's raid to free him.
stages.whoA: Shaman: his Alpha Flight teammate, the medicine man
stages.whoB: Sasquatch: his huge, furry Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sasquatch follows Vindicator as Alpha Flight hunts Wolverine down and hauls him to Department H. When Chasen's plan comes out, the team storms the lab, though Vindicator still tries to keep Wolverine.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: the leader of his Alpha Flight team
stages.whoB: Sasquatch: the strongman of his Alpha Flight team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Northstar and Sasquatch fight side by side as Alpha Flight captures Wolverine for Department H. Once they learn General Chasen plans to dissect him, both turn on Chasen to set him free.
stages.whoA: Sasquatch: his huge, furry Alpha Flight teammate
stages.whoB: Northstar: his speedy Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Shaman tries to talk Wolverine down before Northstar snatches him into the air for Alpha Flight. Later both turn against General Chasen when they learn he means to cut Wolverine apart.
stages.whoA: Shaman: his Alpha Flight teammate, the medicine man
stages.whoB: Northstar: his speedy Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Puck and Northstar help pin Wolverine down, with Puck telling him to listen to the Frenchies. Both later join Alpha Flight's raid on the lab once General Chasen's plan comes out.
stages.whoA: Puck: his short, tough Alpha Flight teammate
stages.whoB: Northstar: his speedy Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Shaman blocks Wolverine's path as Vindicator leads Alpha Flight to bring him back, calling him a friend all the while. When Chasen's plan comes out, Shaman joins the raid as Vindicator tries to keep Wolverine.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: the leader of his Alpha Flight team
stages.whoB: Shaman: the medicine man of his Alpha Flight team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Puck and Sasquatch both take on Wolverine as Alpha Flight tries to bring him back to Department H. When General Chasen's plan comes out, they join the team's raid to free him.
stages.whoA: Sasquatch: his huge, furry Alpha Flight teammate
stages.whoB: Puck: his short, tough Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Puck and Shaman join Alpha Flight's hunt for Wolverine and help hold him once he is down. They later turn on Department H with the team when they learn it wants his skeleton.
stages.whoA: Shaman: his Alpha Flight teammate, the medicine man
stages.whoB: Puck: his short, tough Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Wolverine asks Vindicator what army will take him back, Puck answers as Alpha Flight arrives. Wolverine knocks him flat, and Puck later joins the revolt that frees Wolverine.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: the leader of his Alpha Flight team
stages.whoB: Puck: the tough little acrobat of his team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Heather and her husband Vindicator once nursed Wolverine back to health, and now both help Department H bring him in. When Heather quits to stop the dissection, Vindicator grabs her, and she begs Wolverine to spare her husband.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: her husband, James
stages.whoB: Heather: his wife

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: General Chasen has Alpha Flight, Sasquatch among them, bring Wolverine home, telling them he will rejoin the team. When they learn Chasen wants his skeleton, Sasquatch joins the raid on Chasen's lab and its android guards.
stages.whoA: Sasquatch: an Alpha Flight strongman who turns on him
stages.whoB: General Chasen: the Department H chief who lies to his team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: General Chasen has Northstar and Alpha Flight capture Wolverine, letting them believe he will rejoin the team. When they learn Chasen means to dissect him, Northstar turns on him and helps Wolverine escape.
stages.whoA: Northstar: an Alpha Flight speedster who turns on him
stages.whoB: General Chasen: the Department H chief who lies to his team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: General Chasen uses Shaman and Alpha Flight to track down Wolverine, and Shaman senses he is near. Learning that Chasen lied about Wolverine rejoining them, Shaman joins the team's raid on the lab.
stages.whoA: Shaman: Alpha Flight's medicine man, who turns on him
stages.whoB: General Chasen: the Department H chief who lies to his team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vindicator brings Wolverine in for General Chasen, believing Wolverine will rejoin Alpha Flight. When Chasen demands the skeleton, Vindicator holds Heather back and fights Wolverine, while Chasen orders the rest of his team subdued.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: the Alpha Flight leader who serves him
stages.whoB: General Chasen: his Department H commander

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In Logan's memories, Dr. Cornelius runs the adamantium feed while the Professor gives the orders. When Logan wakes in a rage, the Professor shouts at Cornelius to raise the sedative, but it is too late.
stages.whoA: The Professor: the man he answers to at the lab
stages.whoB: Dr. Cornelius: the scientist who runs his adamantium feed

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Spiral tells Mojo to go fetch the runaway Longshot himself, and Domo backs the sorceress's idea. He then reminds Mojo that they will need Spiral to cleave time and space for the trip.
stages.whoA: Spiral: the sorceress on Mojo's staff
stages.whoB: Domo: Mojo's deadpan right hand man

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ruckus and Vertigo both serve Sinister in the Savage Land, ambushing the powerless X-Men at their crashed jet. Ruckus taunts them to surrender while Vertigo makes Wolverine reel, but the X-Men win back their powers and the Nasty Boys flee.
stages.whoA: Vertigo: a dizzying fellow servant of Sinister
stages.whoB: Ruckus: a loud fellow servant of Sinister

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sinister calls Ruckus, Vertigo and Hairbag away after the Nasty Boys snatch Jean from her wedding. Later the pair fight the X-Men at the Axis of Time, until the psychics go free and Sinister's crew retreats.
stages.whoA: Vertigo: a dizzying fellow servant of Sinister
stages.whoB: Ruckus: a loud fellow servant of Sinister

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Barbarus and Brainchild ambush Xavier, Magneto and Ka-Zar in the secret passage to the citadel. Brainchild lets Ka-Zar run, content with the two prisoners they wanted. After the X-Men beat their master Sinister, the Mutates surrender.
stages.whoA: Brainchild: the big headed Mutate loyal to Sinister
stages.whoB: Barbarus: a four armed fellow Mutate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Barbarus leads the Mutates against Magneto, his creator, while Vertigo overwhelms him and Xavier with her power. Together they haul the pair to their new master, Sinister, but after the X-Men beat him the Mutates surrender.
stages.whoA: Vertigo: a fellow Mutate who throws foes off balance
stages.whoB: Barbarus: a four armed fellow Mutate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo and the other Mutates take Xavier and Magneto for their master, and Brainchild has the captives chained in Sinister's citadel. Both fight on for Sinister until Cyclops blasts him apart and Brainchild rushes to save him.
stages.whoA: Vertigo, a fellow Mutate who serves Sinister
stages.whoB: Brainchild, the Mutate who keeps Sinister's devices

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ruckus leads the Nasty Boys and the Mutates, Amphibius among them, in an ambush on the powerless X-Men in the Savage Land. They fight side by side for Sinister until the X-Men get their powers back.
stages.whoA: Ruckus, the Nasty Boy who leads the joint ambush
stages.whoB: Amphibius, a Mutate in his ambush on the X-Men

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius and the Mutates catch Xavier and Magneto sneaking into the citadel, and Brainchild orders the pair chained to the wall. Both serve Sinister until the X-Men break free and bring him down.
stages.whoA: Brainchild, the Mutate who keeps the citadel
stages.whoB: Amphibius, a Mutate who brings him captives

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius defies his old master Magneto, and Vertigo overwhelms Magneto and Xavier so the Mutates can take them to their new master. Later both fight the powerless X-Men, and Sinister boosts Vertigo with Magneto's strength.
stages.whoA: Vertigo, a fellow Mutate whose power fells his captives
stages.whoB: Amphibius, a fellow Mutate in the Savage Land

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag and Ruckus help the Nasty Boys spring Sinister's trap on Scott and Jean. In the Savage Land, Ruckus leads them against the powerless X-Men until the X-Men win back their powers.
stages.whoA: Ruckus, the loudmouth who leads the Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: Hairbag, a brawler in his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag and Ruckus help the Nasty Boys snatch Jean as she leaves her wedding, then carry her off through a portal. They later turn up with Sinister at the Axis of Time and retreat with him.
stages.whoA: Ruckus, a fellow Nasty Boy on the wedding raid
stages.whoB: Hairbag, a fellow Nasty Boy on the wedding raid

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo now runs with the Nasty Boys, and she and Hairbag help snatch Jean after her wedding, then slip away through a portal. Both later stand with Sinister at the Axis of Time.
stages.whoA: Vertigo, the newest member of the Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: Hairbag, a fellow Nasty Boy

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George and Ruckus spring Sinister's trap on Scott and Jean, and Ruckus floors Wolverine with a scream as the Nasty Boys carry Jean off. In the Savage Land, both beat the powerless X-Men, and George grabs Rogue.
stages.whoA: Ruckus, the loudmouth leading the Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: George, the gooey Nasty Boy at his side

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George's Nasty Boys and Vertigo's Mutates overwhelm the powerless X-Men and lock them up in Sinister's citadel. When Wolverine and Ka-Zar storm the cells, George and Vertigo try to keep the prisoners in.
stages.whoA: Vertigo, a Mutate who guards the captives with him
stages.whoB: George, a Nasty Boy who guards the captives with her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George and Hairbag help the Nasty Boys trap Jean for Sinister, then join the Savage Land ambush on the powerless X-Men. Both fight on until the X-Men win back their powers and the Nasty Boys flee.
stages.whoA: Hairbag, a fellow brawler in the Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: George, a stretchy fellow Nasty Boy

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Zaladane, Garokk's High Priestess, steers Sauron into bringing Storm to the Savage Land. At Garokk's command she frees Storm's power to feed him, then tells Sauron he has outlived his use.
stages.whoA: Zaladane, the High Priestess who serves him
stages.whoB: Garokk, the stone god she serves

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gog and Spiral chase Longshot to Earth for Mojo, but Wolverine helps drive their band off. When Mojo comes himself, both serve his televised hunt, and Mojo yells for them to save him from Longshot.
stages.whoA: Spiral, who leads the hunt for Longshot
stages.whoB: Gog, a hunter in her band

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator leads the Imperial Guard, Oracle among them, in Lilandra's duel with the X-Men on the Moon over Jean's fate. The Guard beats the X-Men down until the Phoenix flares up again and turns on Gladiator.
stages.whoA: Oracle, a psychic in the Imperial Guard he leads
stages.whoB: Gladiator, leader of the Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator leads the Imperial Guard into Lilandra's duel with the X-Men on the Moon, and the twin robot Warstar fights in his ranks. Warstar boasts that organics are too slow to beat it.
stages.whoA: Warstar, a twin robot in the Guard he leads
stages.whoB: Gladiator, leader of the Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Navigator serves aboard Raknar's ship and tracks the Starjammers for him, and he leaves the captive Cyclops in her care. She then shows Cyclops a faked log that proves Raknar plans to murder Jandra.
stages.whoA: Raknar, the corrupt commander she serves, then exposes
stages.whoB: Navigator, his officer who exposes his plot

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar chases Jandra to Earth, claiming Corsair abducted the witness, while he secretly works to silence her for the Lord Chamberlain. The X-Men expose his plan and he goes back to face Shi'ar justice.
stages.whoA: Raknar, the Shi'ar commander sent to silence her
stages.whoB: Jandra, the witness he is paid to silence

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar hunts the Starjammers, Ch'od among them, to Earth to get at the witness Jandra. Ch'od breaks radio silence with a coded call to Corsair that baits Raknar into a trap, then opens fire on him.
stages.whoA: Raknar, the corrupt commander he baits and fires on
stages.whoB: Ch'od, the Starjammer who springs the trap on him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ch'od and Raza crew Corsair's Starjammer and hide the witness Jandra on Earth from Raknar's patrol. Raza helps guard Jandra and a captive Storm, and Ch'od springs the trap on Raknar's ship.
stages.whoA: Raza, a swordsman in his Starjammers crew
stages.whoB: Ch'od, a fellow Starjammer

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ch'od and Hepzibah crew Corsair's Starjammer and hide the witness Jandra on Earth from Raknar's patrol. Hepzibah takes on Storm, and Ch'od springs the trap on Raknar's ship.
stages.whoA: Hepzibah, a catlike crewmate on the Starjammer
stages.whoB: Ch'od, a fellow Starjammer

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah hides Jandra from Raknar's patrol and ambushes Storm, believing the X-Men have sold the Starjammers out. Jandra welcomes her back and asks why the lady is tied up.
stages.whoA: Jandra, the young witness she protects
stages.whoB: Hepzibah, a Starjammer who guards her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah and Raza ambush Storm together, warning her to keep the weather calm, and hold her in the hideout where they guard Jandra. They believe Cyclops has sold them out to Raknar, until Navigator shows him the truth.
stages.whoA: Raza, a fellow Starjammer who ambushes Storm with her
stages.whoB: Hepzibah, a fellow Starjammer who ambushes Storm with him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raza guards Jandra in the Starjammers' hideout and helps Hepzibah take Storm captive. Jandra is glad to see them back and asks why the lady is tied up.
stages.whoA: Raza, a Starjammer who guards her
stages.whoB: Jandra, the young witness he guards

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amelia Voght and Byron Calley serve on Asteroid M after Cortez seizes it. Cortez orders Calley to fire the missiles at Earth, and Calley refuses. When Cortez turns on him, Amelia stops him.
stages.whoA: Asteroid M's missile officer, whom she saves from Cortez
stages.whoB: The Asteroid M resident who stops Cortez from killing him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Leech's flight from a mob draws Cyclops and Jean to the Morlocks, and Annalee lulls them to sleep for Callisto. Below, Leech switches off Cyclops' powers.
stages.whoA: A Morlock boy who helps draw Cyclops below
stages.whoB: The Morlock whose song lulls Cyclops to sleep

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: With Leech gravely ill and refused by a hospital, Annalee helps steal an ambulance for medicine and begs Storm for help. A transfusion of Wolverine's blood saves the boy.
stages.whoA: The sick Morlock boy she fights to save
stages.whoB: A Morlock who steals an ambulance to save him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee's song puts Cyclops and Jean to sleep, and Callisto sends Sunder to carry them below. Both serve Callisto when the X-Men come to the rescue.
stages.whoA: The Morlock strongman who carries her captives below
stages.whoB: The Morlock who lulls his captives to sleep

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pooyetah overrules Kiyoek, who wants to trade the half frozen Wolverine for a reward, and later scolds his jealousy. Kiyoek then helps Wolverine save Pooyetah and the others from Sabretooth.
stages.whoA: The elder of his camp, whose word is law
stages.whoB: A jealous young man of his camp

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bantam rides with Fitzroy to wreck Forge's time portal for Master Mold. In 1959, warned that Master Mold will destroy them both, Fitzroy gives up the hit on Xavier and flees with Bantam.
stages.whoA: His partner, who spares Xavier to save them both
stages.whoB: His partner on Master Mold's time mission

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Master Mold sends Bantam and Fitzroy to destroy Forge's time portal. Then he orders Nimrod to kill the pair once the job is done.
stages.whoA: The Sentinel master who plans to have him killed
stages.whoB: Fitzroy's partner, whom he marks for death

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Master Mold distrusts Fitzroy and sends Nimrod with him to 1959 to kill Xavier. When Fitzroy reports success, Master Mold sends him after Forge's portal and secretly orders Nimrod to kill him.
stages.whoA: The Sentinel master who plans to betray him
stages.whoB: The mutant assassin he means to discard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The High Evolutionary checks Wanda's DNA, sends her after Magneto and then traps her in Wundagore. He uses her powers to breed his new race and tells her Magneto is her father.
stages.whoA: Pietro's twin, whose powers he uses for his new race
stages.whoB: The master of Wundagore who traps her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The High Evolutionary confirms Pietro's identity by his DNA, sends him after Magneto, then captures him. He uses Pietro's speed for his new race and names Magneto as his father.
stages.whoA: Wanda's twin, whose speed he uses for his new race
stages.whoB: The master of Wundagore who traps him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pietro and Wanda learn from Django that they were adopted and seek the truth in Wundagore together. They attack Magneto to avenge their mother, then learn he is their father.
stages.whoA: His twin sister
stages.whoB: Her twin brother

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bova, the midwife who left the newborn Wanda with Django, tells her how her mother fled a mutant and died. She warns that the name brings suffering, then names Magneto.
stages.whoA: One of the twins she once placed with Django
stages.whoB: The midwife who cared for her as a baby

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The High Evolutionary, master of Wundagore and maker of its creatures, brings the twins to Bova. After her story, he agrees revenge brings bloodshed, yet sends his creatures with them.
stages.whoA: The master of Wundagore who made her
stages.whoB: The midwife of Wundagore, one of his creations

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bova tells Pietro and his sister how their mother fled a mutant, left them with her and died. When the twins demand a name, she gives them Magneto.
stages.whoA: One of the twins she once placed with Django
stages.whoB: The midwife who cared for him as a baby

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: From his hospital bed, Django tells Wanda that he and Marya raised her but are not her real parents. He sends her and Pietro to find the midwife Bova in Wundagore.
stages.whoA: The daughter he raised
stages.whoB: The man who raised her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: From his hospital bed, Django tells Pietro that he and Marya raised him but are not his real parents. He sends him and Wanda to find the midwife Bova in Wundagore.
stages.whoA: The son he raised
stages.whoB: The man who raised him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Yoshida scolds Soichi for training villagers to fight and insists they keep paying the Silver Samurai. Soichi defies him, rallies the people to resist and wins.
stages.whoA: The village elder who wants to keep paying
stages.whoB: The hotheaded young man who defies him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kisara introduces her wild brother Soichi to Logan at the village feast. She backs his fight against the Silver Samurai and begs Logan to help him.
stages.whoA: Her hotheaded brother
stages.whoB: His sister

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: At the feast for Logan, village elder Yoshida sends Kisara to show the guest to the table. She later asks Logan to help the fight that Yoshida wants to avoid.
stages.whoA: The elder of her village
stages.whoB: A young woman of his village

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Master Oku brings Logan to the village feast and introduces him to Yoshida. Trusting the monk, Yoshida welcomes the stranger too.
stages.whoA: The elder of the nearby fishing village
stages.whoB: The monk whose word he trusts

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Talos tries to capture Maverick and the others for reprogramming. Maverick scans the robot for its power source and plants a thermite grenade inside its armor.
stages.whoA: The failsafe robot that tries to reprogram him
stages.whoB: One of the subjects it is set to recapture

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Silver Fox and Maverick lure Logan back to the Weapon X ruins to learn what was done to their minds. She directs the fight against Talos, and Maverick plants the grenade.
stages.whoA: His old comrade, plagued by the same false memories
stages.whoB: Her old comrade from the Weapon X days

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Toad is Solarr's enforcer in Skull Mesa and keeps Dr. Prescott frozen in his resin. On Solarr's order he and Lambert drag Cyclops into town for execution.
stages.whoA: The resin slinging thug who does his dirty work
stages.whoB: The boss of his gang in Skull Mesa

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Solarr seizes Skull Mesa's gold mine, and when Dr. Prescott opposes him, has him frozen in Toad's resin. When the town turns on Solarr, Prescott is freed and decides the town will judge him.
stages.whoA: Skull Mesa's founder, the one man who opposed him
stages.whoB: The mutant who seized his town and froze him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Solarr orders Watchdog to shoot down Cyclops' plane, and Watchdog jams his call for help. As the town rises, Watchdog turns on Solarr and calls in the X-Men.
stages.whoA: The guard who downs Cyclops' plane, then turns on him
stages.whoB: The boss he serves, then turns against

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Tusk, a mechanic who fixes Solarr's generator, is too scared to help Cyclops at first. When the town rises, he is among the first to rebel against Solarr.
stages.whoA: A frightened mechanic who rises against him
stages.whoB: The mutant whose gang rules his town

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Toad's resin keeps Dr. Prescott in suspended animation for Solarr. Prescott is freed when the townsfolk overthrow Solarr's gang.
stages.whoA: Solarr's thug, whose resin keeps him frozen
stages.whoB: The doctor he keeps frozen for Solarr

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Chet Lambert echoes every word as Braddock warns Cyclops to leave Skull Mesa. Once Braddock shows himself as Solarr, Lambert drags Cyclops out for execution on his order.
stages.whoA: His boss, Bill Braddock, who calls himself Solarr
stages.whoB: The henchman who echoes his every word

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Lambert and Toad are Solarr's partners in seizing Skull Mesa. Together they mock and beat the powerless Cyclops, then drag him to the center of town.
stages.whoA: His fellow thug in Solarr's gang
stages.whoB: His fellow thug in Solarr's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Solarr frightens Dr. Tanaka into silence about Prescott and keeps the whole town in fear. When Cyclops faces execution, Tanaka at last stands against Solarr.
stages.whoA: The tyrant who frightens him into silence
stages.whoB: The town doctor he cows into silence

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Muir Island, Amelia runs tests for the virus Beast designs with Warlock's help, then flees the Phalanx with them. She helps the strike team reach the core, where Warlock carries the virus in.
stages.whoA: The Phalanx heir whose virus she helps finish
stages.whoB: Amelia, the Muir Island resident on his strike team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: At Sid's Grill, Pietro doubts Beast's story until Warlock assimilates a fork to prove it. Then his Lifemate, in the Phalanx's grip, attacks the diner, and the Phalanx soon takes Pietro.
stages.whoA: The alien who proves the Phalanx threat to him
stages.whoB: Pietro, the doubter he wins over at the diner

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Warlock knows Hodge as the human who abducted his Lifemate, and Hodge boasts of being the Phalanx guide on Earth. Warlock then carries the virus into the core and purges the Phalanx.
stages.whoA: The runaway heir whose virus purges the Phalanx
stages.whoB: Hodge, the Phalanx guide who took his Lifemate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hodge serves as development adviser to the Leader's slaving regime and briefs Gyrich on the rebel Cable. When Cable stops their getaway car, the Leader orders Hodge to blast him before the flood hits.
stages.whoA: The Leader whose slaving regime he advises
stages.whoB: Hodge, his adviser who flees the flood with him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Justine lets Logan into her hideout, where Sawyer briefs him on freeing Andre Cocteau from the Chateau du Mort. Together they send Logan off, and Justine reveals that Cocteau is her father.
stages.whoA: Justine, whose hideout hosts his briefing
stages.whoB: The Allied captain who briefs Logan in her hideout

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sam refuses to leave his pa in a mine cave in and blasts them both free. Ed urges his boy toward a better life, then stands up for him when the town turns on the Guthries.
stages.whoA: Sam, his son who blasts him out of the mine
stages.whoB: Pa, the miner he refuses to leave behind

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ellen frets over her son and his father working the mines and tells Sam to think about his future. When the town drives the Guthries out, she packs up to leave with him.
stages.whoA: Sam, the son she wants out of the mines
stages.whoB: Ma, who pushes him to look past the mines

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kirkland visits the Guthries and presses Sam to join a government program like a Peace Corps for mutants. Once he has Sam, he calls Xavier and Beast terrorists, but Sam sees the trick, escapes and warns his family.
stages.whoA: The boy he wants for his living weapons program
stages.whoB: Kirkland, the recruiter who tries to use him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: James tends Rebecca as the family physician of Grey Hall and marvels at her sudden recovery. Rebecca then lets slip that Nathaniel has been giving her secret treatments.
stages.whoA: Rebecca, the ailing patient he cannot cure
stages.whoB: James, her family physician

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: James frees the mutants Essex holds at Grey Hall and finds the frightened Flannery hiding from a mob. He calms him and tells the crowd Flannery is no demon but a man born different.
stages.whoA: Flannery, the frightened mutant he shields
stages.whoB: James, the doctor who frees him and defends him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: When the Sinister Six take hostages at the Metro Bank, Carter and DeWolff are ordered to move in together. The two partners join the police fight against the escaped villains.
stages.whoA: Carter, her partner on patrol
stages.whoB: DeWolff, his partner on patrol

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: DeWolff and Sergeant Carter take Flash and Harry on a police ride-along. Carter agrees with Flash that Spider-Man is a hero, while DeWolff argues that he goes too far.
stages.whoA: Sergeant Carter, her partner who cheers on Spider-Man
stages.whoB: DeWolff, his partner who thinks Spider-Man goes too far

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: During the mass breakout from Ryker's Island, Hammerhead calls Ox and Fancy Dan to his side while Montana stays behind. The two Enforcers escape together with him.
stages.whoA: Ox, his hulking fellow Enforcer
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, his fellow Enforcer

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man finds Fancy Dan and his little pal Ox caged in the Vault and teases them. Once the cells open, the two Enforcers join Silvermane's posse of prisoners hunting him.
stages.whoA: Ox, his cellblock partner in the Vault
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, his cellblock partner in the Vault

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: At the Thanksgiving parade, quarterback Flash calls an audible and pulls the Mustangs off their balloon to help. Rand follows his lead, and the team catches Gwen when Venom hurls her down.
stages.whoA: Rand, a Mustangs teammate who follows his call
stages.whoB: Flash, the quarterback who leads the Mustangs

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: On Valentine's Day, Flash begs Peter to kick him whenever he says something dumb in front of Sha Shan. She tells him she likes him for who he is, an honest guy, and they dance.
stages.whoA: Sha Shan, the girl he finally wins over
stages.whoB: Flash, the honest guy she agrees to dance with

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Glory comes to the fall formal as Harry's date after dumping Kenny. Kenny admits he was a jerk and begs for one more chance, and Glory takes him back.
stages.whoA: Kenny, the boyfriend she takes back at the formal
stages.whoB: Glory, the girlfriend he wins back with an apology

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Jones greets Vuk when she reaches Earth and reports what he has learned. He tells her the power they hunt is inside a young mutant who does not understand it, and Vuk sees a way to use her.
stages.whoA: The D'Bari leader he reports to
stages.whoB: Her lieutenant waiting on Earth

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
