stages.text: In 1975, young Jean rides in the family car with her mother, Elaine, and the radio keeps changing. Jean's powers flare out of control and crash the car, and Elaine dies.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, whose powers cause the crash
stages.whoB: Her mother, killed in the 1975 crash

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Elaine and her husband, John, drive with their daughter Jean in 1975. Jean's powers crash the car, killing Elaine, while John survives.
stages.whoA: Her husband, who survives the crash
stages.whoB: His wife, killed in the 1975 crash

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Wade arrives at Essex House as an X-Men trainee and mocks Daniel while trying to calm Russell. Sure the boy was abused, Wade shoots Daniel dead, and Wade and Russell are sent to the Ice Box.
stages.whoA: The X-Men trainee who shoots him
stages.whoB: The Essex House orderly he shoots dead

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Russell rages at Essex House while Daniel and the headmaster wait to take him back inside. Wade asks Russell if the staff hurt him, then kills Daniel.
stages.whoA: The young mutant in his care
stages.whoB: An orderly at the orphanage that hurt him

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Daniel stands beside the headmaster as police and the X-Men face Russell at Essex House. The headmaster insists the boy belongs in their care, until Wade shoots Daniel.
stages.whoA: The headmaster he works under
stages.whoB: His orderly at Essex House

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Jackson and his Canewood men block Will's water pump and call him a trespasser, but Logan runs them off. Jackson returns to the farm that night with guns, shouting for Will.
stages.whoA: The farmer who will not sell to Canewood
stages.whoB: The Canewood enforcer at his pump

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: At Will's water pump, Jackson calls Logan hired muscle and will not leave. Logan counts to three and breaks the rifle, and Jackson's men flee.
stages.whoA: Will's guest who beats his men
stages.whoB: A Canewood enforcer he runs off

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Jackson returns to the Munson farm at night and mistakes X-24 for Logan, offering him work with Canewood. X-24 ignores the offer and kills Jackson and his men.
stages.whoA: The clone who kills him at the farm
stages.whoB: A Canewood enforcer he kills at the farm

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: William hides his daughter Dani as their reservation is destroyed and goes back to help others, and he dies. Later, in a vision, he tells her it was not her fault and that she must wake up and face the bear.
stages.whoA: His daughter, the last survivor
stages.whoB: Her father, killed on the reservation

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: The Demon Bear tears through the reservation and kills William as he tries to help. In Dani's mind he urges her to face the bear, and she takes control of it.
stages.whoA: The beast that kills him
stages.whoB: Dani's father, one of its victims

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: In 1944, guards pull Edie away from her young son at the gate of a Nazi camp. As they drag her off, his power bends the iron gate toward her.
stages.whoA: Her son, torn from her at the camp
stages.whoB: His mother, taken from him in 1944

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Edie is pulled from Erik at the camp gate, then brought to Schmidt's office. She tells Erik everything is all right, and Schmidt shoots her when he cannot move the coin.
stages.whoA: Her son Erik, forced to watch her die
stages.whoB: His mother, shot by Schmidt

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Schmidt has Edie brought to his office and counts to three while Erik tries to move a coin. When the coin stays still, he shoots her to unlock Erik's anger.
stages.whoA: The Nazi doctor who shoots her
stages.whoB: Erik's mother, whom he shoots

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Heather and her husband Travis take the stranger Logan into their farmhouse, feed him and give him their son's clothes. The next morning Agent Zero kills them both.
stages.whoA: Her husband on the farm
stages.whoB: His wife, who sets supper for Logan

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Heather spots Logan naked in the barn, and she and Travis give him clothes, supper and a bed. The next morning she admires him in her son's jacket just before Agent Zero shoots her.
stages.whoA: The stranger she takes in
stages.whoB: The farmer's wife who takes him in

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Agent Zero tracks Logan to the farm and opens fire. He kills Heather and Travis while hunting the man they sheltered.
stages.whoA: The Weapon X gunman who kills her
stages.whoB: An old woman he kills hunting Logan

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Living as Henryk Gurzsky in Poland, Erik married Magda and told her who he was the night they met. When his powers are seen, he wants to flee and she wants to stay, then the police come and she dies with Nina.
stages.whoA: Her husband, living as Henryk Gurzsky
stages.whoB: His wife in Poland, who knew his secret

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Magda goes to fetch Nina when Erik says they must leave, and finds her gone. In the woods she holds her frightened daughter as Nina's birds attack the police, and one arrow kills them both.
stages.whoA: Her young daughter
stages.whoB: Her mother

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: When three strangers come asking for Peter, his mother takes them for police again and calls him down. She offers to write a check for whatever he took.
stages.whoA: Her speedster son, often in trouble
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Ten years later, she checks on Peter at home as the news reports Magneto's attack. She sees he means to go after him and warns that nothing ends well with him.
stages.whoA: Her son, set on finding Magneto
stages.whoB: His mother, who warns him off Magneto

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Trask warns Nixon that Mystique could pose as anyone, even him, and pitches his Sentinels, and Nixon gives him whatever he needs. After the unveiling goes wrong, Nixon rages in the bunker that the world now knows they cannot protect it.
stages.whoA: His adviser on the Sentinels
stages.whoB: The President who backs his Sentinels

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Erik turns the Sentinels on the crowd at Nixon's unveiling and tears the bunker out of the White House with Nixon inside. He tells the world that mutants are the future before Mystique stops him.
stages.whoA: The mutant who seizes his Sentinels
stages.whoB: The President he holds at his mercy

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Mystique slips into Nixon's bunker as a Secret Service agent. When Erik holds everyone at his mercy, she takes Nixon's form, brings Erik down with a plastic gun and spares Trask, saving the President.
stages.whoA: The mutant who saves his life
stages.whoB: The President she saves from Erik

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Kid Omega mocks Magneto as a tough talker in a cape at his rally, then follows him into the Brotherhood. Magneto sends him to Jean's house and later into Worthington Labs at Alcatraz.
stages.whoA: The leader he follows into battle
stages.whoB: An Omega who joins his Brotherhood

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Callisto leads Kid Omega's gang to Magneto's rally, and they join the Brotherhood together. They stand guard at Jean's house and storm Alcatraz side by side.
stages.whoA: The leader of his gang
stages.whoB: A spiked member of her gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: At the rally, Kid Omega pops his spikes as Pyro lights a fireball, until their leaders stop them. Soon both fight for Magneto's Brotherhood.
stages.whoA: Magneto's fire wielder, later a teammate
stages.whoB: The Omega who squares off with him

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Storm swoops down outside Jean's house and knocks Kid Omega and Arclight down before she takes on Callisto.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who knocks him down
stages.whoB: A Brotherhood mutant she knocks down

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: At Alcatraz, Kid Omega grabs Dr. Rao as she begs for Warren Worthington II's life, hugs her and kills her with his spikes.
stages.whoA: The scientist he kills
stages.whoB: The mutant who kills her

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Warren finds his young son trying to cut off his wings. Years later, he brings Warren in as the first to take the cure, but Warren breaks free and flies away. At Alcatraz, his son catches him in midair when he is thrown off a roof.
stages.whoA: His winged son
stages.whoB: His father, who made the cure

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Dr. Rao works on the cure at Worthington Labs and readies the injection for Warren's son. When the Brotherhood storms Alcatraz, the two flee together until Kid Omega kills her.
stages.whoA: His scientist on the cure
stages.whoB: Her employer, head of Worthington Labs

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Kid Omega corners Warren and Dr. Rao inside the labs at Alcatraz. When Warren says he only wanted to help, Kid Omega asks if they look like they need help, and Warren is thrown off the roof.
stages.whoA: The mutant who throws him off a roof
stages.whoB: The maker of the cure he tries to kill

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Bobby comes home with Logan, Rogue and John and tells his parents he is a mutant. Madeline struggles with the news and asks if he has tried not being one. Ronny's call brings the police, and Bobby leaves with the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Her son, who tells her he is a mutant
stages.whoB: His mother, who struggles with the news

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Madeline and William come home to find a stranger in their kitchen. Together they hear Bobby say he is a mutant, and admit they thought he was at a school for the gifted.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Madeline and her younger son Ronny hear Bobby say he is a mutant. Ronny secretly calls the police, who break into the house.
stages.whoA: Her younger son
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: X2
stages.text: William demands to know who the stranger in his kitchen is, and Bobby says he is Professor Logan. William thought Bobby was at a school for the gifted, and the news that his son is a mutant leaves him at a loss before the police arrive.
stages.whoA: His son, who tells him he is a mutant
stages.whoB: His father

stages.title: X2
stages.text: William and his younger son Ronny come home to find Logan in the kitchen and hear Bobby's news. Ronny then calls the police on his brother.
stages.whoA: His younger son
stages.whoB: His father

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Under Stryker's control, Kurt teleports through the White House and nearly kills McKenna, leaving a knife marked for mutant freedom before he is shot and escapes. Later he stands with the X-Men in McKenna's office.
stages.whoA: The mutant who tried to kill him
stages.whoB: The President he was forced to attack

stages.title: X2
stages.text: After the attack, Stryker asks McKenna to authorize a special operation and shows him evidence of a mutant training facility in upstate New York. McKenna lets him go ahead, and later the X-Men hand him Stryker's files.
stages.whoA: The colonel whose raid he approves
stages.whoB: The President who approves his raid

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Xavier freezes McKenna's office before an address and hands him Stryker's private files. He warns that a war is coming and that humans and mutants must work together, and leaves the next move to McKenna.
stages.whoA: The mutant who brings him Stryker's files
stages.whoB: The President he warns of war

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: At the subway where Jose Quesada died, Detective Manolis tells Urich he is wasting his time and that there is no proof Daredevil even exists. He brushes Urich off again at Nikolas Natchios's murder scene.
stages.whoA: The reporter who keeps chasing Daredevil
stages.whoB: Detective Manolis, who calls Daredevil a legend

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Manolis works the scene after Bullseye murders Nikolas Natchios. Later he leads the police into the church where Bullseye is fighting Daredevil, and a police sniper shoots Bullseye through both hands.
stages.whoA: The killer the police take down at the church
stages.whoB: Manolis, the detective whose police storm the church

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Stoltz serves on Agent Woo's team, pushing Bill Foster too hard until Woo stops him. He brings Woo a lead on Hank and Hope, leads the raid that arrests them, and is found dead after the lab is stolen.
stages.whoA: His boss, who never learns he is crooked
stages.whoB: Stoltz, the agent who secretly works for Burch

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Burch pays Stoltz, his special friend at the FBI, for inside information. Burch gives him the location of Hank and Hope in exchange for the lab, and Stoltz agrees.
stages.whoA: The dealer who pays him to leak
stages.whoB: Stoltz, his paid mole in the FBI

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: As Stoltz loads Hank's shrunken lab into his car for Burch, Ghost phases her hand into his chest and kills him, then takes the lab.
stages.whoA: The phasing thief who kills him
stages.whoB: Stoltz, the agent she kills for the lab

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Stoltz leads the FBI raid in the woods and arrests Hank and Hope when they shrink their lab. He then slips away with the lab to hand it to Burch.
stages.whoA: The scientist he arrests and robs
stages.whoB: Stoltz, the agent who arrests him

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Burch learns about Hope's fake identity through Stoltz. Stoltz later surrounds her with FBI agents, arrests her and Hank, and takes their lab.
stages.whoA: The woman he arrests for Burch
stages.whoB: Stoltz, Burch's mole in the FBI

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Rumlow orders Klein to launch the helicarriers, and Klein refuses, saying Captain's orders. Rumlow pulls a gun on him, and the standoff turns into a gunfight.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA agent who pulls a gun on him
stages.whoB: Klein, the technician who will not launch

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When Rumlow threatens Klein for refusing to launch, Sharon draws on Rumlow and repeats Captain's orders. She keeps Klein alive as the shooting starts.
stages.whoA: The agent who saves his life
stages.whoB: Klein, the technician she protects

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Fury brings an old helicarrier out of mothballs with a few old friends, Klein among them. Klein runs the lifeboat launch and reports to Fury as Sokovians fill the boats.
stages.whoA: The director who brings him back
stages.whoB: Klein, who launches his lifeboats

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Klein and Hill work the helicarrier bridge over Sokovia, launching lifeboats and taking on refugees. When Ultron's drones attack the bridge, Hill and Fury fight them off.
stages.whoA: His fellow agent on Fury's bridge
stages.whoB: Klein, the lifeboat technician

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: In a vision Wanda forces on her, Natasha relives her Red Room training under Madame B., who drives her to break and tells her the graduation ceremony will give her a place in the world. Natasha later tells Bruce the ceremony sterilized her.
stages.whoA: The girl she trains to kill
stages.whoB: Madame B., her Red Room trainer

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Limbani poses as a medic with Klaue to rob a London museum of a vibranium axe. He helps break Klaue out of CIA custody, and at the airfield Killmonger shoots him when Klaue refuses to take him to Wakanda.
stages.whoA: The boss he robs and shoots for
stages.whoB: Limbani, one of his gunmen

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Limbani works with Killmonger on the museum robbery and Klaue's escape. When Klaue refuses to take Killmonger to Wakanda, Killmonger shoots Limbani dead.
stages.whoA: The partner who kills him
stages.whoB: Limbani, Klaue's gunman he shoots

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Limbani and Linda rob the London museum with Klaue and Killmonger, then help free Klaue from the CIA. Both die at the airfield.
stages.whoA: Killmonger's partner on the job
stages.whoB: Limbani, a gunman on the same job

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Sope gives Killmonger the Heart-Shaped Herb and helps him breathe when he wakes. When she refuses to burn the garden, he chokes her until she obeys.
stages.whoA: The new king who makes her burn the herbs
stages.whoB: The shaman he forces to burn the herbs

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Sope and Zawavari lead Wakanda's rites, from T'Challa's funeral to the coronation they prepare for Shuri. Shuri never comes, and M'Baku claims the challenge.
stages.whoA: The elder who presents the new ruler
stages.whoB: Sope, the shaman at her side

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zawavari laughs when Killmonger asks the council for the throne, then falls silent when he names himself N'Jadaka. After he beats T'Challa, she must bow to him and hear his plan to arm the world.
stages.whoA: The outsider she laughs at, then must obey
stages.whoB: Zawavari, the elder who laughs at him

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zawavari's Mining Tribe declines to challenge at T'Challa's coronation, and she sits on his council. She watches in horror as Killmonger throws him from the falls.
stages.whoA: The king she serves on the council
stages.whoB: Zawavari, the Mining Tribe elder

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zawavari and Ramonda sit together on the council when Killmonger demands the throne. Ramonda calls him a charlatan, and both watch him take Wakanda.
stages.whoA: The queen mother on the council
stages.whoB: Zawavari, a council elder

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Zawavari stands at T'Challa's funeral as Ramonda becomes queen. She serves on Ramonda's council as Namor's threat grows.
stages.whoA: The queen she serves
stages.whoB: Zawavari, an elder on her council

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: With the elders sheltering with M'Baku, Zawavari presses them to choose a ruler. At the coronation she presents Shuri, but M'Baku steps up instead to challenge for the throne.
stages.whoA: The Jabari leader who claims the challenge
stages.whoB: Zawavari, the elder at the coronation

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Dr. Graham greets Smitty on the rig, surprised he is out of retirement, and they run the vibranium dive together. When the attack comes they put in earplugs and run, and Smitty dies on a spear.
stages.whoA: The CIA officer she works with on the rig
stages.whoB: Dr. Graham, his colleague on the dive

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Dr. Graham guides Salazar to the drill site on the seabed and tells her to bring up the detector. Salazar reports that Jackson is gone, then her signal dies.
stages.whoA: The diver she directs on the seabed
stages.whoB: Dr. Graham, who directs her dive

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Dr. Graham escapes the blue attackers in a helicopter and reports that they were not Wakandans. Namor grabs the helicopter and drags it into the sea, killing her.
stages.whoA: The blue attacker who kills her
stages.whoB: Dr. Graham, a CIA scientist he kills

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Steve frees Jones from the HYDRA camp, and Jones asks who he is supposed to be. Steve invites him into his new team, Jones agrees, and he serves under Captain America on the raids against HYDRA.
stages.whoA: His commander, Captain America
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, one of his Howling Commandos

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Escaping the HYDRA camp, Jones reads the German controls of a stolen tank so Dugan can drive it. They join the Howling Commandos together and fight HYDRA across Europe.
stages.whoA: A fellow Howling Commando
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, a fellow Howling Commando

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Jones and Dernier break out of the HYDRA camp together. In the pub, Jones talks Steve's offer over with Dernier in French, and both join the Howling Commandos.
stages.whoA: The French Commando he talks with in French
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, who talks with him in French

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: In the escape from the HYDRA camp, Jones reads the controls of a stolen tank while Falsworth rides on top. Both join the Howling Commandos and storm HYDRA's last base.
stages.whoA: A fellow Commando from the tank
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, who reads the tank's controls

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Jones tracks Zola's train and tells Steve the HYDRA scientist is aboard. On the train, the Commandos take Zola prisoner.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA scientist he helps capture
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, a Commando who captures him

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Steve frees Dernier from the HYDRA camp and asks him to join his team. Dernier agrees and serves under Captain America, blowing up a HYDRA tank on one raid.
stages.whoA: His commander, Captain America
stages.whoB: Jacques Dernier, one of his Howling Commandos

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dernier and Dugan escape the HYDRA camp together and join Steve's Howling Commandos. They fight side by side on the raids that end at HYDRA's last base.
stages.whoA: A fellow Howling Commando
stages.whoB: Jacques Dernier, a fellow Howling Commando

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Freed by Steve at the HYDRA camp, Falsworth answers his introduction with a puzzled I beg your pardon. He joins Steve's Howling Commandos and follows him into HYDRA's last base.
stages.whoA: His commander, Captain America
stages.whoB: Falsworth, one of his Howling Commandos

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Falsworth shouts at Dugan to get the stolen tank going and rides on top as they escape. They join the Howling Commandos together and raid HYDRA's bases.
stages.whoA: A fellow Commando from the tank
stages.whoB: Falsworth, a fellow Howling Commando

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Sergeant Duffy drills Steve with the other recruits and yells at him to fall in. When Steve topples the flagpole and brings him the flag, Duffy has to let him ride back with Agent Carter.
stages.whoA: His drill sergeant at camp
stages.whoB: A skinny recruit he drills

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Sergeant Duffy drills Hodge with the other recruits and cheers him on up the flagpole. Hodge fails, and Steve takes the flag instead.
stages.whoA: His drill sergeant at camp
stages.whoB: A big recruit he cheers on

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Colonel Phillips watches over the recruits that Sergeant Duffy drills at camp. When Phillips throws a dummy grenade into the drill, Duffy sends the men back into formation.
stages.whoA: The colonel in charge of his recruits
stages.whoB: His drill sergeant at camp

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Singh calls for a hearing on the hijacking and later suggests Fury lied to Pierce. When Steve exposes HYDRA, Singh orders Pierce's arrest, defies his plea, and dies when Pierce sets off his badge.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA leader who kills him
stages.whoB: A councilman he kills with a badge bomb

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When HYDRA is exposed, Singh orders Rollins to arrest Pierce. Rollins turns his gun on Singh instead.
stages.whoA: The STRIKE agent who turns his gun on him
stages.whoB: A councilman he holds at gunpoint

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Natasha sits on the Council disguised as Hawley and stops Pierce from shooting Singh. Singh watches her dump S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets before the badge bomb kills him.
stages.whoA: The disguised agent who saves him from Pierce
stages.whoB: A councilman she saves from Pierce

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Norex follows Talos to Earth and stands with him at the Rambeau home. Talos calls him his science guy, and Norex offers to handle the jet's modifications.
stages.whoA: His Skrull commander
stages.whoB: His science officer

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Norex chases Vers to Earth with Talos, then helps her once the Skrulls make peace. He refits the jet for her trip and stays behind posing as her to buy her time.
stages.whoA: The woman he chases, then poses as to save her
stages.whoB: The Skrull who poses as her to cover her escape

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Norex comes to Maria's home posing as her, then helps her and Carol. He refits the stolen jet so Maria can fly it into space.
stages.whoA: The pilot who flies the jet he refits
stages.whoB: The Skrull who refits the jet she flies

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Posing as Carol, Norex stalls Yon-Rogg with her code and her memories. He fails a question about her transfusion, tells Yon-Rogg he is too late, and is shot dead.
stages.whoA: The Kree commander who kills him
stages.whoB: A Skrull who poses as Carol

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Brahl serves in Yondu's crew and guards him on Contraxia. He joins Taserface's mutiny, and Yondu kills him with his arrow as he takes back the ship.
stages.whoA: His captain, then the man who kills him
stages.whoB: A Ravager who turns on him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Brahl backs Taserface when he turns the Ravagers against Yondu. He serves in Taserface's mutiny until Yondu's arrow kills him.
stages.whoA: The Ravager who leads his mutiny
stages.whoB: A Ravager who backs his mutiny

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: On Berhert, Brahl corners Rocket after his traps run out and mocks him for losing his toys. Rocket knocks him out in a fistfight.
stages.whoA: The raccoon he corners on Berhert
stages.whoB: A Ravager he knocks out

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Yondu's funeral, Stakar says Yondu would be proud to see his old team back together. Mainframe happily rejoins, saying she missed them all.
stages.whoA: Stakar, who brings her old team back together
stages.whoB: Mainframe, a captain on his old team

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Martinex and Mainframe are both captains on Stakar's old team. They reunite after Yondu's death and agree to steal together again.
stages.whoA: Martinex, a fellow captain on Stakar's team
stages.whoB: Mainframe, a fellow captain on Stakar's team

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Mainframe and Martinex ride with the United Ravagers who board the Guardians' ship. Mainframe gives the warning before the Ravagers storm aboard.
stages.whoA: Martinex, a fellow captain in the United Ravagers
stages.whoB: Mainframe, a fellow captain in the United Ravagers

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Mainframe tells the Guardians to surrender or die as the United Ravagers board them. Quill protests that he is one of them, and it turns out Gamora is waiting.
stages.whoA: Peter Quill, an old Ravager she threatens to board
stages.whoB: Mainframe, who warns him he is being boarded

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Tullk is a veteran of Yondu's crew and defends him when Taserface calls him soft. When the mutiny comes, he is beaten and thrown out an airlock as the bound Yondu watches.
stages.whoA: Yondu, the captain he dies loyal to
stages.whoB: Tullk, a loyal veteran of his crew

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Tullk warns Taserface to be careful what he says about their captain. Taserface leads the mutiny anyway and has Tullk thrown out an airlock.
stages.whoA: Taserface, the mutineer who has him killed
stages.whoB: Tullk, a Yondu loyalist he has killed

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Tullk and Kraglin sit together when Taserface whispers that Yondu has gone soft. Kraglin's outburst helps start the mutiny that kills Tullk, which Kraglin then regrets.
stages.whoA: Kraglin, a crewmate on Yondu's ship
stages.whoB: Tullk, a crewmate killed in the mutiny

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Behemoth guards the High Evolutionary and stands beside him when Quill comes to bargain. When the Guardians attack his ship, the High Evolutionary sends the Hellspawn out against Knowhere.
stages.whoA: The High Evolutionary, who made and commands him
stages.whoB: Behemoth, one of his Hellspawn guards

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Behemoth and War Pig guard the gate to the High Evolutionary's lab together. War Pig clears Quill to enter while Behemoth keeps Nebula out over her gun arm.
stages.whoA: War Pig, a fellow Hellspawn guard
stages.whoB: Behemoth, a fellow Hellspawn guard

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: At the lab's gate, Behemoth scans Nebula and tells her she must stay outside because her arm is a gun. Nebula is left waiting while Quill and Groot go in.
stages.whoA: Nebula, whom he bars from the lab
stages.whoB: Behemoth, the guard who keeps her outside

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kraglin fights Behemoth's Hellspawn on Knowhere with Yondu's arrow, but Behemoth dodges it. As Behemoth closes in, Cosmo steps in to protect Kraglin.
stages.whoA: Kraglin, the Ravager he nearly kills
stages.whoB: Behemoth, the Hellspawn who corners him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Behemoth laughs when a dog stands between him and Kraglin. Kraglin tells him she is a good dog, and Cosmo crushes him with two slabs of rock.
stages.whoA: Cosmo, the dog who crushes him
stages.whoB: Behemoth, the Hellspawn she crushes

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kwol watches the Orgoscope's cameras and reports trouble to Karja, who runs its guards. Later both watch Adam and Ayesha question a captured Ravager.
stages.whoA: Master Karja, head of the Orgoscope's guards
stages.whoB: Kwol, an administrator who works with him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kwol raises the alarm on the Guardians and sends the Orgosentries after them. When Gamora storms her office, she shoots Kwol in the leg to show they mean business.
stages.whoA: Gamora, who shoots her in the leg
stages.whoB: Kwol, the administrator she shoots

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kwol recognizes Mantis and Drax from the day's warning despite their OrgoCorp uniforms. She calls the Orgosentries on them, and the two have to fight their way through.
stages.whoA: Mantis, one of the intruders she spots
stages.whoB: Kwol, who sees through her disguise

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Neelie trips fleeing the Guardians on Counter-Earth, and Quill cleans her knee to show they mean no harm. She takes them home, points them to the pyramid and lends him her car, which he crashes.
stages.whoA: Peter Quill, the stranger she helps
stages.whoB: Neelie, the Counter-Earth woman who helps him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Neelie hosts the Guardians in her home while Drax sprawls across her couch with his boots on her pillows. Drax stays behind with Rocket when the others head for the pyramid.
stages.whoA: Drax, the rude guest on her couch
stages.whoB: Neelie, the Humanimal whose couch he takes

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Savin meets Taggart outside the Chinese Theatre with a case of Extremis and asks if he can regulate. Taggart says he can, but when Happy grabs the case, he takes too much and explodes.
stages.whoA: Savin, who brings him his Extremis doses
stages.whoB: Taggart, an Extremis soldier he supplies

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Happy follows Savin to the Chinese Theatre, bumps into Taggart and takes one of his doses. Taggart calls for Savin's help, then explodes, leaving Happy badly hurt.
stages.whoA: Happy, who catches his deal with Savin
stages.whoB: Taggart, whose blast puts him in the hospital

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Hoag arrives with Damage Control and tells Toomes his crew is off the salvage job. When he begs and then punches one of her men, she calls off her guards and tells him to take it up with her superiors.
stages.whoA: Toomes, the salvager she shuts out
stages.whoB: Hoag, the official who takes his job

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Foster stands with Damage Control as it throws Toomes's crew off the Battle of New York cleanup. When Toomes pleads that he could lose his house, Foster tells him not to overextend himself, and Toomes punches him.
stages.whoA: The salvage boss who punches him
stages.whoB: The Damage Control agent he punches

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Foster serves under Agent Cleary on the Damage Control raid on Peter's home. At the precinct they question Peter together, and Cleary sends him to get Ned a snack.
stages.whoA: The agent leading his investigation
stages.whoB: A Damage Control agent on his team

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Foster helps arrest Peter at home over the London attack. In the interrogation room he sits with Cleary as Peter says the drones killed Beck and Cleary tells him Nick Fury has been off the planet.
stages.whoA: The teen he arrests and questions
stages.whoB: A Damage Control agent who questions him

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Principal Morita calls Peter to his office and gives him detention. Later he calls Peter in again, tells him he is a good kid and a smart kid, and lets him go with a second chance.
stages.whoA: The student he gives a second chance
stages.whoB: His principal at Midtown

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Randy works on Toomes's salvage crew. After Damage Control takes the job, he points out they still have a load of alien material, and Toomes decides to keep it and go into business.
stages.whoA: His boss, whom he calls chief
stages.whoB: A worker on his crew

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Randy and Schultz carry a scanner into Midtown to track the alien power core Spider-Man took. Later they meet Mac Gargan's men on the Staten Island Ferry together.
stages.whoA: His partner on Toomes's crew
stages.whoB: His partner on Toomes's crew

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Spider-Man crashes the weapons deal on the Staten Island Ferry. He webs Randy to the railing, leaving him for the FBI.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who webs him up on the ferry
stages.whoB: A crook he webs up on the ferry

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Randy and Schultz sell Toomes's weapons to Gargan on the Staten Island Ferry. Spider-Man breaks up the deal before it is done.
stages.whoA: The buyer at his ferry deal
stages.whoB: A seller at his ferry deal

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dag and Talia work the S.A.B.E.R. station with Monica. They find strange pink eggs in a vent and bring them to Fury, then report the failing pods as the station falls apart. Afterward they clear out Monica's desk together.
stages.whoA: His fellow S.A.B.E.R. agent
stages.whoB: Her fellow S.A.B.E.R. agent

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dag reports to Fury on the eggs and the jump point surges, which keep bringing bad news. Fury has the Flerkens swallow the crew to save them, and later asks Dag how things are after Monica is lost.
stages.whoA: His commander on the station
stages.whoB: An agent on his station

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dag works with Monica outside the station as the jump point surges. She goes out alone to read it, which tangles her powers with Carol's and Kamala's. When she is stranded, he mourns her.
stages.whoA: His S.A.B.E.R. colleague
stages.whoB: A S.A.B.E.R. agent on her spacewalk

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: On the station, Yusuf gives Dag advice on index funds and saving for retirement. Dag admits he never thought about it, and the two laugh together until another surge hits.
stages.whoA: A visitor who gives him money advice
stages.whoB: An agent he advises on retirement

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Talia brings Fury the eggs and tells him fifteen escape pods cannot save 350 crew. Fury orders her to fill them and find a Plan B, then saves everyone with the Flerkens.
stages.whoA: Her commander on the station
stages.whoB: An agent on his station

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Talia works the jump point with Monica on a spacewalk outside the station. After Monica is stranded in another universe, Talia clears out her desk in sorrow.
stages.whoA: Her colleague and friend
stages.whoB: A S.A.B.E.R. agent on her team

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Ty-Rone serves Dar-Benn as she hunts the bands to save Hala. He warns her the band is unstable and the power to relight Hala's sun would kill her, but she refuses to wait.
stages.whoA: The Supremor he advises
stages.whoB: Her advisor, who studies the band

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Monica appears on Dar-Benn's ship with Kamala, and Ty-Rone asks what to do about them. On Aladna, Monica blasts Dar-Benn, and Ty-Rone hands his leader back her weapon.
stages.whoA: An associate of Captain Marvel
stages.whoB: Dar-Benn's advisor

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Kamala suddenly appears with Monica on Dar-Benn's ship in Carol's place. Ty-Rone tells Dar-Benn they are associates of Captain Marvel and asks what to do with them.
stages.whoA: An associate of Captain Marvel
stages.whoB: Dar-Benn's advisor

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Azarel chases Jack through the maze. When the Bloodstone throws him back, she tells Verussa, exposing him as a monster, and then watches him turn into a werewolf.
stages.whoA: The rival hunter she exposes
stages.whoB: A hunter who chases and exposes him

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Both hunt the monster for the Bloodstone. When Elsa breaks free during the werewolf's rampage, Azarel attacks her with a chain hammer, and Elsa kills her with a sword.
stages.whoA: The rival who kills her
stages.whoB: A hunter she kills

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Azarel answers Verussa's call to hunt for the Bloodstone. She tells Verussa the stone threw Jack back, then masks up beside her as Verussa forces Jack to change.
stages.whoA: The widow who runs the hunt
stages.whoB: A hunter at her ceremony

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jovan chats warmly with Jack before the ceremony, boasting of his kills. Jack draws the right to enter the maze first, and Jovan groans at his luck.
stages.whoA: A friendly rival in the hunt
stages.whoB: A boastful rival in the hunt

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jovan runs into Elsa in the maze and attacks her with an axe. She flips him and takes the axe, and he swears death is coming for her.
stages.whoA: The hunter he swears to kill
stages.whoB: A hunter who attacks her with an axe

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jovan hunts the monster through the maze to win the Bloodstone. Ted bursts out of the bushes, grabs his head and burns him to death.
stages.whoA: The monster who kills him
stages.whoB: A hunter he kills

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jovan comes to Verussa's ceremony for Ulysses, where she counts his 57 kills. He joins the pledge and follows her rules for the hunt.
stages.whoA: The widow who runs the hunt
stages.whoB: A hunter at her ceremony

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Emma confronts her escaped husband Flint at their apartment and calls him a common thief who may even have killed a man. She orders him away from their sick daughter Penny as the police close in.
stages.whoA: Flint, her escaped convict husband
stages.whoB: Emma, his wife

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Emma raises her sick daughter Penny alone while Flint is in prison. When Flint comes home, Emma tries to keep him away from Penny.
stages.whoA: Penny, her sick daughter
stages.whoB: Emma, her mother

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Flint sneaks home from prison to see Penny, who tells him she missed him too and gives him her pendant. He promises to make her healthy again, and later tells Peter that his daughter is all he has left.
stages.whoA: Flint, her father
stages.whoB: Penny, his sick daughter

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Miss Calleros teaches Miles's class that ours is one of many parallel universes. When he scores a zero on a true or false quiz, she tells him only someone who knows the right answers can get them all wrong, refuses to let him quit and assigns an essay about who he wants to be. Miles finishes that essay after becoming Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Miles, a new student in her class
stages.whoB: Miss Calleros, his physics teacher

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Store clerk T-Bone refuses to sell Peter his milk when he is two cents short, and mocks him for it. When a thief robs the register, T-Bone asks Peter for a little help, and Peter answers that it is not his policy.
stages.whoA: Peter, a customer two cents short
stages.whoB: T-Bone, the clerk who mocks him

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: A man in line behind Peter distracts T-Bone and robs his open cash register. T-Bone shouts for someone to stop him as the thief escapes.
stages.whoA: The thief who robs his register
stages.whoB: T-Bone, the clerk he robs
